modules.source:
-- | Codecs for the versioned syntax artifacts.
--
-- Decoding turns the compiler's exports into the typed `Syntax` vocabularies,
-- rejecting wrong schema tags, malformed shapes, and spans that invert or reach
-- past the embedded source with one structured error; encoding is the exact
-- inverse, re-emitting identical bytes.
--
-- The printer here matches the compiler's export format precisely: two-space
-- indent, one element per line, a space after each key's colon, `[]` and `{}`
-- for empty collections, insertion-order object keys, and the shared escape
-- discipline (named escapes plus lowercase `\u00xx` for other control
-- characters). Field order is part of the schema: envelope keys are in
-- declaration order, node objects are alphabetical, and optional fields are
-- omitted rather than null.

import Data.List (..)

import Data.Maybe (..)

import Data.Result (..)

import Data.String (..)

import Json (Json, JNull, JBool, JInt, JFloat, JStr, JArr, JObj, decode, json_error_message)

import Syntax.Source (..)

import Syntax.Token (..)

import Syntax.Ast (..)

import Syntax.Diagnostic (..)

import Syntax.Resolved (..)

-- | The schema tag of the token-stream artifact.
pub fn tokens_schema() : String = "prism-syntax-tokens-v1"

-- | A structured decode refusal: the path of the offending value inside the
-- document and the reason it was rejected.
pub type CodecError = CodecError { path: String, reason: String }

-- | Render a codec error as one line.
pub fn codec_error_message(e : CodecError) : String = "{e.path}: {e.reason}"

-- | A decoded `prism-syntax-tokens-v1` document: the envelope identity, the
-- embedded source, the raw and post-layout token streams, and the trivia
-- events, all in stream order.
pub type TokensDoc = TokensDoc {
  schema: String,
  compiler: String,
  source: SourceFile,
  raw: List(Token),
  parse: List(Token),
  trivia: List(Trivia)
}

-- Assoc lookup over a JSON object's parse-order fields.
fn jget(fields : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Option(Json) =
  match fields of
    Nil => None
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        Some(v)
      else
        jget(rest, key)

fn need(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String
) : Result(Json, CodecError) =
  match jget(fields, key) of
    Some(v) => Ok(v)
    None => Err(CodecError { path = path, reason = "missing field `{key}`" })

fn as_obj(j : Json, path : String) : Result(List((String, Json)), CodecError) =
  match j of
    JObj(fields) => Ok(fields)
    _ => Err(CodecError { path = path, reason = "expected an object" })

fn as_arr(j : Json, path : String) : Result(List(Json), CodecError) =
  match j of
    JArr(items) => Ok(items)
    _ => Err(CodecError { path = path, reason = "expected an array" })

fn as_str(j : Json, path : String) : Result(String, CodecError) =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => Ok(s)
    _ => Err(CodecError { path = path, reason = "expected a string" })

fn as_int(j : Json, path : String) : Result(Int, CodecError) =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => Ok(n)
    _ => Err(CodecError { path = path, reason = "expected an integer" })

fn token_of(j : Json, path : String) : Token ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Token {
    kind = kind_of_name(str_at(fields, "kind", path)),
    span = span_at(fields, path),
    value = opt_at(fields, "value", path, str_of)
  }

fn trivia_of(j : Json, path : String) : Trivia ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  let kname = str_at(fields, "kind", path)
  let span = span_at(fields, path)
  if kname == "comment" then
    TComment(span)
  elif kname == "block-comment" then
    TBlockComment(span)
  elif kname == "blank" then
    TBlank(span)
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown trivia kind `{kname}`"
        },
      )

-- | Decode a `prism-syntax-tokens-v1` document from its exact bytes. A wrong
-- or missing schema tag, malformed JSON, missing field, or invalid span is a
-- structured `CodecError`, never a partial document.
pub fn decode_tokens(text : String) : Result(TokensDoc, CodecError) =
  run_decode(\() -> decode_tokens_doc(text))

fn decode_tokens_doc(text : String) : TokensDoc ! {Decode} =
  let j = ok_or_bail(decode_or_codec_error(text))
  let fields = obj_at(j, "$")
  let doc =
    TokensDoc {
      schema = schema_at(fields, tokens_schema()),
      compiler = str_at(fields, "compiler", "$"),
      source = source_at(fields),
      raw = req_arr(fields, "raw", "$", token_of),
      parse = req_arr(fields, "parse", "$", token_of),
      trivia = req_arr(fields, "trivia", "$", trivia_of)
    }
  validate_tokens(doc)

-- Reject a token document whose spans reach past the embedded source. Every
-- span is a byte range into that text, so an offset the document cannot support
-- is refused here rather than handed to a consumer that slices on it. The
-- inverted-or-negative refusal already fired per span while decoding.
fn validate_tokens(d : TokensDoc) : TokensDoc ! {Decode} =
  let len = str_len(d.source.text)
  check_span_ends(map(\(t) -> t.span, d.raw), len, "$.raw")
  check_span_ends(map(\(t) -> t.span, d.parse), len, "$.parse")
  check_span_ends(map(trivia_span, d.trivia), len, "$.trivia")
  d

-- The artifact escape discipline, shared with the compiler's JSON emitter:
-- named escapes, then lowercase `\u00xx` for the remaining control characters,
-- raw UTF-8 for everything else.
fn esc_char(c : Int) : String =
  if c == 34 then
    "\\\""
  elif c == 92 then
    "\\\\"
  elif c == 8 then
    "\\b"
  elif c == 12 then
    "\\f"
  elif c == 10 then
    "\\n"
  elif c == 13 then
    "\\r"
  elif c == 9 then
    "\\t"
  elif c < 32 then
    "\\u00{hex2(c)}"
  else
    str_of_char(chr(c))

fn hex_digit(n : Int) : String =
  str_of_char(chr(if n < 10 then 48 + n else 97 + n - 10))

fn hex2(c : Int) : String = "{hex_digit(c / 16)}{hex_digit(c % 16)}"

-- Escape by copying maximal clean runs whole, so a mostly-clean string costs
-- one slice per escape rather than one allocation per character.
fn needs_escape(c : Int) : Bool = c == 34 || c == 92 || c < 32

fn jesc(s : String) : String = str_join("", jesc_go(s, 0, 0, []))

fn jesc_go(s : String, run : Int, i : Int, acc : List(String)) : List(String) =
  if i >= str_len(s) then
    reverse(if run < i then Cons(substring(s, run, i - run), acc) else acc)
  elif needs_escape(char_at(s, i)) then
    let acc2 =
      if run < i then
        Cons(substring(s, run, i - run), acc)
      else
        acc
    jesc_go(s, i + 1, i + 1, Cons(esc_char(char_at(s, i)), acc2))
  else
    jesc_go(s, run, i + 1, acc)

fn spaces(n : Int) : String =
  if n <= 0 then
    ""
  else
    concat("  ", spaces(n - 2))

-- The exact export layout: two-space indent, one element per line, a space
-- after each colon, empty collections inline, insertion-order keys.
fn render(j : Json, ind : Int) : String =
  match j of
    JNull => "null"
    JBool(b) =>
      if b then
        "true"
      else
        "false"
    JInt(n) => show_int(n)
    JFloat(x) => show_float(x)
    JStr(s) => "\"{jesc(s)}\""
    JArr(items) =>
      match items of
        Nil => "[]"
        _ =>
          let inner = str_join(
              ",\n",
              map(\(x) -> "{spaces(ind + 2)}{render(x, ind + 2)}", items),
            )
          "[\n{inner}\n{spaces(ind)}]"
    JObj(fields) =>
      match fields of
        Nil => "\{\}"
        _ =>
          let inner =
            str_join(",\n", map(\(kv) -> render_field(kv, ind + 2), fields))
          "\{\n{inner}\n{spaces(ind)}\}"

fn render_field(kv : (String, Json), ind : Int) : String =
  match kv of
    (k, v) => "{spaces(ind)}\"{jesc(k)}\": {render(v, ind)}"

-- | Render a JSON value in the export layout the encoders here use, for tools
-- that derive a document from an artifact instead of re-encoding a decoded one.
pub fn canonical_json(j : Json) : String = render(j, 0)

fn span_json(s : Span) : Json = JArr([JInt(s.lo), JInt(s.hi)])

fn token_json(t : Token) : Json =
  let base = [("kind", JStr(kind_name(t.kind))), ("span", span_json(t.span))]
  match t.value of
    None => JObj(base)
    Some(v) => JObj(append(base, [("value", JStr(v))]))

fn trivia_json(t : Trivia) : Json =
  JObj([("kind", JStr(trivia_name(t))), ("span", span_json(trivia_span(t)))])

-- | Encode a token document back to the exact artifact bytes the compiler
-- emits: `encode_tokens` after `decode_tokens` is byte-identity on every
-- well-formed export.
pub fn encode_tokens(d : TokensDoc) : String =
  render(
      JObj([
          ("schema", JStr(d.schema)),
          ("compiler", JStr(d.compiler)),
          (
              "source",
              JObj([
                  ("digest", JStr(d.source.digest)),
                  ("text", JStr(d.source.text)),
                ]),
            ),
          ("raw", JArr(map(token_json, d.raw))),
          ("parse", JArr(map(token_json, d.parse))),
          ("trivia", JArr(map(trivia_json, d.trivia))),
        ]),
      0,
    )

-- | The schema tag of the surface-syntax artifact.
pub fn surface_schema() : String = "prism-surface-syntax-v1"

-- | A decoded `prism-surface-syntax-v1` document: the envelope identity, the
-- embedded source, and the ordered item list of the parsed file.
pub type SurfaceDoc = SurfaceDoc {
  schema: String,
  compiler: String,
  source: SourceFile,
  items: List(Item)
}

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Wire tags

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Encode helpers
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The `kind` tag fragment every node starts with.
fn kf(k : String) : (String, Json) = ("kind", JStr(k))

-- An always-present array field.
fn arrf(key : String, xs : List(Json)) : (String, Json) = (key, JArr(xs))

-- A list field omitted when empty (mirrors the exporter's `put_list`).
fn omit_list(key : String, xs : List(Json)) : List((String, Json)) =
  match xs of
    Nil => []
    _ => [(key, JArr(xs))]

-- A string-array field omitted when empty (mirrors `put_strs`).
fn omit_strs(key : String, xs : List(String)) : List((String, Json)) =
  match xs of
    Nil => []
    _ => [(key, JArr(map(JStr, xs)))]

-- A boolean flag field omitted when false (mirrors `put_flag`).
fn flag_field(key : String, b : Bool) : List((String, Json)) =
  if b then
    [(key, JBool(true))]
  else
    []

-- An optional string field.
fn opt_str_field(key : String, o : Option(String)) : List((String, Json)) =
  match o of
    None => []
    Some(s) => [(key, JStr(s))]

-- An optional field carrying an encoded value, omitted when absent.
fn opt_field(
  key : String,
  o : Option(a),
  f : (a) -> Json
) : List((String, Json)) =
  match o of
    None => []
    Some(x) => [(key, f(x))]

fn vis_frag(v : Option(String)) : List((String, Json)) = opt_str_field("vis", v)

fn dep_frag(v : Option(String)) : List((String, Json)) =
  opt_str_field("deprecated", v)

fn field_key(kv : (String, Json)) : String =
  match kv of
    (k, _v) => k

-- Insert one field into a key-sorted list.
fn ins_field(
  kv : (String, Json),
  acc : List((String, Json))
) : List((String, Json)) =
  match acc of
    Nil => [kv]
    Cons(h, t) =>
      if field_key(kv) < field_key(h) then
        Cons(kv, acc)
      else
        Cons(h, ins_field(kv, t))

-- Order a node object's fields by key: the exporter emits node objects with
-- alphabetical (byte-lexicographic) keys, so encoding sorts before rendering.
fn sort_fields(fs : List((String, Json))) : List((String, Json)) =
  foldr(ins_field, [], fs)

-- A node object with no span: sort the fields and wrap.
fn node_obj(fs : List((String, Json))) : Json = JObj(sort_fields(fs))

-- The spanned wrapper an expression or pattern object carries: its own fields
-- plus `span`, plus `synth` when the parser set the sugar bit, all sorted.
fn sp_obj(fs : List((String, Json)), s : Span, synth : Bool) : Json =
  let withspan = append(fs, [("span", span_json(s))])
  let all =
    if synth then
      append(withspan, [("synth", JBool(true))])
    else
      withspan
  JObj(sort_fields(all))

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Encoders
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn enc_kind(k : Kind) : Json =
  match k of
    KType => JStr(tag_kind_type())
    KRow => JStr(tag_kind_row())
    KNat => JStr(tag_kind_nat())
    KFun(a, b) => node_obj([("from", enc_kind(a)), ("to", enc_kind(b))])

fn enc_efflabel(l : EffLabel) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [("name", JStr(l.name))],
      omit_list("args", map(enc_ty, l.args)),
    ]))

fn enc_row(r : Row) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [arrf("labels", map(enc_efflabel, r.labels))],
      opt_str_field("tail", r.tail),
    ]))

fn enc_cfield(c : CField) : Json =
  node_obj([("name", JStr(c.name)), ("ty", enc_ty(c.ty))])

fn enc_ty(t : Ty) : Json =
  match t of
    TyInt => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_int())])
    TyI64 => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_i64())])
    TyU64 => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_u64())])
    TyBool => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_bool())])
    TyUnit => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_unit())])
    TyFloat => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_float())])
    TyChar => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_char())])
    TyStr => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_str())])
    TyVar(n) => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_var()), ("name", JStr(n))])
    TyApp(h, args) =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_ty_app()), ("head", JStr(h))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_ty, args)),
        ]))
    TyState(n) => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_state()), ("cell", JInt(n))])
    TyForall(vars, b) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_ty_forall()),
          arrf("vars", map(JStr, vars)),
          ("ty", enc_ty(b)),
        ])
    TyFun(ps, row, ret) =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_ty_fun())],
          omit_list("params", map(enc_ty, ps)),
          [("effects", enc_row(row)), ("ret", enc_ty(ret))],
        ]))
    TyCon(n, args) =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_ty_con()), ("name", JStr(n))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_ty, args)),
        ]))
    TyTuple(items) =>
      node_obj([kf(tag_ty_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_ty, items))])
    TyUnboxedTuple(items) =>
      node_obj([kf(tag_ty_unboxed_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_ty, items))])
    TyUnboxedRecord(fs) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_ty_unboxed_record()),
          arrf("fields", map(enc_cfield, fs)),
        ])
    TyRowLit(row) => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_row()), ("row", enc_row(row))])
    TyNat(n) => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_nat()), ("value", JInt(n))])
    TyUsage(b, facts) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_ty_usage()),
          ("ty", enc_ty(b)),
          arrf("facts", map(JStr, facts)),
        ])

fn enc_named(n : NamedExpr) : Json =
  node_obj([("name", JStr(n.name)), ("value", enc_expr(n.value))])

fn enc_ensure(e : Ensure) : Json =
  node_obj([("binder", JStr(e.binder)), ("expr", enc_expr(e.expr))])

fn enc_param(p : Param) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [("name", JStr(p.name))],
      opt_field("pat", p.pat, enc_pat),
      opt_field("ty", p.ty, enc_ty),
      flag_field("borrow", p.is_borrow),
      opt_field("default", p.dflt, enc_expr),
    ]))

fn enc_constraint(c : Constraint) : Json =
  node_obj([
      ("class", JStr(c.cls)),
      ("span", span_json(c.span)),
      ("ty", enc_ty(c.ty)),
    ])

fn suffix_frag(s : Suffix) : List((String, Json)) =
  match s of
    SufNone => []
    SufI64 => [("suffix", JStr(tag_suffix_i64()))]
    SufU64 => [("suffix", JStr(tag_suffix_u64()))]

fn enc_expr(e : Sp(Expr)) : Json =
  sp_obj(enc_expr_node(e.node), e.span, e.synth)

fn enc_expr_node(e : Expr) : List((String, Json)) =
  match e of
    EInt(v, suf) =>
      append([kf(tag_expr_int()), ("value", JStr(v))], suffix_frag(suf))
    EFloat(v) => [kf(tag_expr_float()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    EChar(v) => [kf(tag_expr_char()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    EBool(b) => [kf(tag_expr_bool()), ("value", JBool(b))]
    EUnit => [kf(tag_expr_unit())]
    EStr(v) => [kf(tag_expr_str()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    EVar(n) => [kf(tag_expr_var()), ("name", JStr(n))]
    EHole(n) => [kf(tag_expr_hole()), ("name", JStr(n))]
    EBin(op, l, r) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_bin()),
          ("op", JStr(op)),
          ("lhs", enc_expr(l)),
          ("rhs", enc_expr(r)),
        ]
    ENeg(a) => [kf(tag_expr_neg()), ("expr", enc_expr(a))]
    EIf(c, t, f) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_if()),
          ("cond", enc_expr(c)),
          ("then", enc_expr(t)),
          ("else", enc_expr(f)),
        ]
    ELet(n, v, b) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_let()),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          ("value", enc_expr(v)),
          ("body", enc_expr(b)),
        ]
    ELam(ps, b) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_lam())],
          omit_list("params", map(enc_param, ps)),
          [("body", enc_expr(b))],
        ])
    ECall(h, args) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_call()), ("head", enc_expr(h))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_expr, args)),
        ])
    EPipe(l, r) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_pipe()), ("lhs", enc_expr(l)), ("rhs", enc_expr(r))]
    EMatch(s, arms) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_match()),
          ("scrutinee", enc_expr(s)),
          arrf("arms", map(enc_arm, arms)),
        ]
    EList(items) => [kf(tag_expr_list()), arrf("items", map(enc_expr, items))]
    ETuple(items) => [kf(tag_expr_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_expr, items))]
    EField(b, n) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_field()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("name", JStr(n))]
    EUnboxedTuple(items) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_unboxed_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_expr, items))]
    EUnboxedRecord(fs) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_unboxed_record()), arrf("fields", map(enc_named, fs))]
    EUnboxedField(b, n) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_unboxed_field()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("name", JStr(n))]
    ERecord(n, fs) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_record()),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          arrf("fields", map(enc_named, fs)),
        ]
    ERecordUpdate(b, n, fs) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_record_update()),
          ("base", enc_expr(b)),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          arrf("fields", map(enc_named, fs)),
        ]
    EPathUpdate(b, us) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_path_update()),
          ("base", enc_expr(b)),
          arrf("updates", map(enc_pupdate, us)),
        ]
    EHandle(b, arms, partial) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_handle()), ("body", enc_expr(b))],
          omit_list("arms", map(enc_harm, arms)),
          flag_field("partial", partial),
        ])
    EMask(eff, b) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_mask()), ("effect", JStr(eff)), ("body", enc_expr(b))]
    EInst(b, args) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_inst()),
          ("expr", enc_expr(b)),
          arrf("args", map(JStr, args)),
        ]
    EIndex(b, i) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_index()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("index", enc_expr(i))]
    EIndexSet(b, i, v) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_index_set()),
          ("expr", enc_expr(b)),
          ("index", enc_expr(i)),
          ("value", enc_expr(v)),
        ]
    EAnn(b, t) => [kf(tag_expr_ann()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("ty", enc_ty(t))]
    EMarker(m) => [kf(tag_expr_marker()), ("marker", JStr(m))]
    ENamedHandle(n, b, arms) =>
      flatten([
          [
              kf(tag_expr_named_handle()),
              ("name", JStr(n)),
              ("body", enc_expr(b)),
            ],
          omit_list("arms", map(enc_harm, arms)),
        ])
    EVarDecl(n, v, b) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_var_decl()),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          ("value", enc_expr(v)),
          ("body", enc_expr(b)),
        ]
    EAssign(n, v) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_assign()), ("name", JStr(n)), ("value", enc_expr(v))]
    EIndexAssign(b, i, v) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_index_assign()),
          ("expr", enc_expr(b)),
          ("index", enc_expr(i)),
          ("value", enc_expr(v)),
        ]
    EThrow(n, args) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_throw()), ("name", JStr(n))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_expr, args)),
        ])
    ETryCatch(b, arms) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_try_catch()),
          ("body", enc_expr(b)),
          arrf("arms", map(enc_catch, arms)),
        ]
    EFor(bnd, seq, quals, b) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_for()), ("binder", JStr(bnd)), ("seq", enc_expr(seq))],
          omit_list("quals", map(enc_qual, quals)),
          [("body", enc_expr(b))],
        ])
    EWhile(c, b) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_while()), ("cond", enc_expr(c)), ("body", enc_expr(b))]
    ELoop(b) => [kf(tag_expr_loop()), ("body", enc_expr(b))]
    EBreak => [kf(tag_expr_break())]
    EContinue => [kf(tag_expr_continue())]
    EReturn(v) => [kf(tag_expr_return()), ("value", enc_expr(v))]
    EComp(h, bnd, seq, quals) =>
      flatten([
          [
              kf(tag_expr_comprehension()),
              ("head", enc_expr(h)),
              ("binder", JStr(bnd)),
              ("seq", enc_expr(seq)),
            ],
          omit_list("quals", map(enc_qual, quals)),
        ])
    EDefault(b, f) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_default()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("fallback", enc_expr(f))]
    ETransact(b, f) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_transact()),
          ("body", enc_expr(b)),
          ("fallback", enc_expr(f)),
        ]
    EProbe(n, b) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_probe()), ("name", JStr(n)), ("body", enc_expr(b))]
    EReflect(d, n) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_reflect()), ("decl", JStr(d)), ("name", JStr(n))]
    EOptChain(b, n) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_opt_chain()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("name", JStr(n))]
    ERange(prefix, e) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_range()),
          arrf("prefix", map(enc_expr, prefix)),
          ("end", enc_expr(e)),
        ]
    ECompose(dir, l, r) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_compose()),
          ("dir", JStr(dir)),
          ("lhs", enc_expr(l)),
          ("rhs", enc_expr(r)),
        ]
    EReadPath(b, steps) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_read_path()),
          ("base", enc_expr(b)),
          arrf("path", map(enc_pstep, steps)),
        ]

fn enc_arm(a : Arm) : Json = sp_expr_arm(a)

fn sp_expr_arm(a : Arm) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [("pat", enc_pat(a.pat))],
      opt_field("guard", a.guard, enc_expr),
      [("body", enc_expr(a.body))],
    ]))

fn enc_harm(a : HandlerArm) : Json =
  match a of
    HReturn(b, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_return()),
          ("binder", JStr(b)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])
    HOp(op, ps, rk, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_op()),
          ("op", JStr(op)),
          arrf("params", map(JStr, ps)),
          ("resume", JStr(rk)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])
    HOnce(op, ps, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_once()),
          ("op", JStr(op)),
          arrf("params", map(JStr, ps)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])
    HVal(n, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_val()),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])
    HNever(op, ps, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_never()),
          ("op", JStr(op)),
          arrf("params", map(JStr, ps)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])

fn enc_catch(a : CatchArm) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [("name", JStr(a.name))],
      omit_strs("binders", a.binders),
      [("body", enc_expr(a.body)), ("span", span_json(a.span))],
    ]))

fn enc_qual(q : Qual) : Json =
  match q of
    QGuard(e) => node_obj([kf(tag_qual_guard()), ("expr", enc_expr(e))])
    QBind(n, e) =>
      node_obj([kf(tag_qual_bind()), ("name", JStr(n)), ("value", enc_expr(e))])

fn enc_pstep(s : PathStep) : Json =
  match s of
    PSField(n) => node_obj([kf(tag_pstep_field()), ("name", JStr(n))])
    PSEach => node_obj([kf(tag_pstep_each())])
    PSCase(n) => node_obj([kf(tag_pstep_case()), ("name", JStr(n))])
    PSIndex(e) => node_obj([kf(tag_pstep_index()), ("expr", enc_expr(e))])
    PSWhere(e) => node_obj([kf(tag_pstep_where()), ("expr", enc_expr(e))])

fn enc_pop(o : PathOp) : Json =
  match o of
    POSet(e) => node_obj([kf(tag_pop_set()), ("expr", enc_expr(e))])
    POModify(e) => node_obj([kf(tag_pop_modify()), ("expr", enc_expr(e))])

fn enc_pupdate(u : PathUpdate) : Json =
  node_obj([arrf("path", map(enc_pstep, u.path)), ("op", enc_pop(u.op))])

fn enc_pat(p : Sp(Pat)) : Json = sp_obj(enc_pat_node(p.node), p.span, p.synth)

fn enc_pfield(f : PatField) : Json =
  node_obj([("name", JStr(f.name)), ("pat", enc_pat(f.pat))])

fn enc_pat_node(p : Pat) : List((String, Json)) =
  match p of
    PWild => [kf(tag_pat_wild())]
    PVar(n) => [kf(tag_pat_var()), ("name", JStr(n))]
    PInt(v, suf) =>
      append([kf(tag_pat_int()), ("value", JStr(v))], suffix_frag(suf))
    PFloat(v) => [kf(tag_pat_float()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    PChar(v) => [kf(tag_pat_char()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    PBool(b) => [kf(tag_pat_bool()), ("value", JBool(b))]
    PCtor(n, args) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_pat_ctor()), ("name", JStr(n))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_pat, args)),
        ])
    PTuple(items) => [kf(tag_pat_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_pat, items))]
    PRecord(n, fs, rest) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_pat_record()), ("name", JStr(n))],
          omit_list("fields", map(enc_pfield, fs)),
          flag_field("rest", rest),
        ])
    POr(alts) => [kf(tag_pat_or()), arrf("alts", map(enc_pat, alts))]

fn enc_ctor(c : Ctor) : Json =
  match c.shape of
    CPositional(args) =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [("name", JStr(c.name))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_ty, args)),
        ]))
    CRecord(fs) =>
      node_obj([("name", JStr(c.name)), arrf("fields", map(enc_cfield, fs))])

fn enc_deriving(d : Deriving) : Json =
  node_obj([("name", JStr(d.name)), ("span", span_json(d.span))])

fn enc_method(m : Method) : Json =
  node_obj([("name", JStr(m.name)), ("ty", enc_ty(m.ty))])

fn enc_effop(o : EffOp) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [("name", JStr(o.name))],
      omit_list("params", map(enc_ty, o.params)),
      [("ret", enc_ty(o.ret))],
      opt_str_field("grade", o.grade),
    ]))

fn enc_rungfield(f : RungField) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [("name", JStr(f.name)), ("ty", enc_ty(f.ty))],
      opt_field("default", f.dflt, enc_expr),
    ]))

fn enc_rung(r : Rung) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [("name", JStr(r.name))],
      opt_str_field("base", r.base),
      omit_list("fields", map(enc_rungfield, r.fields)),
      opt_str_field("frozen", r.frozen),
      [("span", span_json(r.span))],
    ]))

fn enc_converter(c : Converter) : Json =
  node_obj(flatten([
      [
          ("dir", JStr(c.dir)),
          ("from", JStr(c.from)),
          ("to", JStr(c.to)),
          ("base", enc_expr(c.base)),
        ],
      omit_list("overrides", map(enc_named, c.overrides)),
      omit_strs("drop_loss", c.drop_loss),
      [("span", span_json(c.span))],
    ]))

fn enc_mdir(d : MigrationDir) : Json =
  match d of
    DAuto => JStr(tag_migration_auto())
    DExpr(e) => enc_expr(e)

fn enc_mroute(r : MigrationRoute) : Json =
  match r of
    MAuto => JStr(tag_migration_auto())
    MVersion(up, down) =>
      node_obj([("upgrade", enc_mdir(up)), ("downgrade", enc_mdir(down))])

fn enc_migration(m : Migration) : Json =
  node_obj([
      ("from", JStr(m.from)),
      ("route", enc_mroute(m.route)),
      ("span", span_json(m.span)),
      ("to", JStr(m.to)),
    ])

-- The declaration fields shared by top-level fns/consts/logic-fns and by
-- instance methods; the caller adds visibility and deprecation.
fn enc_decl(d : Decl, kind : String) : List((String, Json)) =
  flatten([
      [kf(kind), ("name", JStr(d.name))],
      omit_list("params", map(enc_param, d.params)),
      opt_field("ret", d.ret, enc_ty),
      opt_field("effects", d.eff, enc_row),
      omit_list("constraints", map(enc_constraint, d.constraints)),
      [("body", enc_expr(d.body))],
      omit_list("wheres", map(enc_named, d.wheres)),
      omit_list("requires", map(enc_expr, d.reqs)),
      omit_list("ensures", map(enc_ensure, d.enss)),
      opt_field("decreases", d.measure, enc_expr),
      flag_field("test", d.is_test),
      opt_str_field("total", d.totality),
      opt_str_field("fip", d.fip_word),
      flag_field("replayable", d.is_replayable),
      flag_field("no_alloc", d.is_no_alloc),
      [("span", span_json(d.span))],
    ])

fn enc_method_decl(d : Decl) : Json = node_obj(enc_decl(d, tag_item_fn()))

fn enc_item(it : Item) : Json =
  match it of
    IImport {
      path = path,
      mod_alias = ma,
      names = names,
      glob = glob,
      reexport = reexport,
      span = span,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_import())],
          opt_str_field("alias", ma),
          opt_field("names", names, \(ns) -> JArr(map(JStr, ns))),
          [arrf("path", map(JStr, path))],
          flag_field("glob", glob),
          flag_field("reexport", reexport),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
        ]))
    IData {
      nt = nt,
      name = name,
      params = params,
      param_kinds = pks,
      ctors = ctors,
      derivs = derivs,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [
              kf(if nt then tag_item_newtype() else tag_item_data()),
              ("name", JStr(name)),
            ],
          omit_strs("params", params),
          omit_list("param_kinds", map(enc_kind, pks)),
          omit_list("ctors", map(enc_ctor, ctors)),
          omit_list("deriving", map(enc_deriving, derivs)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IEffect {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      ops = ops,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_effect()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_strs("params", params),
          omit_list("ops", map(enc_effop, ops)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IError {
      name = name,
      arg_types = params,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_error()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_list("params", map(enc_ty, params)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IEffAlias {
      name = name,
      labels = labels,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_effect_alias()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_list("labels", map(enc_efflabel, labels)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    ISynonym {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      ty = ty,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_type_synonym()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_strs("params", params),
          [("ty", enc_ty(ty)), ("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IClass {
      name = name,
      param = param,
      supers = supers,
      methods = methods,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_class()), ("name", JStr(name)), ("param", JStr(param))],
          omit_strs("supers", supers),
          omit_list("methods", map(enc_method, methods)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IInstance {
      name = name,
      cls = cls,
      head = head,
      context = context,
      decls = methods,
      span = span,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [
              kf(tag_item_instance()),
              ("name", JStr(name)),
              ("class", JStr(cls)),
              ("head", enc_ty(head)),
            ],
          omit_list("context", map(enc_constraint, context)),
          omit_list("methods", map(enc_method_decl, methods)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
        ]))
    ICanonical { cls = cls, head = head, name = name, span = span } =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_item_canonical()),
          ("class", JStr(cls)),
          ("head", enc_ty(head)),
          ("name", JStr(name)),
          ("span", span_json(span)),
        ])
    IPattern {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      forty = forty,
      viewfn = viewfn,
      makefn = makefn,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_pattern()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_strs("params", params),
          [("for", JStr(forty)), ("view", enc_expr(viewfn))],
          opt_field("make", makefn, enc_expr),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IStable {
      name = name,
      rungs = rungs,
      converters = converters,
      migrations = migrations,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_stable()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_list("rungs", map(enc_rung, rungs)),
          omit_list("converters", map(enc_converter, converters)),
          omit_list("migrations", map(enc_migration, migrations)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IDecl { decl = decl, declkind = declkind, vis = vis, dep = dep } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          enc_decl(decl, declkind),
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))

-- | Encode a surface document back to the exact artifact bytes the compiler
-- emits: `encode_surface` after `decode_surface` is byte-identity on every
-- well-formed export.
pub fn encode_surface(d : SurfaceDoc) : String =
  render(
      JObj([
          ("schema", JStr(d.schema)),
          ("compiler", JStr(d.compiler)),
          (
              "source",
              JObj([
                  ("digest", JStr(d.source.digest)),
                  ("text", JStr(d.source.text)),
                ]),
            ),
          ("items", JArr(map(enc_item, d.items))),
        ]),
      0,
    )

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Decode helpers
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn as_bool(j : Json, path : String) : Result(Bool, CodecError) =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => Ok(b)
    _ => Err(CodecError { path = path, reason = "expected a boolean" })

-- Boolean flag field: absent or false is false.
fn flagf(fields : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Bool =
  match jget(fields, key) of
    Some(JBool(b)) => b
    _ => false

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Decoders
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn dec_kind(j : Json, path : String) : Kind ! {Decode} =
  match j of
    JStr(s) =>
      if s == tag_kind_type() then
        KType
      elif s == tag_kind_row() then
        KRow
      elif s == tag_kind_nat() then
        KNat
      else
        fail_decode(CodecError { path = path, reason = "unknown kind `{s}`" })
    JObj(fields) =>
      let a = req_at(fields, "from", path, dec_kind)
      KFun(a, req_at(fields, "to", path, dec_kind))
    _ => fail_decode(CodecError { path = path, reason = "expected a kind" })

fn dec_efflabel(j : Json, path : String) : EffLabel ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  EffLabel {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    args = list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_ty)
  }

fn dec_row(j : Json, path : String) : Row ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Row {
    labels = list_at(fields, "labels", path, dec_efflabel),
    tail = opt_at(fields, "tail", path, str_of)
  }

fn dec_cfield(j : Json, path : String) : CField ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  CField {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    ty = req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty)
  }

fn dec_ty(j : Json, path : String) : Ty ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  dec_ty_kind(str_at(fields, "kind", path), fields, path)

fn dec_ty_kind(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Ty ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_ty_int() then
    TyInt
  elif kind == tag_ty_i64() then
    TyI64
  elif kind == tag_ty_u64() then
    TyU64
  elif kind == tag_ty_bool() then
    TyBool
  elif kind == tag_ty_unit() then
    TyUnit
  elif kind == tag_ty_float() then
    TyFloat
  elif kind == tag_ty_char() then
    TyChar
  elif kind == tag_ty_str() then
    TyStr
  elif kind == tag_ty_var() then
    TyVar(str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_ty_app() then
    let h = str_at(fields, "head", path)
    TyApp(h, list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_ty))
  else
    dec_ty_kind2(kind, fields, path)

fn dec_ty_kind2(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Ty ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_ty_state() then
    TyState(req_at(fields, "cell", path, int_of))
  elif kind == tag_ty_forall() then
    let vars = strs_at(fields, "vars", path)
    TyForall(vars, req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_fun() then
    let ps = list_at(fields, "params", path, dec_ty)
    let row = req_at(fields, "effects", path, dec_row)
    TyFun(ps, row, req_at(fields, "ret", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_con() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    TyCon(n, list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_tuple() then
    TyTuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_unboxed_tuple() then
    TyUnboxedTuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_unboxed_record() then
    TyUnboxedRecord(list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_cfield))
  elif kind == tag_ty_row() then
    TyRowLit(req_at(fields, "row", path, dec_row))
  elif kind == tag_ty_nat() then
    TyNat(req_at(fields, "value", path, int_of))
  elif kind == tag_ty_usage() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty)
    TyUsage(b, strs_at(fields, "facts", path))
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown type kind `{kind}`"
        },
      )

fn dec_named(j : Json, path : String) : NamedExpr ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  NamedExpr {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    value = req_at(fields, "value", path, dec_expr)
  }

fn dec_ensure(j : Json, path : String) : Ensure ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Ensure {
    binder = str_at(fields, "binder", path),
    expr = req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr)
  }

fn dec_suffix(fields : List((String, Json))) : Suffix =
  match jget(fields, "suffix") of
    Some(JStr(s)) =>
      if s == tag_suffix_i64() then
        SufI64
      elif s == tag_suffix_u64() then
        SufU64
      else
        SufNone
    _ => SufNone

fn dec_param(j : Json, path : String) : Param ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Param {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    pat = opt_at(fields, "pat", path, dec_pat),
    ty = opt_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty),
    is_borrow = flagf(fields, "borrow"),
    dflt = opt_at(fields, "default", path, dec_expr)
  }

fn dec_constraint(j : Json, path : String) : Constraint ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Constraint {
    cls = str_at(fields, "class", path),
    ty = req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty),
    span = span_at(fields, path)
  }

fn dec_expr(j : Json, path : String) : Sp(Expr) ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  let kind = str_at(fields, "kind", path)
  let span = span_at(fields, path)
  Sp {
    node = dec_expr_node(kind, fields, path),
    span = span,
    synth = flagf(fields, "synth")
  }

-- One expression field.
fn e1(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String,
  key : String,
  mk : (Sp(Expr)) -> Expr
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  mk(req_at(fields, key, path, dec_expr))

-- Two expression fields.
fn e2(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String,
  k1 : String,
  k2 : String,
  mk : (Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr)) -> Expr
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  let a = req_at(fields, k1, path, dec_expr)
  mk(a, req_at(fields, k2, path, dec_expr))

-- Three expression fields.
fn e3(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String,
  k1 : String,
  k2 : String,
  k3 : String,
  mk : (Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr)) -> Expr
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  let a = req_at(fields, k1, path, dec_expr)
  let b = req_at(fields, k2, path, dec_expr)
  mk(a, b, req_at(fields, k3, path, dec_expr))

-- A string field then an expression field.
fn se(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String,
  ks : String,
  ke : String,
  mk : (String, Sp(Expr)) -> Expr
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  let s = str_at(fields, ks, path)
  mk(s, req_at(fields, ke, path, dec_expr))

-- An expression field then a string field.
fn es(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String,
  ke : String,
  ks : String,
  mk : (Sp(Expr), String) -> Expr
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  let x = req_at(fields, ke, path, dec_expr)
  mk(x, str_at(fields, ks, path))

-- A string field then two expression fields.
fn s2e(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String,
  ks : String,
  k1 : String,
  k2 : String,
  mk : (String, Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr)) -> Expr
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  let s = str_at(fields, ks, path)
  let a = req_at(fields, k1, path, dec_expr)
  mk(s, a, req_at(fields, k2, path, dec_expr))

fn dec_expr_node(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_int() then
    EInt(str_at(fields, "value", path), dec_suffix(fields))
  elif kind == tag_expr_float() then
    EFloat(str_at(fields, "value", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_char() then
    EChar(str_at(fields, "value", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_bool() then
    EBool(req_at(fields, "value", path, bool_of))
  elif kind == tag_expr_unit() then
    EUnit
  elif kind == tag_expr_str() then
    EStr(str_at(fields, "value", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_var() then
    EVar(str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_hole() then
    EHole(str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_bin() then
    let op = str_at(fields, "op", path)
    let l = req_at(fields, "lhs", path, dec_expr)
    EBin(op, l, req_at(fields, "rhs", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_neg() then
    e1(fields, path, "expr", ENeg)
  else
    dec_expr_node2(kind, fields, path)

fn dec_expr_node2(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_if() then
    e3(fields, path, "cond", "then", "else", EIf)
  elif kind == tag_expr_let() then
    s2e(fields, path, "name", "value", "body", ELet)
  elif kind == tag_expr_lam() then
    let ps = list_at(fields, "params", path, dec_param)
    ELam(ps, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_call() then
    let h = req_at(fields, "head", path, dec_expr)
    ECall(h, list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_pipe() then
    e2(fields, path, "lhs", "rhs", EPipe)
  elif kind == tag_expr_match() then
    let s = req_at(fields, "scrutinee", path, dec_expr)
    EMatch(s, list_at(fields, "arms", path, dec_arm))
  elif kind == tag_expr_list() then
    EList(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_tuple() then
    ETuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_field() then
    es(fields, path, "expr", "name", EField)
  elif kind == tag_expr_unboxed_tuple() then
    EUnboxedTuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_expr))
  else
    dec_expr_node3(kind, fields, path)

fn dec_expr_node3(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_unboxed_record() then
    EUnboxedRecord(list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_named))
  elif kind == tag_expr_unboxed_field() then
    es(fields, path, "expr", "name", EUnboxedField)
  elif kind == tag_expr_record() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    ERecord(n, list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_named))
  elif kind == tag_expr_record_update() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "base", path, dec_expr)
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    ERecordUpdate(b, n, list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_named))
  elif kind == tag_expr_path_update() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "base", path, dec_expr)
    EPathUpdate(b, list_at(fields, "updates", path, dec_pupdate))
  elif kind == tag_expr_handle() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr)
    EHandle(
        b,
        list_at(fields, "arms", path, dec_harm),
        flagf(fields, "partial"),
      )
  elif kind == tag_expr_mask() then
    se(fields, path, "effect", "body", EMask)
  elif kind == tag_expr_inst() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr)
    EInst(b, strs_at(fields, "args", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_index() then
    e2(fields, path, "expr", "index", EIndex)
  elif kind == tag_expr_index_set() then
    e3(fields, path, "expr", "index", "value", EIndexSet)
  else
    dec_expr_node4(kind, fields, path)

fn dec_expr_node4(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_ann() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr)
    EAnn(b, req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_expr_marker() then
    EMarker(str_at(fields, "marker", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_named_handle() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    let b = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr)
    ENamedHandle(n, b, list_at(fields, "arms", path, dec_harm))
  elif kind == tag_expr_var_decl() then
    s2e(fields, path, "name", "value", "body", EVarDecl)
  elif kind == tag_expr_assign() then
    se(fields, path, "name", "value", EAssign)
  elif kind == tag_expr_index_assign() then
    e3(fields, path, "expr", "index", "value", EIndexAssign)
  elif kind == tag_expr_throw() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    EThrow(n, list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_try_catch() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr)
    ETryCatch(b, list_at(fields, "arms", path, dec_catch))
  elif kind == tag_expr_for() then
    let bnd = str_at(fields, "binder", path)
    let seq = req_at(fields, "seq", path, dec_expr)
    let quals = list_at(fields, "quals", path, dec_qual)
    EFor(bnd, seq, quals, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_while() then
    e2(fields, path, "cond", "body", EWhile)
  else
    dec_expr_node5(kind, fields, path)

fn dec_expr_node5(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_loop() then
    e1(fields, path, "body", ELoop)
  elif kind == tag_expr_break() then
    EBreak
  elif kind == tag_expr_continue() then
    EContinue
  elif kind == tag_expr_return() then
    e1(fields, path, "value", EReturn)
  elif kind == tag_expr_comprehension() then
    let h = req_at(fields, "head", path, dec_expr)
    let bnd = str_at(fields, "binder", path)
    let seq = req_at(fields, "seq", path, dec_expr)
    EComp(h, bnd, seq, list_at(fields, "quals", path, dec_qual))
  elif kind == tag_expr_default() then
    e2(fields, path, "expr", "fallback", EDefault)
  elif kind == tag_expr_transact() then
    e2(fields, path, "body", "fallback", ETransact)
  elif kind == tag_expr_probe() then
    se(fields, path, "name", "body", EProbe)
  elif kind == tag_expr_reflect() then
    EReflect(str_at(fields, "decl", path), str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_opt_chain() then
    es(fields, path, "expr", "name", EOptChain)
  elif kind == tag_expr_range() then
    let prefix = list_at(fields, "prefix", path, dec_expr)
    ERange(prefix, req_at(fields, "end", path, dec_expr))
  else
    dec_expr_node6(kind, fields, path)

fn dec_expr_node6(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_compose() then
    let dir = str_at(fields, "dir", path)
    let l = req_at(fields, "lhs", path, dec_expr)
    ECompose(dir, l, req_at(fields, "rhs", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_read_path() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "base", path, dec_expr)
    EReadPath(b, list_at(fields, "path", path, dec_pstep))
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown expression kind `{kind}`"
        },
      )

fn dec_arm(j : Json, path : String) : Arm ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Arm {
    pat = req_at(fields, "pat", path, dec_pat),
    guard = opt_at(fields, "guard", path, dec_expr),
    body = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr)
  }

fn dec_harm(j : Json, path : String) : HandlerArm ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  let kind = str_at(fields, "kind", path)
  if kind == tag_harm_return() then
    let b = str_at(fields, "binder", path)
    HReturn(b, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_harm_op() then
    let op = str_at(fields, "op", path)
    let ps = strs_at(fields, "params", path)
    let rk = str_at(fields, "resume", path)
    HOp(op, ps, rk, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_harm_once() then
    let op = str_at(fields, "op", path)
    let ps = strs_at(fields, "params", path)
    HOnce(op, ps, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_harm_val() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    HVal(n, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_harm_never() then
    let op = str_at(fields, "op", path)
    let ps = strs_at(fields, "params", path)
    HNever(op, ps, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown handler arm kind `{kind}`"
        },
      )

fn dec_catch(j : Json, path : String) : CatchArm ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  CatchArm {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    binders = strs_at(fields, "binders", path),
    body = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr),
    span = span_at(fields, path)
  }

fn dec_qual(j : Json, path : String) : Qual ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  let kind = str_at(fields, "kind", path)
  if kind == tag_qual_guard() then
    QGuard(req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_qual_bind() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    QBind(n, req_at(fields, "value", path, dec_expr))
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown qualifier kind `{kind}`"
        },
      )

fn dec_pstep(j : Json, path : String) : PathStep ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  let kind = str_at(fields, "kind", path)
  if kind == tag_pstep_field() then
    PSField(str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_pstep_each() then
    PSEach
  elif kind == tag_pstep_case() then
    PSCase(str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_pstep_index() then
    PSIndex(req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_pstep_where() then
    PSWhere(req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr))
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown path step kind `{kind}`"
        },
      )

fn dec_pop(j : Json, path : String) : PathOp ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  let kind = str_at(fields, "kind", path)
  if kind == tag_pop_set() then
    POSet(req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_pop_modify() then
    POModify(req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr))
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown path op kind `{kind}`"
        },
      )

fn dec_pupdate(j : Json, path : String) : PathUpdate ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  PathUpdate {
    path = list_at(fields, "path", path, dec_pstep),
    op = req_at(fields, "op", path, dec_pop)
  }

fn dec_pat(j : Json, path : String) : Sp(Pat) ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  let kind = str_at(fields, "kind", path)
  let span = span_at(fields, path)
  Sp {
    node = dec_pat_node(kind, fields, path),
    span = span,
    synth = flagf(fields, "synth")
  }

fn dec_pfield(j : Json, path : String) : PatField ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  PatField {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    pat = req_at(fields, "pat", path, dec_pat)
  }

fn dec_pat_node(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Pat ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_pat_wild() then
    PWild
  elif kind == tag_pat_var() then
    PVar(str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_pat_int() then
    PInt(str_at(fields, "value", path), dec_suffix(fields))
  elif kind == tag_pat_float() then
    PFloat(str_at(fields, "value", path))
  elif kind == tag_pat_char() then
    PChar(str_at(fields, "value", path))
  else
    dec_pat_node2(kind, fields, path)

fn dec_pat_node2(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Pat ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_pat_bool() then
    PBool(req_at(fields, "value", path, bool_of))
  elif kind == tag_pat_ctor() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    PCtor(n, list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_pat))
  elif kind == tag_pat_tuple() then
    PTuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_pat))
  elif kind == tag_pat_record() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    PRecord(
        n,
        list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_pfield),
        flagf(fields, "rest"),
      )
  elif kind == tag_pat_or() then
    POr(list_at(fields, "alts", path, dec_pat))
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown pattern kind `{kind}`"
        },
      )

fn dec_ctor(j : Json, path : String) : Ctor ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
  match jget(fields, "fields") of
    Some(_v) =>
      Ctor {
        name = n,
        shape = CRecord(list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_cfield))
      }
    None =>
      Ctor {
        name = n,
        shape = CPositional(list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_ty))
      }

fn dec_deriving(j : Json, path : String) : Deriving ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Deriving { name = str_at(fields, "name", path), span = span_at(fields, path) }

fn dec_method(j : Json, path : String) : Method ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Method {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    ty = req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty)
  }

fn dec_effop(j : Json, path : String) : EffOp ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  EffOp {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    params = list_at(fields, "params", path, dec_ty),
    ret = req_at(fields, "ret", path, dec_ty),
    grade = opt_at(fields, "grade", path, str_of)
  }

fn dec_rungfield(j : Json, path : String) : RungField ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  RungField {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    ty = req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty),
    dflt = opt_at(fields, "default", path, dec_expr)
  }

fn dec_rung(j : Json, path : String) : Rung ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Rung {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    base = opt_at(fields, "base", path, str_of),
    fields = list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_rungfield),
    frozen = opt_at(fields, "frozen", path, str_of),
    span = span_at(fields, path)
  }

fn dec_converter(j : Json, path : String) : Converter ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Converter {
    dir = str_at(fields, "dir", path),
    from = str_at(fields, "from", path),
    to = str_at(fields, "to", path),
    base = req_at(fields, "base", path, dec_expr),
    overrides = list_at(fields, "overrides", path, dec_named),
    drop_loss = strs_at(fields, "drop_loss", path),
    span = span_at(fields, path)
  }

fn dec_mdir(j : Json, path : String) : MigrationDir ! {Decode} =
  match j of
    JStr(s) =>
      if s == tag_migration_auto() then
        DAuto
      else
        fail_decode(
            CodecError {
              path = path,
              reason = "unknown migration direction `{s}`"
            },
          )
    _ => DExpr(dec_expr(j, path))

fn dec_mroute(j : Json, path : String) : MigrationRoute ! {Decode} =
  match j of
    JStr(s) =>
      if s == tag_migration_auto() then
        MAuto
      else
        fail_decode(
            CodecError {
              path = path,
              reason = "unknown migration route `{s}`"
            },
          )
    JObj(fields) =>
      let up = req_at(fields, "upgrade", path, dec_mdir)
      MVersion(up, req_at(fields, "downgrade", path, dec_mdir))
    _ =>
      fail_decode(
          CodecError { path = path, reason = "expected a migration route" },
        )

fn dec_migration(j : Json, path : String) : Migration ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Migration {
    from = str_at(fields, "from", path),
    to = str_at(fields, "to", path),
    route = req_at(fields, "route", path, dec_mroute),
    span = span_at(fields, path)
  }

fn dec_decl_fields(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Decl ! {Decode} =
  Decl {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    params = list_at(fields, "params", path, dec_param),
    ret = opt_at(fields, "ret", path, dec_ty),
    eff = opt_at(fields, "effects", path, dec_row),
    constraints = list_at(fields, "constraints", path, dec_constraint),
    body = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr),
    wheres = list_at(fields, "wheres", path, dec_named),
    reqs = list_at(fields, "requires", path, dec_expr),
    enss = list_at(fields, "ensures", path, dec_ensure),
    measure = opt_at(fields, "decreases", path, dec_expr),
    is_test = flagf(fields, "test"),
    totality = opt_at(fields, "total", path, str_of),
    fip_word = opt_at(fields, "fip", path, str_of),
    is_replayable = flagf(fields, "replayable"),
    is_no_alloc = flagf(fields, "no_alloc"),
    span = span_at(fields, path)
  }

fn dec_decl(j : Json, path : String) : Decl ! {Decode} =
  dec_decl_fields(obj_at(j, path), path)

fn dec_item(j : Json, path : String) : Item ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  dec_item_kind(str_at(fields, "kind", path), fields, path)

fn dec_item_kind(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Item ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_item_import() then
    dec_import(fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_data() || kind == tag_item_newtype() then
    dec_data(kind, fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_effect() then
    dec_effect(fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_error() then
    dec_error(fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_effect_alias() then
    dec_effalias(fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_type_synonym() then
    dec_synonym(fields, path)
  else
    dec_item_kind2(kind, fields, path)

fn dec_item_kind2(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Item ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_item_class() then
    dec_class(fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_instance() then
    dec_instance(fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_canonical() then
    dec_canonical(fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_pattern() then
    dec_pattern(fields, path)
  elif kind == tag_item_stable() then
    dec_stable(fields, path)
  elif (kind == tag_item_fn()
      || kind == tag_item_const()
      || kind == tag_item_logic_fn()) then
    dec_fndecl(kind, fields, path)
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown item kind `{kind}`"
        },
      )

fn dec_import(fields : List((String, Json)), path : String) : Item ! {Decode} =
  IImport {
    path = req_at(fields, "path", path, strs_of),
    mod_alias = opt_at(fields, "alias", path, str_of),
    names = opt_at(fields, "names", path, strs_of),
    glob = flagf(fields, "glob"),
    reexport = flagf(fields, "reexport"),
    span = span_at(fields, path)
  }

fn dec_data(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Item ! {Decode} =
  let name = str_at(fields, "name", path)
  let params = strs_at(fields, "params", path)
  let pks = list_at(fields, "param_kinds", path, dec_kind)
  let ctors = list_at(fields, "ctors", path, dec_ctor)
  let derivs = list_at(fields, "deriving", path, dec_deriving)
  let vis = opt_at(fields, "vis", path, str_of)
  let dep = opt_at(fields, "deprecated", path, str_of)
  IData {
    nt = kind == tag_item_newtype(),
    name = name,
    params = params,
    param_kinds = pks,
    ctors = ctors,
    derivs = derivs,
    span = span_at(fields, path),
    vis = vis,
    dep = dep
  }

fn dec_effect(fields : List((String, Json)), path : String) : Item ! {Decode} =
  let name = str_at(fields, "name", path)
  let params = strs_at(fields, "params", path)
  let ops = list_at(fields, "ops", path, dec_effop)
  let vis = opt_at(fields, "vis", path, str_of)
  let dep = opt_at(fields, "deprecated", path, str_of)
  IEffect {
    name = name,
    params = params,
    ops = ops,
    span = span_at(fields, path),
    vis = vis,
    dep = dep
  }

fn dec_error(fields : List((String, Json)), path : String) : Item ! {Decode} =
  let name = str_at(fields, "name", path)
  let params = list_at(fields, "params", path, dec_ty)
  let vis = opt_at(fields, "vis", path, str_of)
  let dep = opt_at(fields, "deprecated", path, str_of)
  IError {
    name = name,
    arg_types = params,
    span = span_at(fields, path),
    vis = vis,
    dep = dep
  }

fn dec_effalias(
  fields : List((String, Json)),

) : Item ! {Decode} =

fn dec_synonym(fields : List((String, Json)), path : String) : Item ! {Decode} =
  let name = str_at(fields, "name", path)

fn dec_class(fields : List((String, Json)), path : String) : Item ! {Decode} =

fn dec_instance(
  fields : List((String, Json)),

) : Item ! {Decode} =
  IInstance {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    cls = str_at(fields, "class", path),
    head = req_at(fields, "head", path, dec_ty),
    context = list_at(fields, "context", path, dec_constraint),

fn dec_canonical(
  fields : List((String, Json)),

) : Item ! {Decode} =
  ICanonical {

fn dec_pattern(fields : List((String, Json)), path : String) : Item ! {Decode} =

fn dec_fndecl(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Item ! {Decode} =
  IDecl {
    decl = dec_decl_fields(fields, path),
    declkind = kind,

-- | Decode a `prism-surface-syntax-v1` document from its exact bytes. A wrong
-- or missing schema tag, malformed JSON, missing field, or invalid span is a
-- structured `CodecError`, never a partial document.
pub fn decode_surface(text : String) : Result(SurfaceDoc, CodecError) =
  run_decode(\() -> decode_surface_doc(text))

fn decode_surface_doc(text : String) : SurfaceDoc ! {Decode} =
  let j = ok_or_bail(decode_or_codec_error(text))
  let fields = obj_at(j, "$")
  SurfaceDoc {
    schema = schema_at(fields, surface_schema()),
    compiler = str_at(fields, "compiler", "$"),
    source = source_at(fields),
    items = req_arr(fields, "items", "$", dec_item)
  }

-- | Decode a `prism-syntax-diagnostics-v1` document. Total: every malformed
-- input lands on a `CodecError` naming the JSON path that refused.
pub fn decode_diagnostics(text : String) : Result(DiagnosticsDoc, CodecError) =
  run_decode(\() -> decode_diagnostics_doc(text))

fn decode_diagnostics_doc(text : String) : DiagnosticsDoc ! {Decode} =
  let j = ok_or_bail(decode_or_codec_error(text))
  let fields = obj_at(j, "$")
  DiagnosticsDoc {
    schema = schema_at(fields, diagnostics_schema()),
    compiler = str_at(fields, "compiler", "$"),
    source = source_at(fields),
    diagnostics = req_arr(fields, "diagnostics", "$", diag_of)
  }

fn phase_of(s : String, path : String) : DiagPhase ! {Decode} =
  if s == tag_phase_lex() then
    DPLex
  elif s == tag_phase_parse() then
    DPParse
  else
    fail_decode(CodecError { path = path, reason = "unknown phase `{s}`" })

fn phase_name(p : DiagPhase) : String =
  match p of
    DPLex => tag_phase_lex()
    DPParse => tag_phase_parse()

fn diag_of(j : Json, path : String) : Diagnostic ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  Diagnostic {
    code = str_at(fields, "code", path),
    phase = phase_of(str_at(fields, "phase", path), "{path}.phase"),
    span = span_at(fields, path),
    message = str_at(fields, "message", path),
    expected = req_arr(fields, "expected", path, str_of),
    related = req_arr(fields, "related", path, span_of)
  }

fn diag_json(d : Diagnostic) : Json =
  JObj([
      ("code", JStr(d.code)),
      ("phase", JStr(phase_name(d.phase))),
      ("span", span_json(d.span)),
      ("message", JStr(d.message)),
      ("expected", JArr(map(JStr, d.expected))),
      ("related", JArr(map(span_json, d.related))),
    ])

-- | Encode a diagnostics document to the canonical artifact bytes, the exact
-- inverse of `decode_diagnostics` on every Rust-produced document.
pub fn encode_diagnostics(d : DiagnosticsDoc) : String =
  render(
      JObj([
          ("schema", JStr(d.schema)),
          ("compiler", JStr(d.compiler)),
          (
              "source",
              JObj([
                  ("digest", JStr(d.source.digest)),
                  ("text", JStr(d.source.text)),
                ]),
            ),
          ("diagnostics", JArr(map(diag_json, d.diagnostics))),
        ]),
      0,
    )

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The idiomatic decoder style: a value-carrying `Decode` effect.
--
-- `fail_decode(err)` abandons the current decode with its `CodecError`, and
-- `run_decode` turns a whole decoding computation into a `Result`. Decoders
-- written against it read as straight-line code (`let name = str_at(fields,
-- "name", path)`) instead of a right-nested tower of `match ... Err(e) =>
-- Err(e)` arms. This is the effect-native way to thread short-circuiting
-- errors in Prism; new decoders should use it.

pub effect Decode
  never fail_decode(CodecError) : a

-- | Run a decoding computation, turning a `fail_decode` into `Err` and a
-- completed decode into `Ok`.
pub fn run_decode(action : () -> a ! {Decode | r}) : Result(a, CodecError) =
  handle action() with
    never fail_decode(err) => Err(err)
    return value => Ok(value)

-- | Bail out of the current decode by lifting a `Result`'s `Err`, returning the
-- `Ok` value directly. The bridge from the `Result`-returning primitives to the
-- effectful style.
fn ok_or_bail(r : Result(a, CodecError)) : a ! {Decode} =
  match r of
    Ok(value) => value
    Err(err) => fail_decode(err)

-- The effectful field/shape accessors: each lifts its `Result`-returning
-- primitive through `ok_or_bail`, so a decoder body never matches on failure.
fn obj_at(j : Json, path : String) : List((String, Json)) ! {Decode} =
  ok_or_bail(as_obj(j, path))

fn arr_at(j : Json, path : String) : List(Json) ! {Decode} =
  ok_or_bail(as_arr(j, path))

fn str_at(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String
) : String ! {Decode} =
  str_of(need_at(fields, key, path), "{path}.{key}")

fn int_at(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String
) : Int ! {Decode} =
  int_of(need_at(fields, key, path), "{path}.{key}")

fn need_at(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String
) : Json ! {Decode} =
  ok_or_bail(need(fields, key, path))

fn span_at(fields : List((String, Json)), path : String) : Span ! {Decode} =
  span_of(need_at(fields, "span", path), "{path}.span")

fn schema_at(fields : List((String, Json)), want : String) : String ! {Decode} =
  let schema = str_at(fields, "schema", "$")
  if schema == want then
    schema
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "$.schema",
          reason = "unsupported schema `{schema}`"
        },
      )

fn source_at(fields : List((String, Json))) : SourceFile ! {Decode} =
  source_of(need_at(fields, "source", "$"), "$.source")

-- The effectful leaf decoders, each lifting a `Result`-returning primitive
-- through `ok_or_bail` so a decoder body reads as straight-line code.
fn str_of(j : Json, path : String) : String ! {Decode} =
  ok_or_bail(as_str(j, path))

fn int_of(j : Json, path : String) : Int ! {Decode} =
  ok_or_bail(as_int(j, path))

fn bool_of(j : Json, path : String) : Bool ! {Decode} =
  ok_or_bail(as_bool(j, path))

-- A `[lo, hi]` span array, checked well formed.
fn span_of(j : Json, path : String) : Span ! {Decode} =
  match j of
    JArr(Cons(jlo, Cons(jhi, Nil))) =>
      let s =
        Span { lo = int_of(jlo, "{path}[0]"), hi = int_of(jhi, "{path}[1]") }
      if span_valid(s) then
        s
      else
        fail_decode(
            CodecError { path = path, reason = "inverted or negative span" },
          )
    _ =>
      fail_decode(
          CodecError {
            path = path,
            reason = "expected a two-element span array"
          },
        )

fn source_of(j : Json, path : String) : SourceFile ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  SourceFile {
    digest = str_at(fields, "digest", path),
    text = str_at(fields, "text", path)
  }

fn strs_of(j : Json, path : String) : List(String) ! {Decode} =
  each_of(arr_at(j, path), path, str_of)

-- Map an effectful decoder over a JSON array, tagging each element's path with
-- its index. The effectful counterpart of the old `decode_each`.
fn each_of(
  items : List(Json),
  path : String,
  f : (Json, String) -> a ! {Decode}
) : List(a) ! {Decode} =
  each_of_go(items, path, 0, f)

fn each_of_go(
  items : List(Json),
  path : String,
  i : Int,
  f : (Json, String) -> a ! {Decode}
) : List(a) ! {Decode} =
  match items of
    Nil => []
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let v = f(x, "{path}[{i}]")
      Cons(v, each_of_go(rest, path, i + 1, f))

-- Required field, then decode with the effectful `f`. Mirrors `req`.
fn req_at(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String,
  f : (Json, String) -> a ! {Decode}
) : a ! {Decode} =
  f(need_at(fields, key, path), "{path}.{key}")

-- Optional field: `None` when absent, else decoded with `f`. Mirrors `opt`.
fn opt_at(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String,
  f : (Json, String) -> a ! {Decode}
) : Option(a) ! {Decode} =
  match jget(fields, key) of
    None => None
    Some(v) => Some(f(v, "{path}.{key}"))

-- List field: absent decodes to the empty list. Mirrors `listf`.
fn list_at(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String,
  f : (Json, String) -> a ! {Decode}
) : List(a) ! {Decode} =
  match jget(fields, key) of
    None => []
    Some(v) => each_of(arr_at(v, "{path}.{key}"), "{path}.{key}", f)

-- Required array field, then decode each element. Mirrors `token_stream`.
fn req_arr(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String,
  f : (Json, String) -> a ! {Decode}
) : List(a) ! {Decode} =
  each_of(arr_at(need_at(fields, key, path), "{path}.{key}"), "{path}.{key}", f)

-- String-list field: absent decodes to the empty list. Mirrors `strsf`.
fn strs_at(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  key : String,
  path : String
) : List(String) ! {Decode} =
  match jget(fields, key) of
    None => []
    Some(v) => strs_of(v, "{path}.{key}")

-- | Decode a `prism-resolved-syntax-v1` document. Total: every malformed input
-- lands on a `CodecError` naming the JSON path that refused. The node tree
-- decodes recursively; a child list is bounded by the input's own nesting.
pub fn decode_resolved(text : String) : Result(ResolvedDoc, CodecError) =
  run_decode(\() -> decode_resolved_doc(text))

fn decode_resolved_doc(text : String) : ResolvedDoc ! {Decode} =
  let j = ok_or_bail(decode_or_codec_error(text))
  let fields = obj_at(j, "$")
  let doc = ResolvedDoc {
    schema = schema_at(fields, resolved_schema()),
    compiler = str_at(fields, "compiler", "$"),
    source = source_at(fields),
    functions = map(
        \(jf) -> rfunction_of(jf, "$.functions"),
        arr_at(need_at(fields, "functions", "$"), "$.functions"),
      )
  }
  validate_resolved(doc)

-- Reject a resolved document whose node identities or spans are unusable: a
-- node id repeated anywhere in the document (the id is the `tc-facts` join key,
-- so a collision aliases two nodes to one fact), or a span reaching past the
-- embedded source. The per-node inverted-or-negative-span refusal already fired
-- while decoding each node; this is the whole-document check a traversing
-- consumer relies on, so a hostile artifact fails closed instead of decoding
-- into an ambiguous tree.
fn validate_resolved(d : ResolvedDoc) : ResolvedDoc ! {Decode} =
  let nodes = concat_map(\(f) -> rnode_universe(f.body), d.functions)
  check_unique_ids(sort(map(\(n) -> n.id, nodes)))
  check_span_ends(
      map(\(n) -> n.span, nodes),
      str_len(d.source.text),
      "$.functions",
    )
  d

-- No node id occurs twice, checked over the ascending id list so a collision is
-- an adjacent pair.
fn check_unique_ids(ids : List(Int)) : Unit ! {Decode} =
  match ids of
    Cons(a, Cons(b, rest)) =>
      if a == b then
        fail_decode(
            CodecError {
              path = "$.functions",
              reason = "duplicate node id {a}"
            },
          )
      else
        check_unique_ids(Cons(b, rest))
    _ => ()

-- Every span ends within the embedded source text: a span reaching past it
-- indexes bytes the document does not carry, so the whole document is refused
-- rather than decoded into offsets a consumer cannot slice. `path` names the
-- stream or section the offending span came from.
fn check_span_ends(
  spans : List(Span),
  len : Int,
  path : String
) : Unit ! {Decode} =
  match spans of
    Nil => ()
    Cons(s, rest) =>
      if s.hi <= len then
        check_span_ends(rest, len, path)
      else
        fail_decode(
            CodecError {
              path = path,
              reason = "span [{s.lo}, {s.hi}) past source length {len}"
            },
          )

fn decode_or_codec_error(text : String) : Result(Json, CodecError) =
  match decode(text) of
    Ok(j) => Ok(j)
    Err(e) => Err(CodecError { path = "$", reason = json_error_message(e) })

fn rfunction_of(j : Json, path : String) : RFunction ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  RFunction {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    params = map(
        \(jp) -> rparam_of(jp, "{path}.params"),
        arr_at(need_at(fields, "params", path), "{path}.params"),
      ),
    body = rnode_of(need_at(fields, "body", path), "{path}.body")
  }

fn rparam_of(j : Json, path : String) : RParam ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  RParam {
    name = str_at(fields, "name", path),
    is_borrow = flagf(fields, "borrow")
  }

fn rnode_of(j : Json, path : String) : RNode ! {Decode} =
  let fields = obj_at(j, path)
  RNode {
    id = int_at(fields, "id", path),
    kind = str_at(fields, "kind", path),
    span = span_at(fields, path),
    children = rnode_children_of(fields, path)
  }

-- An absent `children` key is the empty list, matching the exporter, which
-- drops an empty child array.
fn rnode_children_of(
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : List(RNode) ! {Decode} =
  match jget(fields, "children") of
    None => []
    Some(jc) =>
      map(
          \(jn) -> rnode_of(jn, "{path}.children"),
          arr_at(jc, "{path}.children"),
        )

fn rnode_json(n : RNode) : Json =
  let base =
    [("id", JInt(n.id)), ("kind", JStr(n.kind)), ("span", span_json(n.span))]
  match n.children of
    Nil => JObj(base)
    Cons(_, _) =>
      JObj(append(base, [("children", JArr(map(rnode_json, n.children)))]))

fn rfunction_json(f : RFunction) : Json =
  JObj([
      ("name", JStr(f.name)),
      ("params", JArr(map(rparam_json, f.params))),
      ("body", rnode_json(f.body)),
    ])

-- The exporter writes both keys on every parameter, so `borrow` is emitted
-- unconditionally here rather than omitted when false.
fn rparam_json(p : RParam) : Json =
  JObj([("name", JStr(p.name)), ("borrow", JBool(p.is_borrow))])

pub fn encode_resolved(d : ResolvedDoc) : String =
  render(
      JObj([
          ("schema", JStr(d.schema)),
          ("compiler", JStr(d.compiler)),
          (
              "source",
              JObj([
                  ("digest", JStr(d.source.digest)),
                  ("text", JStr(d.source.text)),
                ]),
            ),
          ("functions", JArr(map(rfunction_json, d.functions))),
        ]),
      0,
    )

The mechanical half of recursive descent: a token cursor with peek, advance, and expect, and a Pratt driver over a binding-power table.

Deliberately not a combinator library. There is no alternation operator, no backtracking engine, no grammar vocabulary; a caller writes the grammar by hand, in ordinary functions, and hands this module the two things a hand-written parser gets subtly wrong. The first is span arithmetic: joining two spans, covering a consumed run, and pointing a caret at a position where nothing was read. The second is expectation merging: unmet expectations join a set held at the furthest token the cursor ever reached, so a refusal names every alternative tried at the position the parse died at rather than only the last one attempted. Rewinding is where that record is classically lost, so rewinding is a named operation (`cursor_restore`) that returns the position and keeps the record.

Expectations are token wire names, the vocabulary of `Syntax.Token`, and a refusal renders as a `Syntax.Diagnostic` under the compiler's own parse codes. A parser built on this cursor therefore reports through the same document every other syntax fault does, with no error type of its own.
