modules.source:
-- | Effects, classes, instances, canonical designations, and the shared
-- `alias` declaration family for the Prism-owned parser.
--
-- These declarations share two pieces of grammar that do not belong in the
-- top-level dispatcher: `given` constraints and member lists.  Effect, class,
-- and instance members are layout-delimited; a real brace is recognized as the
-- retired form and receives the same directed rewrite as the bootstrap parser.
-- Instance methods are parsed here as complete function declarations so this
-- module does not depend on private helpers in `Syntax.Parse.Decl`.

import Data.List (..)

import Syntax.Source (..)

import Syntax.Token (..)

import Syntax.Ast (..)

import Syntax.Cursor (..)

import Syntax.Parse.Support (..)

import Syntax.Parse.Type (..)

import Syntax.Parse.Pattern (..)

import Syntax.Parse.Expr (..)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Shared token and layout helpers
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn at_sep(c : Cursor) : Bool = at_fixed(c, ",") || at_kind(c, TVSemi)

fn skip_sep(c : Cursor) : Cursor =
  if at_sep(c) then
    cursor_advance(c)
  else
    c

fn expect_layout_open(c : Cursor, family : String) : Parsed(Token) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    let member =
      if family == "effect" then
        "operation"
      elif family == "class" then
        "method"
      else
        "member"
    PFault(
        refuse(
            cursor_span(c),
            "{family} bodies use layout: remove the braces and put each {member} on its own indented line",
          ),
      )
  else
    take_kind(c, TVOpen)

fn take_uid(c : Cursor) : Parsed(String) = take_word(c, TUid)

fn take_ident(c : Cursor) : Parsed(String) = take_word(c, TIdent)

-- An unkinded type-parameter list, used by effects and aliases.  A trailing
-- comma is accepted because the bootstrap grammar's `Comma` production does.
fn parse_ty_params(c : Cursor) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "(")) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    parse_ty_params_go(cursor_advance(c), Nil)

fn parse_ty_params_go(c : Cursor, rev : List(String)) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match take_ident(c) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_ty_params_go(cursor_advance(c1), Cons(name, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, ")") then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(name, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, ")"))

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Given constraints
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- | Parse an optional `given Class(Type), ...` clause.  This is public because
-- ordinary function declarations and the other declaration-family modules use
-- exactly the same qualifier.
pub fn parse_given_clause(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(Constraint)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "given")) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    match parse_constraint(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(first, c1) => parse_given_more(c1, depth, [first])

fn parse_given_more(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  acc : List(Constraint)
) : Parsed(List(Constraint)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ",") then
    match parse_constraint(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(next, c1) => parse_given_more(c1, depth, append(acc, [next]))
  else
    PTook(acc, c)

fn parse_constraint(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Constraint) =
  let saved = c
  match take_uid(c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(cls, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "(") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_type(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(ty, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, ")") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  PTook(
                      Constraint {
                        cls = cls,
                        ty = ty,
                        span = cursor_since(saved, c4)
                      },
                      c4,
                    )

fn constraint_names(cs : List(Constraint)) : List(String) =
  match cs of
    Nil => Nil
    Cons(c, rest) => Cons(c.cls, constraint_names(rest))

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Effect declarations
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- | Parse an `effect` item. `c` points at the keyword, and `vis` is the
-- already-decoded visibility prefix (`None`, `Some("pub")`, or
-- `Some("opaque")`).
pub fn parse_effect_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "effect") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_uid(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match parse_ty_params(c2) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(params, c3) =>
              match expect_layout_open(c3, "effect") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_effect_ops(c4, depth, Nil) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(ops, c5) =>
                      match take_kind(c5, TVClose) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(_, c6) =>
                          PTook(
                              IEffect {
                                name = name,
                                params = params,
                                ops = ops,
                                span = cursor_since(saved, c6),
                                vis = vis,
                                dep = None
                              },
                              c6,
                            )

fn parse_effect_ops(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(EffOp)
) : Parsed(List(EffOp)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  elif at_sep(c) then
    parse_effect_ops(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match parse_effect_op(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(op, c1) =>
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_span(c),
                  "effect operation parser made no progress",
                ),
            )
        else
          parse_effect_ops(skip_sep(c1), depth, Cons(op, rev))

fn parse_effect_op(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(EffOp) =
  let first = peek_word(c)
  let graded = at_kind(c, TIdent) && at_kind(cursor_advance(c), TIdent)
  if graded then
    if first == "never" then
      parse_effect_op_named(cursor_advance(c), depth, Some("never"))
    elif first == "once" then
      parse_effect_op_named(cursor_advance(c), depth, Some("once"))
    elif first == "many" then
      parse_effect_op_named(cursor_advance(c), depth, None)
    else
      PFault(
          refuse(
              cursor_span(c),
              "`{first}` is not a grade: an operation grade is `never`, `once`, or `many`, or omit it for `many`",
            ),
        )
  else
    parse_effect_op_named(c, depth, None)

fn parse_effect_op_named(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  grade : Option(String)
) : Parsed(EffOp) =
  match take_ident(c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "(") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_effect_params(c2, depth, Nil) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(params, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, ":") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_type(c4, depth) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(ret, c5) =>
                      PTook(
                          EffOp {
                            name = name,
                            params = params,
                            ret = ret,
                            grade = grade
                          },
                          c5,
                        )

fn parse_effect_params(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Ty)
) : Parsed(List(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match parse_effect_param(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(ty, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_effect_params(cursor_advance(c1), depth, Cons(ty, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, ")") then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(ty, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, ")"))

fn parse_effect_param(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Ty) =
  if at_kind(c, TIdent) && at_fixed(cursor_advance(c), ":") then
    parse_type(cursor_advance(cursor_advance(c)), depth)
  else
    parse_type(c, depth)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Alias declarations
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- | Parse the shared `alias` family. A brace RHS constructs an effect alias;
-- every other RHS is a type synonym. The optional parameter list is retained
-- only for a synonym, matching the bootstrap AST.
pub fn parse_alias_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "alias") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_uid(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match parse_ty_params(c2) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(params, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, "=") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  if at_fixed(c4, "\{") then
                    parse_effect_alias_rhs(saved, name, c4, depth, vis)
                  else
                    match parse_type(c4, depth) of
                      PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(ty, c5) =>
                        PTook(
                            ISynonym {
                              name = name,
                              params = params,
                              ty = ty,
                              span = cursor_since(saved, c5),
                              vis = vis,
                              dep = None
                            },
                            c5,
                          )

fn parse_effect_alias_rhs(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match parse_alias_labels(cursor_advance(c), depth, Nil) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(labels, c1) =>
      PTook(
          IEffAlias {
            name = name,
            labels = labels,
            span = cursor_since(saved, c1),
            vis = vis,
            dep = None
          },
          c1,
        )

fn parse_alias_labels(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(EffLabel)
) : Parsed(List(EffLabel)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match parse_eff_label(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(label, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_alias_labels(cursor_advance(c1), depth, Cons(label, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, "\}") then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(label, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, "\}"))

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Classes
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- | Parse a class declaration, including marker classes without a body and
-- layout bodies containing method signatures.
pub fn parse_class_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "class") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_uid(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "(") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match take_ident(c3) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(param, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, ")") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match parse_given_clause(c5, depth) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(supers, c6) =>
                          parse_class_body(
                              saved,
                              name,
                              param,
                              constraint_names(supers),
                              c6,
                              depth,
                              vis,
                            )

fn parse_class_body(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  param : String,
  supers : List(String),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    match expect_layout_open(c, "class") of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) => PStuck(c1)
  elif not(at_kind(c, TVOpen)) then
    PTook(
        IClass {
          name = name,
          param = param,
          supers = supers,
          methods = Nil,
          span = cursor_since(saved, c),
          vis = vis,
          dep = None
        },
        c,
      )
  else
    match take_kind(c, TVOpen) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) =>
        match parse_class_methods(c1, depth, Nil) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(methods, c2) =>
            match take_kind(c2, TVClose) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                PTook(
                    IClass {
                      name = name,
                      param = param,
                      supers = supers,
                      methods = methods,
                      span = cursor_since(saved, c3),
                      vis = vis,
                      dep = None
                    },
                    c3,
                  )

fn parse_class_methods(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Method)
) : Parsed(List(Method)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  elif at_sep(c) then
    parse_class_methods(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match take_ident(c) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, ":") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_type(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(ty, c3) =>
                parse_class_methods(
                    skip_sep(c3),
                    depth,
                    Cons(Method { name = name, ty = ty }, rev),
                  )

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Instances and instance methods
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- | Parse an instance declaration, including marker instances and layout
-- bodies of complete function declarations. Visibility is accepted for the
-- uniform dispatcher API; the phase-independent instance AST has no visibility
-- field, matching the bootstrap export.
pub fn parse_instance_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "instance") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_ident(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, ":") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match take_uid(c3) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(cls, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "(") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match parse_type(c5, depth) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(head, c6) =>
                          match take_fixed(c6, ")") of
                            PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PTook(_, c7) =>
                              match parse_given_clause(c7, depth) of
                                PStuck(c8) => PStuck(c8)
                                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                PTook(context, c8) =>
                                  parse_instance_body(
                                      saved,
                                      name,
                                      cls,
                                      head,
                                      context,
                                      c8,
                                      depth,
                                      vis,
                                    )

fn parse_instance_body(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  cls : String,
  head : Ty,
  context : List(Constraint),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  _vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    match expect_layout_open(c, "instance") of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) => PStuck(c1)
  elif not(at_kind(c, TVOpen)) then
    PTook(
        IInstance {
          name = name,
          cls = cls,
          head = head,
          context = context,
          decls = Nil,
          span = cursor_since(saved, c)
        },
        c,
      )
  else
    match take_kind(c, TVOpen) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) =>
        match parse_instance_methods(c1, depth, Nil) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(methods, c2) =>
            match take_kind(c2, TVClose) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                PTook(
                    IInstance {
                      name = name,
                      cls = cls,
                      head = head,
                      context = context,
                      decls = methods,
                      span = cursor_since(saved, c3)
                    },
                    c3,
                  )

fn parse_instance_methods(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Decl)
) : Parsed(List(Decl)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  elif at_sep(c) then
    parse_instance_methods(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match parse_method_decl(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(method, c1) =>
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PFault(
              refuse(cursor_span(c), "instance method parser made no progress"),
            )
        else
          parse_instance_methods(skip_sep(c1), depth, Cons(method, rev))

-- Leading contextual modifiers are consumed only in their canonical order:
-- `test`, then `total` or `assume total`.
fn parse_method_mods(c : Cursor) : Parsed((Bool, Option(String), Cursor)) =
  let is_test = peek_word(c) == "test"
  let c1 =
    if is_test then
      cursor_advance(c)
    else
      c
  if peek_word(c1) == "assume" then
    let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
    if peek_word(c2) == "total" then
      PTook((is_test, Some("assume"), cursor_advance(c2)), c)
    else
      PFault(
          refuse(
              cursor_span(c1),
              "`assume` is not a declaration modifier by itself; write `assume total`",
            ),
        )
  elif peek_word(c1) == "total" then
    PTook((is_test, Some("prove"), cursor_advance(c1)), c)
  else
    PTook((is_test, None, c1), c)

fn parse_method_decl(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Decl) =
  let saved = c
  match parse_method_mods(c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(mods, _) =>
      match mods of
        (is_test, totality, c1) =>
          let is_replayable = at_fixed(c1, "replayable")
          let c2 =
            if is_replayable then
              cursor_advance(c1)
            else
              c1
          let fip_word =
            if at_fixed(c2, "fip") then
              Some("fip")
            elif at_fixed(c2, "fbip") then
              Some("fbip")
            else
              None
          let c3 =
            match fip_word of
              None => c2
              Some(_) => cursor_advance(c2)
          match take_fixed(c3, "fn") of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c4) =>
              match take_ident(c4) of
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(name, c5) =>
                  match take_fixed(c5, "(") of
                    PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c6) =>
                      match parse_method_params(c6, depth, 0, Nil) of
                        PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(params, c7) =>
                          parse_method_after_params(
                              saved,
                              name,
                              params,
                              c7,
                              depth,
                              is_test,
                              totality,
                              fip_word,
                              is_replayable,
                            )

fn parse_method_after_params(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  params : List(Param),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  is_test : Bool,
  totality : Option(String),
  fip_word : Option(String),
  is_replayable : Bool
) : Parsed(Decl) =
  match parse_return_ann(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(ann, c1) =>
      match ann of
        (ret0, eff, no_alloc) =>
          match parse_given_clause(c1, depth) of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(constraints, c2) =>
              match parse_requires(c2, depth, Nil) of
                PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(reqs, c3) =>
                  match parse_ensures(c3, depth, Nil) of
                    PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(enss, c4) =>
                      match parse_decreases(c4, depth) of
                        PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(measure, c5) =>
                          match take_fixed(c5, "=") of
                            PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PTook(_, c6) =>
                              match parse_expr_or_block(c6, depth) of
                                PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                PTook(body, c7) =>
                                  match parse_where_block(c7, depth) of
                                    PStuck(c8) => PStuck(c8)
                                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                    PTook(wheres, c8) =>
                                      PTook(
                                          Decl {
                                            name = name,
                                            params = params,
                                            ret = ret0,
                                            eff = eff,
                                            constraints = constraints,
                                            body = body,
                                            wheres = wheres,
                                            reqs = reqs,
                                            enss = enss,
                                            measure = measure,
                                            is_test = is_test,
                                            totality = totality,
                                            fip_word = fip_word,
                                            is_replayable = is_replayable,
                                            is_no_alloc = no_alloc,
                                            span = cursor_since(saved, c8)
                                          },
                                          c8,
                                        )

fn parse_method_params(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  index : Int,
  rev : List(Param)
) : Parsed(List(Param)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    let borrowed = at_fixed(c, "borrow")
    let c0 =
      if borrowed then
        cursor_advance(c)
      else
        c
    match parse_pattern(c0, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(pat, c1) =>
        match parse_optional_type(c1, depth) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(ty, c2) =>
            match parse_optional_default(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(dflt, c3) =>
                let param =
                  match pat.node of
                    PVar(n) =>
                      Param {
                        name = n,
                        pat = None,
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                    PWild =>
                      Param {
                        name = "_",
                        pat = None,
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                    _ =>
                      Param {
                        name = "arg@{index}",
                        pat = Some(pat),
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                if at_fixed(c3, ",") then
                  parse_method_params(
                      cursor_advance(c3),
                      depth,
                      index + 1,
                      Cons(param, rev),
                    )
                elif at_fixed(c3, ")") then
                  PTook(reverse(Cons(param, rev)), cursor_advance(c3))
                else
                  PStuck(cursor_note_name(c3, ")"))

fn parse_optional_type(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":") then
    match parse_type(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(ty, c1) => PTook(Some(ty), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

fn parse_optional_default(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Sp(Expr))) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":=") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => PTook(Some(e), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Function return annotations
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The result type and its declaration effect have a shared `!` token.  Parse
-- the type through a capped view of the cursor, then attach the row to a
-- function result (including beneath `forall`) or retain it as the
-- declaration's ambient effect for every other result.
fn parse_return_ann(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed((Option(Ty), Option(Row), Bool)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, ":")) then
    PTook((None, None, false), c)
  elif at_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "!") then
    PFault(
        refuse(
            cursor_since(c, cursor_advance(cursor_advance(c))),
            "the effect row now follows the result type: write `: Result ! \{Effects\}` instead of `: !\{Effects\} Result`",
          ),
      )
  else
    let start = cursor_advance(c)
    match find_top_bang(start, start.pos, 0, 0, 0) of
      None =>
        match parse_type(start, depth) of
          PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(ty, c1) =>
            match lift_noalloc(ty) of
              (ret, no_alloc) => PTook((Some(ret), None, no_alloc), c1)
      Some(stop) =>
        let capped = cap_cursor(start, stop)
        match parse_type(capped, depth) of
          PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(ty, c1) =>
            if c1.pos /= stop then
              PStuck(cursor_note_name(full_cursor(start, c1), "type"))
            else
              let c2 = full_cursor(start, c1)
              match parse_effect_row(c2, depth) of
                PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(row, c3) =>
                  match attach_decl_effect(ty, row) of
                    (ret, eff) =>
                      match lift_noalloc(ret) of
                        (ret2, no_alloc) =>
                          PTook((Some(ret2), eff, no_alloc), c3)

fn lift_noalloc(ty : Ty) : (Ty, Bool) =
  match ty of
    TyUsage(inner, facts) =>
      match facts of
        Cons(fact, Nil) =>
          if fact == "noalloc" then
            (inner, true)
          else
            (ty, false)
        _ => (ty, false)
    _ => (ty, false)

fn attach_decl_effect(ty : Ty, row : Row) : (Ty, Option(Row)) =
  match ty of
    TyFun(params, _, ret) => (TyFun(params, row, ret), None)
    TyForall(vars, body) =>
      match attach_decl_effect(body, row) of
        (body2, None) => (TyForall(vars, body2), None)
        (_, Some(eff)) => (ty, Some(eff))
    _ => (ty, Some(row))

fn cap_cursor(c : Cursor, stop : Int) : Cursor =
  let toks = take(stop, array_to_list(c.toks))
  let end_span =
    match cursor_peek_at(c, stop - c.pos) of
      None => c.stop
      Some(t) => t.span.lo
  Cursor {
    toks = array_of_list(toks),
    pos = c.pos,
    stop = end_span,
    far = min(c.far, stop),
    wanted = c.wanted
  }

fn full_cursor(base : Cursor, parsed : Cursor) : Cursor =
  Cursor { ..base, pos = parsed.pos }

fn find_top_bang(
  c : Cursor,
  i : Int,
  parens : Int,
  brackets : Int,
  braces : Int
) : Option(Int) =
  if i >= cursor_count(c) then
    None
  else
    let t = array_get(c.toks, i)
    match t.kind of
      TVOpen =>
        if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      TVSemi =>
        if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      TVClose =>
        if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      TFixed(s) =>
        if s == "(" then
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens + 1, brackets, braces)
        elif s == ")" then
          if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
            None
          else
            find_top_bang(c, i + 1, max(0, parens - 1), brackets, braces)
        elif s == "[" then
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets + 1, braces)
        elif s == "]" then
          if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
            None
          else
            find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, max(0, brackets - 1), braces)
        elif s == "\{" then
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces + 1)
        elif s == "\}" then
          if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
            None
          else
            find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, max(0, braces - 1))
        elif s == "!" && parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
          Some(i)
        elif ((s == "="
            || s == ","
            || s == "given"
            || s == "requires"
            || s == "ensures"
            || s == "where")
            && parens == 0
            && brackets == 0
            && braces == 0) then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      TIdent =>
        if (token_text(t) == "decreases"
            && parens == 0
            && brackets == 0
            && braces == 0) then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      _ => find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Function clauses
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn parse_requires(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Sp(Expr))
) : Parsed(List(Sp(Expr))) =
  if at_fixed(c, "requires") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => parse_requires(c1, depth, Cons(e, rev))
  else
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)

fn parse_ensures(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Ensure)
) : Parsed(List(Ensure)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "ensures") then
    match take_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "|") of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) =>
        match take_ident(c1) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(binder, c2) =>
            match take_fixed(c2, "|") of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                match parse_expr(c3, depth) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(expr, c4) =>
                    parse_ensures(
                        c4,
                        depth,
                        Cons(Ensure { binder = binder, expr = expr }, rev),
                      )
  else
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)

fn parse_decreases(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Sp(Expr))) =
  if peek_word(c) == "decreases" then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => PTook(Some(e), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

fn parse_where_block(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "where")) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    match take_kind(cursor_advance(c), TVOpen) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) => parse_where_bindings(c1, depth, Nil)

fn parse_where_bindings(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(NamedExpr)
) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
    parse_where_bindings(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match take_ident(c) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c3) =>
                parse_where_bindings(
                    c3,
                    depth,
                    Cons(NamedExpr { name = name, value = value }, rev),
                  )

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Canonical instance designations
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- | Parse `canonical Class(Head) = instance_name`.
pub fn parse_canonical_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  _vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "canonical") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_uid(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(cls, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "(") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match parse_type(c3, depth) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(head, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, ")") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match take_fixed(c5, "=") of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(_, c6) =>
                          match take_ident(c6) of
                            PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PTook(name, c7) =>
                              PTook(
                                  ICanonical {
                                    cls = cls,
                                    head = head,
                                    name = name,
                                    span = cursor_since(saved, c7)
                                  },
                                  c7,
                                )

-- | Pattern-synonym and stable-family declarations.
--
-- These two declaration families carry more parse-time validation than the
-- ordinary top-level forms. Keeping them together and out of the declaration
-- dispatcher makes that validation visible without turning `Syntax.Parse.Decl`
-- into a second grammar file.
--
-- The public functions start at the declaration keyword and return a complete
-- `Item`. They are intentionally shaped for direct dispatch from
-- `Syntax.Parse.Decl`: the caller supplies the remaining depth budget and the
-- already-decoded visibility.

import Data.Foldable (length)

import Data.List (..)

import Syntax.Source (..)

import Syntax.Token (..)

import Syntax.Ast (..)

import Syntax.Cursor (..)

import Syntax.Diagnostic (..)

import Syntax.Parse.Support (..)

import Syntax.Parse.Type (..)

import Syntax.Parse.Expr (..)

-- A parsed pattern-declaration clause before its family-level invariants have
-- been checked.
type PatternClause = PatternClause { word: String, expr: Sp(Expr), span: Span }

-- The three surface forms admitted in a stable block share one comma-separated
-- sequence, but have different ordering rules after parsing.
type StableEntry
  = SERung(Rung)
  | SEConverter(Converter)
  | SEMigrations(List(Migration))

type StableParts = StableParts {
  rungs: List(Rung),
  converters: List(Converter),
  migrations: List(Migration),
  has_migrations: Bool,
  saw_body: Bool
}

type Checked(a) = CheckBad(Diagnostic) | CheckOk(a)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pattern declarations
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- | Parse a complete `pattern` declaration.
--
-- The clause assembler enforces the surface contract at parse time: one
-- one-argument `view`, at most one `make`, and a `make` arity equal to the
-- pattern parameter count. A bare name is admitted for `view` because it may
-- name a class-dispatched view method; every other clause body must be a
-- lambda.
pub fn parse_pattern_decl(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(d, c1) => parse_pattern_decl_body(c1, d, vis)

fn parse_pattern_decl_body(
  saved : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match take_fixed(saved, "pattern") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_word(c1, TUid) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "(") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match parse_ident_list(c3, ")", Nil) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(params, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "for") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match take_word(c5, TUid) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(for_ty, c6) =>
                          match take_fixed(c6, "=") of
                            PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PTook(_, c7) =>
                              match parse_pattern_clauses(c7, depth) of
                                PStuck(c8) => PStuck(c8)
                                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                PTook(clauses, c8) =>
                                  assemble_pattern(
                                      saved,
                                      c8,
                                      name,
                                      params,
                                      for_ty,
                                      clauses,
                                      vis,
                                    )

-- A conventional comma list with an optional trailing comma. The closing
-- delimiter is consumed here.
fn parse_ident_list(
  c : Cursor,
  close : String,
  rev : List(String)
) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if at_fixed(c, close) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_ident_list(cursor_advance(c1), close, Cons(name, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, close) then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(name, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(note_comma_or(c1, close))

fn parse_pattern_clauses(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(List(PatternClause)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVOpen) then
    parse_pattern_clause_block(cursor_advance(c), depth, Nil)
  else
    match parse_pattern_clause(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(clause, c1) => PTook([clause], c1)

fn parse_pattern_clause_block(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(PatternClause)
) : Parsed(List(PatternClause)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
    parse_pattern_clause_block(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match parse_pattern_clause(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(clause, c1) =>
        if at_kind(c1, TVSemi) then
          parse_pattern_clause_block(
              cursor_advance(c1),
              depth,
              Cons(clause, rev),
            )
        elif at_kind(c1, TVClose) then
          parse_pattern_clause_block(c1, depth, Cons(clause, rev))
        else
          let c2 = cursor_note(c1, TVSemi)
          PStuck(cursor_note(c2, TVClose))

fn parse_pattern_clause(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(PatternClause) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(word, c1) =>
      match parse_expr(c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(expr, c2) =>
          if word /= "view" && word /= "make" then
            PFault(
                refuse(
                    cursor_since(saved, c2),
                    "expected `view` or `make` in pattern declaration",
                  ),
              )
          else
            PTook(
                PatternClause {
                  word = word,
                  expr = expr,
                  span = cursor_since(saved, c2)
                },
                c2,
              )

fn assemble_pattern(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  name : String,
  params : List(String),
  for_ty : String,
  clauses : List(PatternClause),
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match (collect_pattern_clauses(name, length(params), clauses, None, None)) of
    CheckBad(d) => PFault(d)
    CheckOk(parts) =>
      match parts of
        (None, _) =>
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_since(saved, c),
                  "pattern `{name}` needs a `view` clause",
                ),
            )
        (Some(viewfn), makefn) =>
          PTook(
              IPattern {
                name = name,
                params = params,
                forty = for_ty,
                viewfn = viewfn,
                makefn = makefn,
                span = cursor_since(saved, c),
                vis = vis,
                dep = None
              },
              c,
            )

fn collect_pattern_clauses(
  pattern_name : String,
  make_arity : Int,
  clauses : List(PatternClause),
  viewfn : Option(Sp(Expr)),
  makefn : Option(Sp(Expr))
) : Checked((Option(Sp(Expr)), Option(Sp(Expr)))) =
  match clauses of
    Nil => CheckOk((viewfn, makefn))
    Cons(clause, rest) =>
      let want =
        if clause.word == "view" then
          1
        else
          make_arity
      match clause_arity(clause.word, clause.expr) of
        None =>
          CheckBad(
              refuse(clause.span, "`{clause.word}` clause must be a lambda"),
            )
        Some(got) =>
          if got /= want then
            CheckBad(
                refuse(
                    clause.span,
                    "`{clause.word}` for pattern `{pattern_name}` must take {want} argument(s), this lambda takes {got}",
                  ),
              )
          elif clause.word == "view" then
            match viewfn of
              Some(_) =>
                CheckBad(
                    refuse(
                        clause.span,
                        "duplicate `view` clause in pattern `{pattern_name}`",
                      ),
                  )
              None =>
                collect_pattern_clauses(
                    pattern_name,
                    make_arity,
                    rest,
                    Some(clause.expr),
                    makefn,
                  )
          else
            match makefn of
              Some(_) =>
                CheckBad(
                    refuse(
                        clause.span,
                        "duplicate `make` clause in pattern `{pattern_name}`",
                      ),
                  )
              None =>
                collect_pattern_clauses(
                    pattern_name,
                    make_arity,
                    rest,
                    viewfn,
                    Some(clause.expr),
                  )

-- A view may be a class method name. Makes and all other view expressions
-- remain lambdas, matching the authoritative parse-time normalization.
fn clause_arity(word : String, e : Sp(Expr)) : Option(Int) =
  match e.node of
    ELam(params, _) => Some(length(params))
    EVar(_) =>
      if word == "view" then
        Some(1)
      else
        None
    _ => None

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Stable declarations
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- | Parse a complete `stable` declaration, including rungs, converters, and
-- an optional migrations table.
--
-- Stable entries are parsed in their authored order. The assembler rejects an
-- empty family, a rung after converters or migrations, and duplicate migration
-- tables before constructing the `IStable` item.
pub fn parse_stable_decl(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(d, c1) => parse_stable_decl_body(c1, d, vis)

fn parse_stable_decl_body(
  saved : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match take_fixed(saved, "stable") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_word(c1, TUid) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "\{") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              let empty =
                StableParts {
                  rungs = Nil,
                  converters = Nil,
                  migrations = Nil,
                  has_migrations = false,
                  saw_body = false
                }
              match (parse_stable_entries(saved, c3, depth, name, empty)) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(parts, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "\}") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      if length(parts.rungs) == 0 then
                        PFault(
                            refuse(
                                cursor_since(saved, c5),
                                "`stable {name}` declares no version rungs",
                              ),
                          )
                      else
                        PTook(
                            IStable {
                              name = name,
                              rungs = parts.rungs,
                              converters = parts.converters,
                              migrations = parts.migrations,
                              span = cursor_since(saved, c5),
                              vis = vis,
                              dep = None
                            },
                            c5,
                          )

fn parse_stable_entries(
  decl_start : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  family : String,
  parts : StableParts
) : Parsed(StableParts) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(parts, c)
  else
    match parse_stable_entry(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(entry, c1) =>
        match add_stable_entry(decl_start, c1, family, parts, entry) of
          CheckBad(d) => PFault(d)
          CheckOk(next) =>
            if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
              parse_stable_entries(
                  decl_start,
                  cursor_advance(c1),
                  depth,
                  family,
                  next,
                )
            elif at_fixed(c1, "\}") then
              PTook(next, c1)
            else
              PStuck(note_comma_or(c1, "\}"))

fn parse_stable_entry(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(StableEntry) =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    Some(TUid) =>
      match parse_rung(c, depth) of
        PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(rung, c1) => PTook(SERung(rung), c1)
    Some(TIdent) =>
      let word = peek_word(c)
      if word == "migrations" then
        match parse_migrations(c, depth) of
          PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(rows, c1) => PTook(SEMigrations(rows), c1)
      elif word == "upgrade" || word == "downgrade" then
        match parse_converter(c, depth) of
          PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(converter, c1) => PTook(SEConverter(converter), c1)
      else
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_span(c),
                "expected a version rung, `upgrade`, `downgrade`, or `migrations`, found `{word}`",
              ),
          )
    _ => PStuck(note_stable_entry(c))

fn add_stable_entry(
  decl_start : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  family : String,
  parts : StableParts,
  entry : StableEntry
) : Checked(StableParts) =
  match entry of
    SERung(rung) =>
      if parts.saw_body then
        CheckBad(
            refuse(
                rung.span,
                "rung `{rung.name}` must come before the converters and migrations in `stable {family}`",
              ),
          )
      else
        CheckOk(StableParts { ..parts, rungs = append(parts.rungs, [rung]) })
    SEConverter(converter) =>
      CheckOk(
          StableParts {
            ..parts,
            converters = append(parts.converters, [converter]),
            saw_body = true
          },
        )
    SEMigrations(rows) =>
      if parts.has_migrations then
        CheckBad(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(decl_start, c),
                "`stable {family}` has two migration tables",
              ),
          )
      else
        CheckOk(
            StableParts {
              ..parts,
              migrations = rows,
              has_migrations = true,
              saw_body = true
            },
          )

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Stable rungs
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn parse_rung(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Rung) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TUid) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "\{") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match parse_rung_body(c3, depth) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(body, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "\}") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match parse_frozen_badge(c5) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(frozen, c6) =>
                          match body of
                            (base, fields) =>
                              PTook(
                                  Rung {
                                    name = name,
                                    base = base,
                                    fields = fields,
                                    frozen = frozen,
                                    span = cursor_since(saved, c6)
                                  },
                                  c6,
                                )

fn parse_rung_body(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed((Option(String), List(RungField))) =
  if at_fixed(c, "..") then
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TUid) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(base, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, "\}") then
          PTook((Some(base), Nil), c1)
        elif at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          match parse_rung_field(cursor_advance(c1), depth) of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(field, c2) =>
              match parse_rung_field_tail(c2, depth, [field], false) of
                PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(fields, c3) => PTook((Some(base), fields), c3)
        else
          PStuck(note_comma_or(c1, "\}"))
  elif at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook((None, Nil), c)
  else
    match parse_rung_field(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(field, c1) =>
        match parse_rung_field_tail(c1, depth, [field], true) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(fields, c2) => PTook((None, fields), c2)

fn parse_rung_field_tail(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  fields : List(RungField),
  allow_trailing : Bool
) : Parsed(List(RungField)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, ",")) then
    PTook(fields, c)
  else
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "\}") && allow_trailing then
      PTook(fields, c1)
    else
      match parse_rung_field(c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(field, c2) =>
          parse_rung_field_tail(
              c2,
              depth,
              append(fields, [field]),
              allow_trailing,
            )

fn parse_rung_field(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(RungField) =
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, ":") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_type(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(ty, c3) =>
              if at_fixed(c3, "=") then
                match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c3), depth) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(dflt, c4) =>
                    PTook(
                        RungField { name = name, ty = ty, dflt = Some(dflt) },
                        c4,
                      )
              else
                PTook(RungField { name = name, ty = ty, dflt = None }, c3)

-- Optional in the grammar, but once an identifier follows a rung it is
-- committed as the contextual badge and checked deliberately.
fn parse_frozen_badge(c : Cursor) : Parsed(Option(String)) =
  if not(at_kind(c, TIdent)) then
    PTook(None, c)
  else
    let saved = c
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(word, c1) =>
        if word /= "frozen" then
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_since(saved, c1),
                  "expected `frozen` after a rung, found `{word}`",
                ),
            )
        else
          match take_word(c1, TStr) of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(digest, c2) => PTook(Some(digest), c2)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Hand-written converters
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn parse_converter(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Converter) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(dir, c1) =>
      if dir /= "upgrade" && dir /= "downgrade" then
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(saved, c1),
                "expected `upgrade` or `downgrade`, found `{dir}`",
              ),
          )
      else
        match take_word(c1, TUid) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(from, c2) =>
            match take_fixed(c2, "->") of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                match take_word(c3, TUid) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(to, c4) =>
                    match take_fixed(c4, "=") of
                      PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(_, c5) =>
                        match parse_converter_body(c5, depth) of
                          PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                          PTook(body, c6) =>
                            match parse_drop_loss(c6) of
                              PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                              PTook(dropped, c7) =>
                                match body of
                                  (base, overrides) =>
                                    PTook(
                                        Converter {
                                          dir = dir,
                                          from = from,
                                          to = to,
                                          base = base,
                                          overrides = overrides,
                                          drop_loss = dropped,
                                          span = cursor_since(saved, c7)
                                        },
                                        c7,
                                      )

fn parse_converter_body(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed((Sp(Expr), List(NamedExpr))) =
  match take_fixed(c, "\{") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "..") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(base, c3) =>
              match parse_converter_fields(c3, depth, Nil) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(fields, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "\}") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) => PTook((base, fields), c5)

-- Unlike ordinary comma lists, converter fields do not admit a trailing comma.
fn parse_converter_fields(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  fields : List(NamedExpr)
) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, ",")) then
    PTook(fields, c)
  else
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c3) =>
                parse_converter_fields(c3, depth, append(fields, [
                    NamedExpr { name = name, value = value },
                  ]))

-- As with `frozen`, a following identifier commits to this optional contextual
-- suffix and receives a precise spelling diagnostic on mismatch.
fn parse_drop_loss(c : Cursor) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if not(at_kind(c, TIdent)) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    let saved = c
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(word, c1) =>
        if word /= "drop_loss" then
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_since(saved, c1),
                  "expected `drop_loss`, found `{word}`",
                ),
            )
        else
          match take_fixed(c1, "(") of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c2) => parse_ident_list(c2, ")", Nil)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Migration tables and routes
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn parse_migrations(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(Migration)) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(word, c1) =>
      if word /= "migrations" then
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(saved, c1),
                "expected `migrations`, found `{word}`",
              ),
          )
      else
        match take_fixed(c1, "\{") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_migration_rows(c2, depth, Nil) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(rows, c3) =>
                match take_fixed(c3, "\}") of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(_, c4) => PTook(rows, c4)

fn parse_migration_rows(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rows : List(Migration)
) : Parsed(List(Migration)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(rows, c)
  else
    match parse_migration_row(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(row, c1) =>
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PFault(refuse(cursor_span(c), "migration parser made no progress"))
        else
          parse_migration_rows(c1, depth, append(rows, [row]))

fn parse_migration_row(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Migration) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TUid) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(from, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "->") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match take_word(c2, TUid) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(to, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, "=") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_migration_route(c4, depth) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(route, c5) =>
                      PTook(
                          Migration {
                            from = from,
                            to = to,
                            route = route,
                            span = cursor_since(saved, c5)
                          },
                          c5,
                        )

fn parse_migration_route(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(MigrationRoute) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(word, c1) =>
      if at_fixed(c1, "(") then
        parse_version_route(saved, word, cursor_advance(c1), depth)
      elif word == "auto" then
        PTook(MAuto, c1)
      else
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(saved, c1),
                "expected `auto` or `version(...)`, found `{word}`",
              ),
          )

fn parse_version_route(
  saved : Cursor,
  word : String,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(MigrationRoute) =
  match parse_version_arg(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(up, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, ",") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_version_arg(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(down, c3) =>
              let c4 =
                if at_fixed(c3, ",") then
                  cursor_advance(c3)
                else
                  c3
              match take_fixed(c4, ")") of
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c5) =>
                  match (up, down) of
                    ((up_name, up_dir), (down_name, down_dir)) =>
                      if word /= "version" then
                        PFault(
                            refuse(
                                cursor_since(saved, c5),
                                "expected `auto` or `version(...)`, found `{word}`",
                              ),
                          )
                      elif (up_name /= "upgrade" || down_name /= "downgrade") then
                        PFault(
                            refuse(
                                cursor_since(saved, c5),
                                "`version(...)` takes `upgrade = ..., downgrade = ...`",
                              ),
                          )
                      else
                        PTook(MVersion(up_dir, down_dir), c5)

fn parse_version_arg(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed((String, MigrationDir)) =
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(expr, c3) => PTook((name, migration_dir(expr)), c3)

fn migration_dir(e : Sp(Expr)) : MigrationDir =
  match e.node of
    EVar(name) =>
      if name == "auto" then
        DAuto
      else
        DExpr(e)
    _ => DExpr(e)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Shared expectations
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn note_comma_or(c : Cursor, close : String) : Cursor =
  cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed(",")), TFixed(close))

fn note_stable_entry(c : Cursor) : Cursor =
  let c1 = cursor_note(c, TUid)
  let c2 = cursor_note_name(c1, "upgrade")
  let c3 = cursor_note_name(c2, "downgrade")
  cursor_note_name(c3, "migrations")
