defs.name: intmap_fold
defs.ty: forall e0 a b. ((a, I64, b) -> a ! {e0}, a, Data.IntMap.IntMap(b)) -> a ! {e0}
defs.source:
fn intmap_fold(f, z : b, t : IntMap(v)) : b =
  match t of
    IMEmpty => z
    IMLeaf(k, v) => f(z, k, v)
    IMBranch(_p, _m, l, r) => intmap_fold(f, intmap_fold(f, z, l), r)
defs.doc:
Fold `f(acc, key, value)` over the bindings in ascending key order.

The zero subtree of a branch holds the smaller branch words and branch-word order is key order, so a left-to-right walk is ascending with no sign case.

```prism
intmap_fold(\(acc, k, _v) -> acc + k, 0i64, intmap_from_list([(1i64, "a"), (2i64, "b")]))
```

```output
3
```

defs.name: map_empty
defs.ty: forall a b c. Map(a, b, c)
defs.source: let map_empty : Map(k, v) = Tip
defs.doc: The empty map.

defs.name: map_height
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Map(a, b, c)) -> Int
defs.source:
fn map_height(m) =
  match m of
    Tip => 0
    Bin(h, _, _, _, _) => h
defs.doc: Helper: the cached height of the tree (0 for the empty map).

defs.name: map_node
defs.ty: forall a b c. (a, b, Map(a, b, c), Map(a, b, c)) -> Map(a, b, c)
defs.source: fn map_node(k, v, l, r) = Bin(1 + max(map_height(l), map_height(r)), k, v, l, r)
defs.doc: Helper: build a `Bin` node, computing its height from its children.

defs.name: map_bf
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Map(a, b, c)) -> Int
defs.source:
fn map_bf(m) =
  match m of
    Tip => 0
    Bin(_, _, _, l, r) => map_height(l) - map_height(r)
defs.doc: Helper: the balance factor of a node (left height minus right height).

defs.name: map_rot_right
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Map(a, b, c)) -> Map(a, b, c)
defs.source:
fn map_rot_right(m) =
  match m of
    Bin(_, k, v, Bin(_, lk, lv, ll, lr), r) =>
      map_node(lk, lv, ll, map_node(k, v, lr, r))
    other => other
defs.doc: Helper: a single right AVL rotation.

defs.name: map_rot_left
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Map(a, b, c)) -> Map(a, b, c)
defs.source:
fn map_rot_left(m) =
  match m of
    Bin(_, k, v, l, Bin(_, rk, rv, rl, rr)) =>
      map_node(rk, rv, map_node(k, v, l, rl), rr)
    other => other
defs.doc: Helper: a single left AVL rotation.

defs.name: map_balance
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Map(a, b, c)) -> Map(a, b, c)
defs.source:
fn map_balance(m) =
  let bf = map_bf(m)
  if bf > 1 then
    match m of
      Bin(_, k, v, l, r) =>
        if map_bf(l) < 0 then
          map_rot_right(map_node(k, v, map_rot_left(l), r))
        else
          map_rot_right(m)
      Tip => Tip
  elif bf < -1 then
    match m of
      Bin(_, k, v, l, r) =>
        if map_bf(r) > 0 then
          map_rot_left(map_node(k, v, l, map_rot_right(r)))
        else
          map_rot_left(m)
      Tip => Tip
  else
    m
defs.doc: Helper: rebalance a node after an insert or delete unbalanced it.

defs.name: map_insert
defs.ty: forall a b c. (b, c, Map(b, c, a)) -> Map(b, c, a)
defs.source:
fn map_insert(key : k, value : v, m : Map(k, v)) : Map(k, v) given Ord(k) =
  match m of
    Tip => map_node(key, value, Tip, Tip)
    Bin(_, k2, v2, l, r) =>
      let c = cmp(key, k2)
      if c < 0 then
        map_balance(map_node(k2, v2, map_insert(key, value, l), r))
      elif c > 0 then
        map_balance(map_node(k2, v2, l, map_insert(key, value, r)))
      else
        map_node(k2, value, l, r)
defs.doc:
Insert `key` with `value`, overwriting any existing binding, and rebalance.

```prism
map_lookup(1, map_insert(1, "a", map_empty))
```

```output
Some(a)
```

defs.ty: forall a b c. (b, Map(b, c, a)) -> Option(c)
defs.source:

  match m of
    Tip => None
    Bin(_, k2, v, l, r) =>
      let c = cmp(key, k2)
      if c < 0 then
        map_lookup(key, l)
      elif c > 0 then
        map_lookup(key, r)
      else
        Some(v)

defs.name: map_delete
defs.ty: forall a b c. (b, Map(b, c, a)) -> Map(b, c, a)
defs.source:
fn map_delete(key : k, m : Map(k, v)) : Map(k, v) given Ord(k) =
  match m of
    Tip => Tip
    Bin(_, k2, v2, l, r) =>
      let c = cmp(key, k2)
      if c < 0 then
        map_balance(map_node(k2, v2, map_delete(key, l), r))
      elif c > 0 then
        map_balance(map_node(k2, v2, l, map_delete(key, r)))
      else
        match l of
          Tip => r
          _ =>
            match r of
              Tip => l
              _ =>
                match map_min(r) of
                  None => l
                  Some((mk, mv)) =>
                    map_balance(map_node(mk, mv, l, map_delete(mk, r)))
defs.doc:
Remove `key` (a no-op if absent), rebalancing the tree.

defs.name: Name
defs.source: newtype Name(space) = Name(Int)
defs.doc: A branded nominal identity: one integer, one phantom namespace.

defs.name: Binder
defs.source: type Binder(space) = Binder { name: Name(space), hint: String }
defs.doc: A binder: the identity the checker compares, and the source spelling diagnostics print.

defs.name: eqName
defs.source:
instance eqName : Eq(Name(space))
  fn eq(a, b) =
    match (a, b) of
      (Name(x), Name(y)) => x == y

defs.name: ordName
defs.source:
instance ordName : Ord(Name(space))
  fn cmp(a, b) =
    match (a, b) of
      (Name(x), Name(y)) => cmp(x, y)

defs.name: showName
defs.source:
instance showName : Show(Name(space))
  fn show(n) =
    match n of
      Name(x) => "%{x}"

defs.name: eqBinder
defs.source:
instance eqBinder : Eq(Binder(space))
  fn eq(a, b) = a.name == b.name

defs.name: ordBinder
defs.source:
instance ordBinder : Ord(Binder(space))
  fn cmp(a, b) = cmp(a.name, b.name)

defs.name: showBinder
defs.source:
instance showBinder : Show(Binder(space))
  fn show(b) = render_binder(b)

defs.name: name_id
defs.doc: The integer identity a name carries. Serialization and hashing commit to this and the surrounding schema, never to an address or a random seed.

defs.name: fresh_binder
defs.source:
fn fresh_binder(hint : String) : Binder(space) ! {Fresh} =
  Binder { name = Name(fresh()), hint = hint }
defs.doc:
Allocate a binder with a fresh deterministic identity and the given presentation hint.

```prism
# import Control.Fresh (run_fresh)
run_fresh(\() -> [render_binder(fresh_binder("x")), render_binder(fresh_binder("x"))])
```

```output
[x%0, x%1]
```

defs.name: bound_name
defs.source: fn bound_name(b : Binder(space)) : Name(space) = b.name
defs.doc: A reference to a binder: the branded name the checker compares.

defs.name: render_binder
defs.source: fn render_binder(b : Binder(space)) : String = "{b.hint}%{name_id(b.name)}"
defs.doc: Render a binder as its hint plus its identity, deterministic and unique by construction. A prettier printer may use the hint alone where no sibling shares the spelling.

defs.name: OrdWitness
defs.source: type OrdWitness(k, brand) = OrdBy((k, k) -> Int)
defs.doc: An ordering witness: a comparator branded by the phantom `brand`. The only way to obtain one is `with_ordering`, which mints a fresh brand per call, so two witnesses always carry incompatible brands.

defs.name: with_ordering
defs.ty: forall a b. ((a, a) -> Int, forall brand. (Data.Ordered.OrdWitness(a, brand)) -> b) -> b
defs.doc:
Run `body` with a fresh ordering witness carrying `cmp`. The witness's brand is rigid and unique to this call: a map built under it cannot be handed to a different witness's operation, and that mismatch is a compile error naming both brands. The result `a` may not mention the brand, so a branded map never escapes the block, only a summary of it (a size, a looked-up value, an encoded form).

The brand binder is spelled `brand` rather than a bare letter on purpose: it must not collide with the `a`, `b`, `c` a scheme's own quantifiers are canonicalized to, which would capture the result type under the inner quantifier.

```prism
with_ordering(\(a, b) -> cmp(a, b), \(w) ->
  ord_lookup(w, 1, ord_insert(w, 1, "a", ord_empty(w))))
```

```output
Some(a)
```

defs.name: ins_by
defs.ty: forall a b c. ((a, a) -> Int, a, b, Map(a, b, c)) -> Map(a, b, c)
defs.source:
fn ins_by(
  cmp : (k, k) -> Int,
  key : k,
  x : v,
  m : Map(k, v, brand)
) : Map(k, v, brand) =
  match m of
    Tip => map_node(key, x, Tip, Tip)
    Bin(_, k2, v2, l, r) =>
      let c = cmp(key, k2)
      if c < 0 then
        map_balance(map_node(k2, v2, ins_by(cmp, key, x, l), r))
      elif c > 0 then
        map_balance(map_node(k2, v2, l, ins_by(cmp, key, x, r)))
      else
        map_node(k2, x, l, r)

defs.name: look_by
defs.ty: forall a b c. ((a, a) -> Int, a, Map(a, b, c)) -> Option(b)
defs.source:
fn look_by(cmp : (k, k) -> Int, key : k, m : Map(k, v, brand)) : Option(v) =
  match m of
    Tip => None
    Bin(_, k2, v2, l, r) =>
      let c = cmp(key, k2)
      if c < 0 then
        look_by(cmp, key, l)
      elif c > 0 then
        look_by(cmp, key, r)
      else
        Some(v2)

defs.name: ord_empty
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Data.Ordered.OrdWitness(a, b)) -> Map(a, c, b)
defs.source: fn ord_empty(_w : OrdWitness(k, brand)) : Map(k, v, brand) = map_empty
defs.doc: The empty map under witness `w`, carrying `w`'s brand.

defs.name: ord_insert
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Data.Ordered.OrdWitness(a, b), a, c, Map(a, c, b)) -> Map(a, c, b)
defs.source:
fn ord_insert(
  w : OrdWitness(k, brand),
  key : k,
  x : v,
  m : Map(k, v, brand)
) : Map(k, v, brand) =
  match w of
    OrdBy(cmp) => ins_by(cmp, key, x, m)
defs.doc:
Insert under witness `w`; the result carries `w`'s brand.

```prism
with_ordering(\(a, b) -> cmp(a, b), \(w) ->
  ord_size(w, ord_insert(w, 1, "a", ord_empty(w))))
```

```output
1
```

defs.name: ord_lookup
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Data.Ordered.OrdWitness(a, b), a, Map(a, c, b)) -> Option(c)
defs.source:
fn ord_lookup(
  w : OrdWitness(k, brand),
  key : k,
  m : Map(k, v, brand)
) : Option(v) =
  match w of
    OrdBy(cmp) => look_by(cmp, key, m)

defs.name: Doc
defs.source:
type Doc
  = DNil
  | DText(String)
  | DSoft(String)
  | DHard
  | DCat(Doc, Doc)
  | DNest(Int, Doc)
  | DGroup(Doc)
defs.doc: A layout document. Its representation is hidden so indentation and break invariants are established only by the public combinators.

defs.name: Mode
defs.source: type Mode = Flat | Brk

defs.name: Item
defs.source: type Item = Item(Int, Mode, Doc)

defs.name: SDoc
defs.source: type SDoc = SNil | SText(String, SDoc) | SLine(Int, SDoc)

defs.name: spaces
defs.source:
fn spaces(n) =
  if n <= 0 then
    ""
  else
    concat(" ", spaces(n - 1))

defs.name: fits
defs.source:
fn fits(w, items) =
  if w < 0 then
    false
  else
    match items of
      Nil => true
      Cons(Item(i, m, d), rest) =>
        match d of
          DNil => fits(w, rest)
          DText(s) => fits(w - str_len(s), rest)
          DSoft(s) =>
            match m of
              Flat => fits(w - str_len(s), rest)
              Brk => true
          DHard => true
          DCat(a, b) => fits(w, Cons(Item(i, m, a), Cons(Item(i, m, b), rest)))
          DNest(j, x) => fits(w, Cons(Item(i + j, m, x), rest))
          DGroup(x) => fits(w, Cons(Item(i, Flat, x), rest))

defs.name: best
defs.source:
fn best(w, k, items) =
  match items of
    Nil => SNil
    Cons(Item(i, m, d), rest) =>
      match d of
        DNil => best(w, k, rest)
        DText(s) => SText(s, best(w, k + str_len(s), rest))
        DSoft(s) =>
          match m of
            Flat => SText(s, best(w, k + str_len(s), rest))
            Brk => SLine(i, best(w, i, rest))
        DHard => SLine(i, best(w, i, rest))
        DCat(a, b) => best(w, k, Cons(Item(i, m, a), Cons(Item(i, m, b), rest)))
        DNest(j, x) => best(w, k, Cons(Item(i + j, m, x), rest))
        DGroup(x) =>
          if fits(w - k, Cons(Item(i, Flat, x), rest)) then
            best(w, k, Cons(Item(i, Flat, x), rest))
          else
            best(w, k, Cons(Item(i, Brk, x), rest))

defs.name: layout
defs.source:
fn layout(sd) =
  match sd of
    SNil => ""
    SText(s, r) => concat(s, layout(r))
    SLine(i, r) => concat("\n", concat(spaces(i), layout(r)))

defs.name: render
defs.source: fn render(w, d) = layout(best(w, 0, Cons(Item(0, Brk, d), Nil)))
defs.doc:
Render a document to a string at page width `w`.

```prism
import Data.Pretty (render, group, cat, text, line)
render(80, group(cat(text("hello"), cat(line(), text("world")))))
```

```output
hello world
```

defs.name: pretty
defs.source: fn pretty(d) = render(80, d)
defs.doc: Render at the conventional width of 80 columns.

defs.name: text
defs.source: fn text(s) = DText(s)
defs.doc: Literal text. The string must not contain a newline; use `hardline` for a forced break.

defs.name: empty
defs.source: fn empty() = DNil
defs.doc: The empty document.

defs.name: line
defs.source: fn line() = DSoft(" ")
defs.doc: A break that is a space when flat and a newline when broken.

defs.name: linebreak
defs.source: fn linebreak() = DSoft("")
defs.doc: A break that is nothing when flat and a newline when broken.

defs.name: softline
defs.source: fn softline() = DGroup(DSoft(" "))
defs.doc: A `line` inside its own group: a space if it fits, a newline otherwise.

defs.name: softbreak
defs.source: fn softbreak() = DGroup(DSoft(""))
defs.doc: A `linebreak` inside its own group: nothing if it fits, a newline otherwise.

defs.name: hardline
defs.source: fn hardline() = DHard
defs.doc: A newline that no group can flatten away.

defs.name: cat
defs.source: fn cat(a, b) = DCat(a, b)
defs.doc: One document then another.

defs.name: nest
defs.source: fn nest(n, d) = DNest(max(0, n), d)
defs.doc: Indent every break inside `d` by at least zero columns. Negative indentation is clamped to zero.

defs.name: group
defs.source: fn group(d) = DGroup(d)
defs.doc: Try to lay `d` out flat; fall back to its broken form if it does not fit.

defs.name: concat_docs
defs.source:
fn concat_docs(ds) =
  match ds of
    Nil => DNil
    Cons(d, rest) => DCat(d, concat_docs(rest))
defs.doc: Concatenate a list of documents end to end.

defs.name: intersperse
defs.source:
fn intersperse(s, ds) =
  match ds of
    Nil => DNil
    Cons(x, Nil) => x
    Cons(x, rest) => DCat(x, DCat(s, intersperse(s, rest)))

defs.name: join_docs
defs.source:
fn join_docs(separator : Doc, docs : List(Doc)) : Doc =
  intersperse(separator, docs)
defs.doc: Put `separator` between each pair of documents. Unlike `hsep` and `vsep`, the caller selects the exact separator document, which is useful for small target-language emitters (commas plus soft breaks, operators, or hard lines).

defs.name: hsep
defs.source: fn hsep(ds) = intersperse(DText(" "), ds)
defs.doc: Documents separated by a single space, all on one line.

defs.name: vsep
defs.source: fn vsep(ds) = intersperse(DSoft(" "), ds)
defs.doc: Documents separated by `line` breaks (spaces or newlines under a group).

defs.name: sep
defs.source: fn sep(ds) = DGroup(vsep(ds))
defs.doc: `vsep` wrapped in a group: one line if it fits, one per element otherwise.

defs.name: enclose
defs.source: fn enclose(l, r, d) = DCat(l, DCat(d, r))
defs.doc: `d` between the opening `l` and closing `r`.

defs.name: parens
defs.source: fn parens(d) = enclose(DText("("), DText(")"), d)
defs.doc: `d` in parentheses.

defs.name: brackets
defs.source: fn brackets(d) = enclose(DText("["), DText("]"), d)
defs.doc: `d` in square brackets.

defs.name: braces
defs.source: fn braces(d) = enclose(DText("\{"), DText("\}"), d)
defs.doc: `d` in curly braces.

defs.name: map_result
defs.ty: forall e0 a b c. ((c) -> b ! {e0}, Result(c, a)) -> Result(b, a) ! {e0}
defs.source:
fn map_result(f, r) =
  match r of
    Ok(x) => Ok(f(x))
    Err(e) => Err(e)
defs.doc:

defs.name: map_err
defs.ty: forall e0 a b c. ((c) -> b ! {e0}, Result(a, c)) -> Result(a, b) ! {e0}
defs.source:
fn map_err(f, r) =
  match r of
    Ok(x) => Ok(x)
    Err(e) => Err(f(e))
defs.doc: Apply `f` to the `Err` value, leaving an `Ok` untouched (the error-side counterpart of `map_result`).

defs.name: and_then_result
defs.ty: forall e0 a b c. ((a) -> Result(b, c) ! {e0}, Result(a, c)) -> Result(b, c) ! {e0}
defs.source:
fn and_then_result(f, r) =
  match r of
    Ok(x) => f(x)
    Err(e) => Err(e)
defs.doc:
Chain a result-returning function, short-circuiting on `Err` (monadic bind for `Result`).

```prism
and_then_result(\(x) -> if x > 0 then Ok(x) else Err("neg"), Ok(5))
```

```output

```

defs.name: result_or
defs.ty: forall a b. (a, Result(a, b)) -> a
defs.source:
fn result_or(d, r) =
  match r of
    Ok(x) => x
    Err(_e) => d
defs.doc:
The `Ok` value, or the default `d` when the result is `Err`.

defs.name: ok_of_option
defs.ty: forall a b. (a, Option(b)) -> Result(b, a)
defs.source:
fn ok_of_option(err, o) =
  match o of
    None => Err(err)
    Some(x) => Ok(x)
defs.doc:

defs.name: Scope
defs.source: type Scope(space) = Scope { spellings: Map(String, List(Binder(space))) }
defs.doc: A resolution scope for one namespace: each spelling maps to its stack of active binders, innermost first.

defs.name: ScopeError
defs.source:
type ScopeError
  = ScopeUnknown(String)
  | ScopeUnderflow(String)
  deriving (Eq, Show)
defs.doc: Why a scope operation refused.

defs.name: scope_empty
defs.source: let scope_empty : Scope(space) = Scope { spellings = map_empty }
defs.doc: The empty scope: no spelling resolves.

defs.name: stack_of
defs.source:
fn stack_of(sc : Scope(space), spelling : String) : List(Binder(space)) =
  match map_lookup(spelling, sc.spellings) of
    None => Nil
    Some(bs) => bs

defs.name: scope_push
defs.doc: Bring `binder` into force for its own hint spelling, shadowing any binder already in force for it.

defs.name: scope_lookup
defs.source:
fn scope_lookup(
  sc : Scope(space),
  spelling : String
) : Result(Binder(space), ScopeError) =
  match stack_of(sc, spelling) of
    Nil => Err(ScopeUnknown(spelling))
    Cons(b, _rest) => Ok(b)
defs.doc: The innermost binder in force for `spelling`, or `ScopeUnknown`.

defs.name: scope_pop
defs.source:
fn scope_pop(
  sc : Scope(space),
  spelling : String
) : Result(Scope(space), ScopeError) =
  match stack_of(sc, spelling) of
    Nil => Err(ScopeUnderflow(spelling))
    Cons(_b, rest) =>
      Ok(Scope { spellings = map_insert(spelling, rest, sc.spellings) })
defs.doc: Leave the innermost binding for `spelling`, restoring whatever it shadowed; popping a spelling with no active binder is `ScopeUnderflow`.

defs.name: scope_depth
defs.source:
fn scope_depth(sc : Scope(space), spelling : String) : Int =
  depth_go(stack_of(sc, spelling), 0)
defs.doc: How many binders are in force for `spelling`; zero for an unknown one.

defs.name: depth_go
defs.source:
fn depth_go(bs : List(Binder(space)), n : Int) : Int =
  match bs of
    Nil => n
    Cons(_b, rest) => depth_go(rest, n + 1)

defs.source:
fn occurs_at(needle, s, j, k) =
  if k >= byte_len(needle) then
    true
  elif j + k >= byte_len(s) then
    false
  elif byte_at(needle, k) == byte_at(s, j + k) then
    occurs_at(needle, s, j, k + 1)
  else
    false
defs.doc: Helper for the substring queries: whether `needle` sits at byte offset `j` in `s`, comparing from position `k`.

    j
  else
    index_of_go(needle, s, j + 1)
defs.doc: Helper for `index_of`: search for `needle` in `s` from byte offset `j`.

    buf

    map_case(
        s,
        i + 1,
        buf_push(buf, if up then to_upper_c(c) else to_lower_c(c)),
        up,
      )
defs.doc: Helper for `to_upper`/`to_lower`: fold ASCII case mapping over `s` into a byte buffer (`up` selects upper- vs lower-casing).

defs.name: reshape
defs.source:
fn reshape(t : Tensor, new_shape : List(Int)) : Tensor =
  match t of
    MkTensor(b, sh, st, _) =>
      if st == rm_strides(sh) && prod(sh) == prod(new_shape) then
        MkTensor(
            b,
            new_shape,
            rm_strides(new_shape),
            default_axes(length(new_shape)),
          )
      else
        fail()
defs.doc:

defs.name: contract_sum
defs.ty: (FloatBuf, Int, Int, Int, Int, Float) -> Float
defs.source:
fn contract_sum(
  b : FloatBuf,
  base : Int,
  sa : Int,
  e : Int,
  extent : Int,
  acc : Float
) : Float =
  if e >= extent then
    acc
  else
    contract_sum(b, base, sa, e + 1, extent, acc + tbuf_get(b, base + e * sa))

defs.name: sum_axis_fill
defs.ty: (FloatBuf, FloatBuf, List(Int), List(Int), List(Int), Int, Int, Int, Int) -> FloatBuf
defs.source:
fn sum_axis_fill(
  b : FloatBuf,
  out : FloatBuf,
  ostrides : List(Int),
  osh : List(Int),
  ks : List(Int),
  sa : Int,
  extent : Int,
  q : Int,
  total : Int
) : FloatBuf =
  if q >= total then
    out
  else
    let out_idx = zip_with(\(s, n) -> q / s % n, ostrides, osh)
    let base = offset(out_idx, ks)
    sum_axis_fill(
        b,
        tbuf_set(out, q, contract_sum(b, base, sa, 0, extent, 0.0)),
        ostrides,
        osh,
        ks,
        sa,
        extent,
        q + 1,
        total,
      )

defs.name: sum_axis
defs.doc:
Reduce over one named axis by summing, removing that axis (rank `r` becomes `r - 1`); the remaining axes keep their names. The contracted axis is summed in index order `0..extent` (source loop order), so the result is bit-identical across backends. `fail()` on a missing axis or a non-contiguous input.

```prism
let s = sum_axis(from_list([2, 2], [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]), "0")
(at_tensor(s, [0]), at_tensor(s, [1]))
```

```output
(4, 6)
```

defs.doc:
Reduce over one named axis by averaging: the sum over that axis divided by its extent, removing the axis. Same source-loop order and contiguity requirement as `sum_axis`.

```prism
let m = mean_axis(from_list([2, 2], [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]), "1")
(at_tensor(m, [0]), at_tensor(m, [1]))
```

defs.name: mm_dot
defs.ty: (FloatBuf, FloatBuf, Int, Int, Int, Int, Int, Float) -> Float
defs.source:
fn mm_dot(
  ba : FloatBuf,
  bb : FloatBuf,
  i : Int,
  j : Int,
  k : Int,
  n : Int,
  p : Int,
  acc : Float
) : Float =
  if p >= k then
    acc
  else
    mm_dot(
        ba,
        bb,
        i,
        j,
        k,
        n,
        p + 1,
        acc + tbuf_get(ba, i * k + p) * tbuf_get(bb, p * n + j),
      )

defs.name: mm_fill
defs.ty: (FloatBuf, FloatBuf, FloatBuf, Int, Int, Int, Int) -> FloatBuf
defs.source:
fn mm_fill(
  ba : FloatBuf,
  bb : FloatBuf,
  out : FloatBuf,
  k : Int,
  n : Int,
  q : Int,
  total : Int
) : FloatBuf =
  if q >= total then
    out
  else
    mm_fill(
        ba,
        bb,
        tbuf_set(out, q, mm_dot(ba, bb, q / n, q % n, k, n, 0, 0.0)),
        k,
        n,
        q + 1,
        total,
      )

defs.name: matmul
defs.source:
fn matmul(a : Tensor, b : Tensor) : Tensor ! {Fail} =
  match shape(a) of
    Cons(m, Cons(k, Nil)) =>
      match shape(b) of
        Cons(k2, Cons(n, Nil)) =>
          if k == k2 && is_contig(a) && is_contig(b) then
            contig_tensor(
                Cons(m, Cons(n, Nil)),
                mm_fill(buf(a), buf(b), tbuf_new(m * n, 0.0), k, n, 0, m * n),
              )
          else
            fail()
        _ => fail()
    _ => fail()
defs.doc:
Matrix product of a rank-2 `[m, k]` tensor with a rank-2 `[k, n]` tensor, giving `[m, n]`. The contraction sums in source loop order, so the result is bit-identical across backends. `fail()` unless both operands are contiguous, rank 2, with matching inner extents.

```prism
let c = matmul(from_list([2, 2], [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]), from_list([2, 2], [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]))
(c[0, 0], c[1, 1])
```

```output
(1, 4)
```

defs.ty: forall a b. Map(a, a, b)
defs.source: let uf_empty : Map(k, k) = map_empty

defs.name: uf_find
defs.ty: forall a b. (Map(b, b, a), b) -> b
defs.source:
fn uf_find(uf : Map(k, k), x : k) : k given Ord(k) =
  match map_lookup(x, uf) of
    None => x
    Some(p) =>
      if cmp(p, x) == 0 then
        x
      else
        uf_find(uf, p)
defs.doc:
The canonical root of `x`'s set.

Merge the sets of `x` and `y`, keeping the smaller root; a no-op when they are already joined.

defs.source:

  cmp(uf_find(uf, x), uf_find(uf, y)) == 0
defs.doc: True when `x` and `y` belong to the same set.

defs.name: UnionFind
defs.source: type UnionFind(k, a) = Ufp { parents: Map(k, k), payloads: Map(k, a) }
defs.doc: A payload-carrying forest over ordered keys. The constructor is the module's private representation; go through the `ufp_` functions.

defs.name: UfError
defs.source: type UfError = UfDuplicate | UfAbsent deriving (Eq, Show)
defs.doc: Why a forest operation refused.

defs.name: ufp_empty
defs.source:
let ufp_empty : UnionFind(k, a) =
  Ufp { parents = map_empty, payloads = map_empty }
defs.doc: The empty forest: no keys, no classes.

defs.name: root_of
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b), a) -> a
defs.source:
fn root_of(uf : UnionFind(k, a), x : k) : k given Ord(k) =
  match map_lookup(x, uf.parents) of
    None => x
    Some(p) => root_of(uf, p)

defs.name: member
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b), a) -> Bool
defs.source:
fn member(uf : UnionFind(k, a), x : k) : Bool given Ord(k) =
  match map_lookup(x, uf.payloads) of
    Some(_a) => true
    None =>
      match map_lookup(x, uf.parents) of
        Some(_p) => true
        None => false

defs.name: ufp_insert
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b), a, b) -> Result(Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b), Data.UnionFind.Payload.UfError)
defs.source:
fn ufp_insert(
  uf : UnionFind(k, a),
  x : k,
  a : a
) : Result(UnionFind(k, a), UfError) given Ord(k) =
  if member(uf, x) then
    Err(UfDuplicate)
  else
    Ok(Ufp { ..uf, payloads = map_insert(x, a, uf.payloads) })
defs.doc:
Insert `x` as a fresh singleton class with descriptor `a`. Inserting a key that is already a member (root or not) is `UfDuplicate`.

```prism
ufp_find(result_or(ufp_empty, ufp_insert(ufp_empty, 1, "one")), 1)
```

```output
Some((1, one))
```

defs.name: ufp_find
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b), a) -> Option((a, b))
defs.source:
fn ufp_find(uf : UnionFind(k, a), x : k) : Option((k, a)) given Ord(k) =
  if member(uf, x) then
    let r = root_of(uf, x)
    match map_lookup(r, uf.payloads) of
      Some(a) => Some((r, a))
      None => None
  else
    None
defs.doc:
The canonical root of `x`'s class and the class descriptor, or `None` when `x` was never inserted.

```prism
ufp_find(result_or(ufp_empty, ufp_insert(ufp_empty, 1, "one")), 9)
```

```output
None
```

defs.name: ufp_set
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b), a, b) -> Result(Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b), Data.UnionFind.Payload.UfError)
defs.doc: Replace the descriptor of `x`'s class, or `UfAbsent` when `x` was never inserted. The class and its root are unchanged.

defs.name: ufp_union_with
defs.ty: forall e0 a b. ((a, a) -> a ! {e0}, Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(b, a), b, b) -> Result(Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(b, a), Data.UnionFind.Payload.UfError) ! {e0}
defs.doc:
Join the classes of `x` and `y`. The smaller root by `Ord` stays the root; `combine` receives the kept root's descriptor first and the absorbed root's second, runs exactly once per join that changes the partition, and its result becomes the joined class's descriptor. Joining a class with itself is a no-op that never calls `combine`; either key absent is `UfAbsent`.

```prism
let uf1 = result_or(ufp_empty, ufp_insert(ufp_empty, 2, "b"))
let uf2 = result_or(ufp_empty, ufp_insert(uf1, 1, "a"))
ufp_find(result_or(ufp_empty, ufp_union_with(concat, uf2, 2, 1)), 2)
```

```output
Some((1, ab))
```

defs.name: ufp_roots
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b)) -> List((a, b))
defs.source:
fn ufp_roots(uf : UnionFind(k, a)) : List((k, a)) given Ord(k) =
  map_to_list(uf.payloads)
defs.doc:
The logical partition: every canonical root paired with its class descriptor, in ascending key order. This is the rendering to compare or serialize; it is independent of the parent paths any sequence of joins happened to build.

```prism
let uf1 = result_or(ufp_empty, ufp_insert(ufp_empty, 2, "b"))
let uf2 = result_or(ufp_empty, ufp_insert(uf1, 1, "a"))
ufp_roots(result_or(ufp_empty, ufp_union_with(concat, uf2, 1, 2)))
```

```output
[(1, ab)]
```

defs.name: ufp_equiv
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.UnionFind.Payload.UnionFind(a, b), a, a) -> Option(Bool)
defs.source:
fn ufp_equiv(uf : UnionFind(k, a), x : k, y : k) : Option(Bool) given Ord(k) =
  if member(uf, x) && member(uf, y) then
    Some(cmp(root_of(uf, x), root_of(uf, y)) == 0)
  else
    None
defs.doc: Whether `x` and `y` are members of the same class; `None` when either was never inserted.

defs.name: Validation
defs.source: type Validation(e, a) = Valid(a) | Invalid(List(e)) deriving (Eq, Show)
defs.doc: A validated `a`, or the list of accumulated errors `e`.

defs.name: is_valid
defs.source:
fn is_valid(v) =
  match v of
    Valid(_x) => true
    Invalid(_es) => false
defs.doc: True when the value validated.

defs.name: is_invalid
defs.source: fn is_invalid(v) = not(is_valid(v))
defs.doc: True when there were errors.

defs.name: map_valid
defs.ty: forall e0 a b c. ((c) -> b ! {e0}, Data.Validation.Validation(a, c)) -> Data.Validation.Validation(a, b) ! {e0}
defs.source:
fn map_valid(f, v) =
  match v of
    Valid(x) => Valid(f(x))
    Invalid(es) => Invalid(es)
defs.doc: Apply `f` to a `Valid` value, leaving accumulated errors untouched.

defs.name: validation_ap
defs.ty: forall e0 a b c. (Data.Validation.Validation(a, (c) -> b ! {e0}), Data.Validation.Validation(a, c)) -> Data.Validation.Validation(a, b) ! {e0}
defs.source:
fn validation_ap(vf, va) =
  match vf of
    Valid(f) =>
      match va of
        Valid(x) => Valid(f(x))
        Invalid(es) => Invalid(es)
    Invalid(es1) =>
      match va of
        Valid(_x) => Invalid(es1)
        Invalid(es2) => Invalid(append(es1, es2))
defs.doc:
Applicative apply: when both sides validate, apply the function; otherwise keep every error from both sides, in order. This is the accumulation.

```prism
validation_ap(Invalid(["bad function"]), Invalid(["bad argument"]))
```

```output
Data.Validation.Invalid([bad function, bad argument])
```

defs.name: validate2
defs.ty: forall e0 a b c d. ((c, d) -> b ! {e0}, Data.Validation.Validation(a, c), Data.Validation.Validation(a, d)) -> Data.Validation.Validation(a, b) ! {e0}
defs.source:
fn validate2(f, va, vb) =
  match va of
    Valid(a) =>
      match vb of
        Valid(b) => Valid(f(a, b))
        Invalid(es) => Invalid(es)
    Invalid(es1) =>
      match vb of
        Valid(_b) => Invalid(es1)
        Invalid(es2) => Invalid(append(es1, es2))
defs.doc:
Combine two validations with the two-argument `f`, accumulating the errors of whichever failed.

```prism
validate2(\(a, b) -> a + b, Valid(1), Invalid(["oops"]))
```

```output
Data.Validation.Invalid([oops])
```

defs.name: validation_or
defs.ty: forall a b. (a, Data.Validation.Validation(b, a)) -> a
defs.source:
fn validation_or(d, v) =
  match v of
    Valid(x) => x
    Invalid(_es) => d
defs.doc:
The `Valid` value, or `d` when there were errors.

```prism
(validation_or(0, Valid(7)), validation_or(0, Invalid(["bad"])))
```

```output
(7, 0)
```

defs.name: validation_of_result
defs.ty: forall a b. (Result(a, b)) -> Data.Validation.Validation(b, a)
defs.source:
fn validation_of_result(r) =
  match r of
    Ok(x) => Valid(x)
    Err(e) => Invalid([e])
defs.doc: Turn a `Result` into a single-error `Validation`.

defs.name: result_of_validation
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.Validation.Validation(a, b)) -> Result(b, List(a))
defs.source:
fn result_of_validation(v) =
  match v of
    Valid(x) => Ok(x)
    Invalid(es) => Err(es)
defs.doc: Turn a `Validation` back into a `Result`, keeping the whole error list on the `Err` side.

defs.name: cons_validation
defs.ty: forall a b. (Data.Validation.Validation(a, b), Data.Validation.Validation(a, List(b))) -> Data.Validation.Validation(a, List(b))
defs.source:
fn cons_validation(v, acc) =
  match v of
    Valid(x) =>
      match acc of
        Valid(xs) => Valid(Cons(x, xs))
        Invalid(es) => Invalid(es)
    Invalid(es1) =>
      match acc of
        Valid(_xs) => Invalid(es1)
        Invalid(es2) => Invalid(append(es1, es2))

defs.name: sequence_validation
defs.ty: forall a b. (List(Data.Validation.Validation(a, b))) -> Data.Validation.Validation(a, List(b))
defs.source: fn sequence_validation(vs) = foldr(cons_validation, Valid(Nil), vs)
defs.doc:
Collapse a list of validations into a validation of the list, accumulating every error across all of them.

```prism
sequence_validation([Valid(1), Invalid(["first"]), Invalid(["second"])])
```

```output
Data.Validation.Invalid([first, second])
```

defs.name: Vec
defs.source: type Vec(a, n : Nat) = MkVec(List(a))
defs.doc: A vector of `a` with a type-level length `n`.

defs.name: vempty
defs.source: fn vempty() : Vec(a, 0) = MkVec([])
defs.doc: The empty vector, length `0`.

defs.name: vsingle
defs.source: fn vsingle(x : a) : Vec(a, 1) = MkVec([x])
defs.doc:
The one-element vector, length `1`.

```prism
vto_list(vsingle(42))
```

```output
[42]
```

defs.name: vto_list
defs.doc:
The underlying list, forgetting the static length.

```prism
vto_list(vsingle(7))
```

```output
[7]
```

defs.name: vmap
defs.ty: forall a b c. ((a) -> b, Data.Vec.Vec(a, c)) -> Data.Vec.Vec(b, c)
defs.doc:
Apply `f` to every element, preserving the length.

```prism
vto_list(vmap(\(x) -> x * 2, vsingle(21)))
```

```output
[42]
```

defs.name: vzip
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Data.Vec.Vec(a, b), Data.Vec.Vec(c, b)) -> Data.Vec.Vec((a, c), b)
defs.source:
fn vzip(u : Vec(a, n), v : Vec(b, n)) : Vec((a, b), n) =
  match u of
    MkVec(xs) =>
      match v of
        MkVec(ys) => MkVec(zip(xs, ys))
defs.doc:
Zip two vectors of the SAME length into a vector of pairs. The shared `n` forces equal lengths; a mismatch is rejected at compile time, naming both.

```prism
vto_list(vzip(vsingle(1), vsingle(2)))
```

```output
[(1, 2)]
```

A length mismatch is a compile error:

```prism,compile_fail
vzip(vsingle(1), vempty())
```

defs.name: vhead
defs.source:
fn vhead(v : Vec(a, n)) : a =
  match v of
    MkVec(xs) =>
      match xs of
        Cons(x, _) => x
        Nil => fail()
defs.doc:
The first element. `n` is unconstrained, so the empty vector is not ruled out statically; on an empty vector this raises `Fail`.

```prism
vhead(vsingle(42))
```

```output
42
```

defs.name: an_nodes
defs.source: fn an_nodes(e : Sp(Expr)) : List(Sp(Expr)) = lay_universe(expr_layer(), e)
defs.doc: Every node of an expression, root first, in source order.

defs.name: an_where
defs.doc: Every node satisfying a predicate, in source order.

defs.name: an_size
defs.source: fn an_size(e : Sp(Expr)) : Int = lay_size(expr_layer(), e)
defs.doc: The number of nodes in an expression.

defs.name: an_depth
defs.source: fn an_depth(e : Sp(Expr)) : Int = lay_depth(expr_layer(), e)
defs.doc: The height of an expression: `1` at a leaf.

defs.name: an_spans
defs.source: fn an_spans(e : Sp(Expr)) : List(Span) = map(span_of, an_nodes(e))
defs.doc: The span of every node, root first, in source order.

defs.name: an_var_uses
defs.source:
fn an_var_uses(e : Sp(Expr)) : List((String, Span)) =
  concat_map(an_var_use, an_nodes(e))
defs.doc: Every variable occurrence: the identifier and the exact span it covers. This is the occurrence table an editor tool wants, and the one place a purely syntactic tool should stop: it says where a name is written, never what it refers to.

defs.name: an_var_use
defs.source:
fn an_var_use(n : Sp(Expr)) : List((String, Span)) =
  match node_of(n) of
    EVar(name) => [(name, span_of(n))]
    _ => []

defs.name: an_var_names
defs.source:
fn an_var_names(e : Sp(Expr)) : List(String) =
  an_dedup(map(an_use_name, an_var_uses(e)), Nil)
defs.doc: Every name written as a variable, in first-occurrence order and without repeats.

defs.name: an_use_name
an_uses_of
defs.source:
fn an_uses_of(name : String, e : Sp(Expr)) : Int =
  length(filter(\(u) -> an_use_name(u) == name, an_var_uses(e)))
defs.doc: How many times a name is written as a variable.

defs.name: an_calls
defs.source: fn an_calls(e : Sp(Expr)) : List(Sp(Expr)) = filter(an_is_call, an_nodes(e))
defs.doc: Every call site, in source order.

defs.name: an_is_call
defs.source:
fn an_is_call(n : Sp(Expr)) : Bool =
  match node_of(n) of
    ECall(_, _) => true
    _ => false
defs.doc: Whether a node is an application. The predicate `an_calls` filters on, made public so a rewrite can scope a rule to call sites without restating it.

defs.name: an_call_targets
defs.source:
fn an_call_targets(e : Sp(Expr)) : List(String) =
  concat_map(an_call_target, an_nodes(e))
defs.doc: The name of every directly called function, in source order. A call whose head is not a plain variable (a field access, a lambda, a computed callee) contributes nothing rather than a guess.

defs.name: an_call_target
defs.source:
fn an_call_target(n : Sp(Expr)) : List(String) =
  match node_of(n) of
    ECall(f, _) =>
      match node_of(f) of
        EVar(name) => [name]
        _ => []
    _ => []

defs.name: an_holes
defs.source: fn an_holes(e : Sp(Expr)) : List(Span) = concat_map(an_hole, an_nodes(e))
defs.doc: The span of every typed hole, in source order: what a completion tool asks for first.

defs.name: an_hole
defs.source:
fn an_hole(n : Sp(Expr)) : List(Span) =
  match node_of(n) of
    EHole(_) => [span_of(n)]
    _ => []

defs.name: an_any
defs.source:
fn an_any(q : (Sp(Expr)) -> Bool ! {| f}, e : Sp(Expr)) : Bool ! { | f} =
  lay_any(expr_layer(), q, e)
defs.doc: Whether any node satisfies the predicate, short-circuiting on the first hit.

defs.name: ExprCensus
defs.source:
type ExprCensus = ExprCensus {
  nodes: Int,
  vars: Int,
  calls: Int,
  binds: Int,
  holes: Int
}
defs.doc: A shape census of one expression: the counts a size heuristic, a lint threshold, or a complexity report is built from. `nodes` is every node, `vars` every variable occurrence, `calls` every application, `holes` every typed hole, and `binds` every form that introduces a name (a let, a mutable declaration, a lambda, a match, a for loop, a comprehension), counted once per form rather than once per name it binds.

defs.name: an_census
defs.source:
fn an_census(e : Sp(Expr)) : ExprCensus =
  lay_summarize(expr_layer(), an_measure, an_add, an_zero(), e)
defs.doc: Count every shape in one walk. The combining operation is field-wise addition, which is what `lay_summarize` was shaped for: one pass, one caller-supplied monoid, no repeated traversals.

defs.name: an_zero
an_one
an_measure
defs.source:
fn an_measure(n : Sp(Expr)) : ExprCensus =
  match node_of(n) of
    EVar(_) => an_one(1, 0, 0, 0)
    ECall(_, _) => an_one(0, 1, 0, 0)
    EHole(_) => an_one(0, 0, 0, 1)
    ELet(_, _, _) => an_one(0, 0, 1, 0)
    EVarDecl(_, _, _) => an_one(0, 0, 1, 0)
    ELam(_, _) => an_one(0, 0, 1, 0)
    EMatch(_, _) => an_one(0, 0, 1, 0)
    EFor(_, _, _, _) => an_one(0, 0, 1, 0)
    EComp(_, _, _, _) => an_one(0, 0, 1, 0)
    _ => an_one(0, 0, 0, 0)

defs.name: an_add
an_dedup
defs.source:
fn an_dedup(xs : List(String), seen : List(String)) : List(String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Nil
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if elem(x, seen) then
        an_dedup(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(x, an_dedup(rest, Cons(x, seen)))

defs.name: Sp
defs.source: type Sp(a) = Sp { node: a, span: Span, synth: Bool }
defs.doc: A parsed node with its byte span and the parse-sugar bit. Expressions and patterns are spanned; `synth` is set when the parser rewrote surface sugar into this node rather than reading it verbatim.

defs.name: Suffix
defs.source: type Suffix = SufNone | SufI64 | SufU64
defs.doc: An integer literal's optional width suffix: `i64`, `u64`, or none.

defs.name: Kind
defs.source:
type Kind
  = KType
  | KRow
  | KNat
  | KFun(Kind, Kind)
defs.doc: A kind: the classifier of a type parameter. Ground kinds classify types, rows, and type-level naturals; `KFun` is the kind of a type constructor.

defs.name: EffLabel
defs.source: type EffLabel = EffLabel { name: String, args: List(Ty) }
defs.doc: One effect label: an effect name applied to zero or more type arguments, as it appears in an effect row or an effect alias.

defs.name: Row
defs.source: type Row = Row { labels: List(EffLabel), tail: Option(String) }
defs.doc: An effect row: the labels present plus an optional row-variable tail. The empty row and a tail-less label list share this one shape.

defs.name: Ty
defs.source:
type Ty
  = TyInt
  | TyI64
  | TyU64
  | TyBool
  | TyUnit
  | TyFloat
  | TyChar
  | TyStr
  | TyVar(String)
  | TyApp(String, List(Ty))
  | TyState(Int)
  | TyForall(List(String), Ty)
  | TyFun(List(Ty), Row, Ty)
  | TyCon(String, List(Ty))
  | TyTuple(List(Ty))
  | TyUnboxedTuple(List(Ty))
  | TyUnboxedRecord(List(CField))
  | TyRowLit(Row)
  | TyNat(Int)
  | TyUsage(Ty, List(String))
defs.doc: A surface type. Ground types, type variables, applications, function types with an effect row, saturated constructors, tuples, unboxed aggregates, row literals, type-level naturals, and usage-qualified types.

defs.name: CField
defs.source: type CField = CField { name: String, ty: Ty }
defs.doc: A named field carrying a type: a record constructor field or an unboxed record field.

defs.name: NamedExpr
defs.source: type NamedExpr = NamedExpr { name: String, value: Sp(Expr) }
defs.doc: A named field carrying an expression: a record literal field, a record update field, a where binding, or a converter override.

defs.name: Expr
defs.source:
type Expr
  = EInt(String, Suffix)
  | EFloat(String)
  | EChar(String)
  | EBool(Bool)
  | EUnit
  | EStr(String)
  | EVar(String)
  | EHole(String)
  | EBin(String, Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | ENeg(Sp(Expr))
  | EIf(Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | ELet(String, Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | ELam(List(Param), Sp(Expr))
  | ECall(Sp(Expr), List(Sp(Expr)))
  | EPipe(Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | EMatch(Sp(Expr), List(Arm))
  | EList(List(Sp(Expr)))
  | ETuple(List(Sp(Expr)))
  | EField(Sp(Expr), String)
  | EUnboxedTuple(List(Sp(Expr)))
  | EUnboxedRecord(List(NamedExpr))
  | EUnboxedField(Sp(Expr), String)
  | ERecord(String, List(NamedExpr))
  | ERecordUpdate(Sp(Expr), String, List(NamedExpr))
  | EPathUpdate(Sp(Expr), List(PathUpdate))
  | EHandle(Sp(Expr), List(HandlerArm), Bool)
  | EMask(String, Sp(Expr))
  | EInst(Sp(Expr), List(String))
  | EIndex(Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | EIndexSet(Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | EAnn(Sp(Expr), Ty)
  | EMarker(String)
  | ENamedHandle(String, Sp(Expr), List(HandlerArm))
  | EVarDecl(String, Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | EAssign(String, Sp(Expr))
  | EIndexAssign(Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | EThrow(String, List(Sp(Expr)))
  | ETryCatch(Sp(Expr), List(CatchArm))
  | EFor(String, Sp(Expr), List(Qual), Sp(Expr))
  | EWhile(Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | ELoop(Sp(Expr))
  | EBreak
  | EContinue
  | EReturn(Sp(Expr))
  | EComp(Sp(Expr), String, Sp(Expr), List(Qual))
  | EDefault(Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | ETransact(Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | EProbe(String, Sp(Expr))
  | EReflect(String, String)
  | EOptChain(Sp(Expr), String)
  | ERange(List(Sp(Expr)), Sp(Expr))
  | ECompose(String, Sp(Expr), Sp(Expr))
  | EReadPath(Sp(Expr), List(PathStep))
defs.doc: A surface expression. One constructor per node kind the exporter emits, including the desugarable surface forms (loops, comprehensions, throw and try-catch, path reads and updates) that the parser records before lowering.

defs.name: Arm
defs.source: type Arm = Arm { pat: Sp(Pat), guard: Option(Sp(Expr)), body: Sp(Expr) }
defs.doc: One match arm: a spanned pattern, an optional boolean guard, and the body taken when the pattern matches and the guard holds.

defs.name: HandlerArm
defs.source:
type HandlerArm
  = HReturn(String, Sp(Expr))
  | HOp(String, List(String), String, Sp(Expr))
  | HOnce(String, List(String), Sp(Expr))
  | HVal(String, Sp(Expr))
  | HNever(String, List(String), Sp(Expr))
defs.doc: One arm of an effect handler: the return clause, a full operation clause binding the resumption, or the `once`, `val`, and `never` sugars.

defs.name: CatchArm
defs.doc: One catch arm of a try-catch: the error name, the binders for its payload, and the handler body.

defs.name: Qual
defs.source: type Qual = QGuard(Sp(Expr)) | QBind(String, Sp(Expr))
defs.doc: One qualifier of a for-loop or comprehension: a boolean guard or a binding generator.

defs.name: PathStep
defs.source:
type PathStep
  = PSField(String)
  | PSEach
  | PSCase(String)
  | PSIndex(Sp(Expr))
  | PSWhere(Sp(Expr))
defs.doc: One step of an optic path: a field, every element, a case selection, an index, or a where filter.

defs.name: PathOp
defs.source: type PathOp = POSet(Sp(Expr)) | POModify(Sp(Expr))
defs.doc: The write at the end of an optic path: set to a value or modify by a function.

defs.name: PathUpdate
defs.source: type PathUpdate = PathUpdate { path: List(PathStep), op: PathOp }
defs.doc: One update in a path-update expression: the path walked and the write performed at its end.

defs.name: Pat
defs.source:
type Pat
  = PWild
  | PVar(String)
  | PInt(String, Suffix)
  | PFloat(String)
  | PChar(String)
  | PBool(Bool)
  | PCtor(String, List(Sp(Pat)))
  | PTuple(List(Sp(Pat)))
  | PRecord(String, List(PatField), Bool)
  | POr(List(Sp(Pat)))
defs.doc: A surface pattern: wildcards, variables, literals, constructor and tuple patterns, record patterns with an optional rest, and alternations. An alternation is expanded into one match arm per alternative before the checker, so it appears only in the surface seam.

defs.name: PatField
defs.source: type PatField = PatField { name: String, pat: Sp(Pat) }
defs.doc: One field of a record pattern: the field name and the pattern bound to it.

defs.name: Param
defs.source:
type Param = Param {
  name: String,
  pat: Option(Sp(Pat)),
  ty: Option(Ty),
  is_borrow: Bool,
  dflt: Option(Sp(Expr))
}
defs.doc: A function parameter: its name, the pattern it was written as if it was written as one rather than named, an optional type annotation, whether it is taken by borrow, and an optional default expression. A pattern parameter's name is synthesized from its position, so the pattern is the half of it the source wrote.

defs.name: Constraint
defs.source: type Constraint = Constraint { cls: String, ty: Ty, span: Span }
defs.doc: A class constraint on a type: the class name, the constrained type, and its span.

defs.name: Decl
defs.source:
type Decl = Decl {
  name: String,
  params: List(Param),
  ret: Option(Ty),
  eff: Option(Row),
  constraints: List(Constraint),
  body: Sp(Expr),
  wheres: List(NamedExpr),
  reqs: List(Sp(Expr)),
  enss: List(Ensure),
  measure: Option(Sp(Expr)),
  is_test: Bool,
  totality: Option(String),
  fip_word: Option(String),
  is_replayable: Bool,
  is_no_alloc: Bool,
  span: Span
}
defs.doc: A function, constant, or logic-function declaration, with every optional clause the parser can attach: effect row, constraints, where bindings, requires and ensures, a decreases measure, and the totality and resource modifiers.

defs.name: Ensure
defs.source: type Ensure = Ensure { binder: String, expr: Sp(Expr) }
defs.doc: One ensures clause: the binder for the result and the postcondition expression over it.

defs.name: CtorShape
defs.source: type CtorShape = CPositional(List(Ty)) | CRecord(List(CField))
defs.doc: The shape of a data constructor: a positional argument list or a named field list.

defs.name: Ctor
defs.source: type Ctor = Ctor { name: String, shape: CtorShape }
defs.doc: One data constructor: its name and its argument shape.

defs.name: Deriving
defs.source: type Deriving = Deriving { name: String, span: Span }
defs.doc: One derived class on a data declaration: the class name and its span.

defs.name: Method
defs.source: type Method = Method { name: String, ty: Ty }
defs.doc: One class method signature: the method name and its declared type.

defs.name: EffOp
defs.doc: One operation of an effect declaration: its name, parameter types, result type, and optional resumption grade.

defs.name: Rung
defs.source:
type Rung = Rung {
  name: String,
  base: Option(String),
  fields: List(RungField),
  frozen: Option(String),
  span: Span
}
defs.doc: One rung of a stable type: the version name, an optional base to inherit from, its fields, and an optional frozen marker.

defs.name: RungField
defs.source: type RungField = RungField { name: String, ty: Ty, dflt: Option(Sp(Expr)) }
defs.doc: One field of a stable rung: the field name, its type, and an optional default expression.

defs.name: Converter
defs.doc: One converter between stable rungs: the direction, the from and to rung names, the base expression, overriding field bindings, and dropped fields.

defs.name: MigrationRoute
defs.source: type MigrationRoute = MAuto | MVersion(MigrationDir, MigrationDir)
defs.doc: The route of a stable migration: automatic, or an explicit upgrade and downgrade pair.

defs.name: MigrationDir

esc_char
defs.source:
fn esc_char(c : Int) : String =
  if c == 34 then
    "\\\""
  elif c == 92 then
    "\\\\"
  elif c == 8 then
    "\\b"
  elif c == 12 then
    "\\f"
  elif c == 10 then
    "\\n"
  elif c == 13 then
    "\\r"
  elif c == 9 then
    "\\t"
  elif c < 32 then
    "\\u00{hex2(c)}"
  else
    str_of_char(chr(c))

defs.source:
fn hex_digit(n : Int) : String =
  str_of_char(chr(if n < 10 then 48 + n else 97 + n - 10))

defs.name: hex2
defs.source: fn hex2(c : Int) : String = "{hex_digit(c / 16)}{hex_digit(c % 16)}"

defs.name: needs_escape
defs.source: fn needs_escape(c : Int) : Bool = c == 34 || c == 92 || c < 32

defs.name: jesc
defs.source: fn jesc(s : String) : String = str_join("", jesc_go(s, 0, 0, []))

defs.name: jesc_go
defs.source:
fn jesc_go(s : String, run : Int, i : Int, acc : List(String)) : List(String) =
  if i >= str_len(s) then
    reverse(if run < i then Cons(substring(s, run, i - run), acc) else acc)
  elif needs_escape(char_at(s, i)) then
    let acc2 =
      if run < i then
        Cons(substring(s, run, i - run), acc)
      else
        acc
    jesc_go(s, i + 1, i + 1, Cons(esc_char(char_at(s, i)), acc2))
  else
    jesc_go(s, run, i + 1, acc)

defs.name: spaces
defs.source:
fn spaces(n : Int) : String =
  if n <= 0 then
    ""
  else
    concat("  ", spaces(n - 2))

defs.name: render
defs.source:
fn render(j : Json, ind : Int) : String =
  match j of
    JNull => "null"
    JBool(b) =>
      if b then
        "true"
      else
        "false"
    JInt(n) => show_int(n)
    JFloat(x) => show_float(x)
    JStr(s) => "\"{jesc(s)}\""
    JArr(items) =>
      match items of
        Nil => "[]"
        _ =>
          let inner = str_join(
              ",\n",
              map(\(x) -> "{spaces(ind + 2)}{render(x, ind + 2)}", items),
            )
          "[\n{inner}\n{spaces(ind)}]"
    JObj(fields) =>
      match fields of
        Nil => "\{\}"
        _ =>
          let inner =
            str_join(",\n", map(\(kv) -> render_field(kv, ind + 2), fields))
          "\{\n{inner}\n{spaces(ind)}\}"

defs.name: encode_tokens
defs.source:
fn encode_tokens(d : TokensDoc) : String =
  render(
      JObj([
          ("schema", JStr(d.schema)),
          ("compiler", JStr(d.compiler)),
          (
              "source",
              JObj([
                  ("digest", JStr(d.source.digest)),
                  ("text", JStr(d.source.text)),
                ]),
            ),
          ("raw", JArr(map(token_json, d.raw))),
          ("parse", JArr(map(token_json, d.parse))),
          ("trivia", JArr(map(trivia_json, d.trivia))),
        ]),
      0,
    )
defs.doc: Encode a token document back to the exact artifact bytes the compiler emits: `encode_tokens` after `decode_tokens` is byte-identity on every well-formed export.

fn enc_ty(t : Ty) : Json =
  match t of
    TyInt => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_int())])
    TyI64 => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_i64())])
    TyU64 => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_u64())])
    TyBool => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_bool())])
    TyUnit => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_unit())])
    TyFloat => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_float())])
    TyChar => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_char())])
    TyStr => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_str())])
    TyVar(n) => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_var()), ("name", JStr(n))])
    TyApp(h, args) =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_ty_app()), ("head", JStr(h))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_ty, args)),
        ]))
    TyState(n) => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_state()), ("cell", JInt(n))])
    TyForall(vars, b) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_ty_forall()),
          arrf("vars", map(JStr, vars)),
          ("ty", enc_ty(b)),
        ])
    TyFun(ps, row, ret) =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_ty_fun())],
          omit_list("params", map(enc_ty, ps)),
          [("effects", enc_row(row)), ("ret", enc_ty(ret))],
        ]))
    TyCon(n, args) =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_ty_con()), ("name", JStr(n))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_ty, args)),
        ]))
    TyTuple(items) =>
      node_obj([kf(tag_ty_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_ty, items))])
    TyUnboxedTuple(items) =>
      node_obj([kf(tag_ty_unboxed_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_ty, items))])
    TyUnboxedRecord(fs) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_ty_unboxed_record()),
          arrf("fields", map(enc_cfield, fs)),
        ])
    TyRowLit(row) => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_row()), ("row", enc_row(row))])
    TyNat(n) => node_obj([kf(tag_ty_nat()), ("value", JInt(n))])
    TyUsage(b, facts) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_ty_usage()),
          ("ty", enc_ty(b)),
          arrf("facts", map(JStr, facts)),
        ])

defs.name: enc_expr_node
defs.source:
fn enc_expr_node(e : Expr) : List((String, Json)) =
  match e of
    EInt(v, suf) =>
      append([kf(tag_expr_int()), ("value", JStr(v))], suffix_frag(suf))
    EFloat(v) => [kf(tag_expr_float()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    EChar(v) => [kf(tag_expr_char()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    EBool(b) => [kf(tag_expr_bool()), ("value", JBool(b))]
    EUnit => [kf(tag_expr_unit())]
    EStr(v) => [kf(tag_expr_str()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    EVar(n) => [kf(tag_expr_var()), ("name", JStr(n))]
    EHole(n) => [kf(tag_expr_hole()), ("name", JStr(n))]
    EBin(op, l, r) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_bin()),
          ("op", JStr(op)),
          ("lhs", enc_expr(l)),
          ("rhs", enc_expr(r)),
        ]
    ENeg(a) => [kf(tag_expr_neg()), ("expr", enc_expr(a))]
    EIf(c, t, f) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_if()),
          ("cond", enc_expr(c)),
          ("then", enc_expr(t)),
          ("else", enc_expr(f)),
        ]
    ELet(n, v, b) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_let()),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          ("value", enc_expr(v)),
          ("body", enc_expr(b)),
        ]
    ELam(ps, b) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_lam())],
          omit_list("params", map(enc_param, ps)),
          [("body", enc_expr(b))],
        ])
    ECall(h, args) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_call()), ("head", enc_expr(h))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_expr, args)),
        ])
    EPipe(l, r) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_pipe()), ("lhs", enc_expr(l)), ("rhs", enc_expr(r))]
    EMatch(s, arms) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_match()),
          ("scrutinee", enc_expr(s)),
          arrf("arms", map(enc_arm, arms)),
        ]
    EList(items) => [kf(tag_expr_list()), arrf("items", map(enc_expr, items))]
    ETuple(items) => [kf(tag_expr_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_expr, items))]
    EField(b, n) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_field()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("name", JStr(n))]
    EUnboxedTuple(items) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_unboxed_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_expr, items))]
    EUnboxedRecord(fs) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_unboxed_record()), arrf("fields", map(enc_named, fs))]
    EUnboxedField(b, n) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_unboxed_field()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("name", JStr(n))]
    ERecord(n, fs) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_record()),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          arrf("fields", map(enc_named, fs)),
        ]
    ERecordUpdate(b, n, fs) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_record_update()),
          ("base", enc_expr(b)),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          arrf("fields", map(enc_named, fs)),
        ]
    EPathUpdate(b, us) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_path_update()),
          ("base", enc_expr(b)),
          arrf("updates", map(enc_pupdate, us)),
        ]
    EHandle(b, arms, partial) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_handle()), ("body", enc_expr(b))],
          omit_list("arms", map(enc_harm, arms)),
          flag_field("partial", partial),
        ])
    EMask(eff, b) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_mask()), ("effect", JStr(eff)), ("body", enc_expr(b))]
    EInst(b, args) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_inst()),
          ("expr", enc_expr(b)),
          arrf("args", map(JStr, args)),
        ]
    EIndex(b, i) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_index()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("index", enc_expr(i))]
    EIndexSet(b, i, v) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_index_set()),
          ("expr", enc_expr(b)),
          ("index", enc_expr(i)),
          ("value", enc_expr(v)),
        ]
    EAnn(b, t) => [kf(tag_expr_ann()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("ty", enc_ty(t))]
    EMarker(m) => [kf(tag_expr_marker()), ("marker", JStr(m))]
    ENamedHandle(n, b, arms) =>
      flatten([
          [
              kf(tag_expr_named_handle()),
              ("name", JStr(n)),
              ("body", enc_expr(b)),
            ],
          omit_list("arms", map(enc_harm, arms)),
        ])
    EVarDecl(n, v, b) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_var_decl()),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          ("value", enc_expr(v)),
          ("body", enc_expr(b)),
        ]
    EAssign(n, v) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_assign()), ("name", JStr(n)), ("value", enc_expr(v))]
    EIndexAssign(b, i, v) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_index_assign()),
          ("expr", enc_expr(b)),
          ("index", enc_expr(i)),
          ("value", enc_expr(v)),
        ]
    EThrow(n, args) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_throw()), ("name", JStr(n))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_expr, args)),
        ])
    ETryCatch(b, arms) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_try_catch()),
          ("body", enc_expr(b)),
          arrf("arms", map(enc_catch, arms)),
        ]
    EFor(bnd, seq, quals, b) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_expr_for()), ("binder", JStr(bnd)), ("seq", enc_expr(seq))],
          omit_list("quals", map(enc_qual, quals)),
          [("body", enc_expr(b))],
        ])
    EWhile(c, b) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_while()), ("cond", enc_expr(c)), ("body", enc_expr(b))]
    ELoop(b) => [kf(tag_expr_loop()), ("body", enc_expr(b))]
    EBreak => [kf(tag_expr_break())]
    EContinue => [kf(tag_expr_continue())]
    EReturn(v) => [kf(tag_expr_return()), ("value", enc_expr(v))]
    EComp(h, bnd, seq, quals) =>
      flatten([
          [
              kf(tag_expr_comprehension()),
              ("head", enc_expr(h)),
              ("binder", JStr(bnd)),
              ("seq", enc_expr(seq)),
            ],
          omit_list("quals", map(enc_qual, quals)),
        ])
    EDefault(b, f) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_default()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("fallback", enc_expr(f))]
    ETransact(b, f) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_transact()),
          ("body", enc_expr(b)),
          ("fallback", enc_expr(f)),
        ]
    EProbe(n, b) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_probe()), ("name", JStr(n)), ("body", enc_expr(b))]
    EReflect(d, n) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_reflect()), ("decl", JStr(d)), ("name", JStr(n))]
    EOptChain(b, n) =>
      [kf(tag_expr_opt_chain()), ("expr", enc_expr(b)), ("name", JStr(n))]
    ERange(prefix, e) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_range()),
          arrf("prefix", map(enc_expr, prefix)),
          ("end", enc_expr(e)),
        ]
    ECompose(dir, l, r) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_compose()),
          ("dir", JStr(dir)),
          ("lhs", enc_expr(l)),
          ("rhs", enc_expr(r)),
        ]
    EReadPath(b, steps) =>
      [
          kf(tag_expr_read_path()),
          ("base", enc_expr(b)),
          arrf("path", map(enc_pstep, steps)),
        ]

defs.source:
fn enc_harm(a : HandlerArm) : Json =
  match a of
    HReturn(b, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_return()),
          ("binder", JStr(b)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])
    HOp(op, ps, rk, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_op()),
          ("op", JStr(op)),
          arrf("params", map(JStr, ps)),
          ("resume", JStr(rk)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])
    HOnce(op, ps, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_once()),
          ("op", JStr(op)),
          arrf("params", map(JStr, ps)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])
    HVal(n, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_val()),
          ("name", JStr(n)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])
    HNever(op, ps, body) =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_harm_never()),
          ("op", JStr(op)),
          arrf("params", map(JStr, ps)),
          ("body", enc_expr(body)),
        ])

fn enc_pat_node(p : Pat) : List((String, Json)) =
  match p of
    PWild => [kf(tag_pat_wild())]
    PVar(n) => [kf(tag_pat_var()), ("name", JStr(n))]
    PInt(v, suf) =>
      append([kf(tag_pat_int()), ("value", JStr(v))], suffix_frag(suf))
    PFloat(v) => [kf(tag_pat_float()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    PChar(v) => [kf(tag_pat_char()), ("value", JStr(v))]
    PBool(b) => [kf(tag_pat_bool()), ("value", JBool(b))]
    PCtor(n, args) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_pat_ctor()), ("name", JStr(n))],
          omit_list("args", map(enc_pat, args)),
        ])
    PTuple(items) => [kf(tag_pat_tuple()), arrf("items", map(enc_pat, items))]
    PRecord(n, fs, rest) =>
      flatten([
          [kf(tag_pat_record()), ("name", JStr(n))],
          omit_list("fields", map(enc_pfield, fs)),
          flag_field("rest", rest),
        ])
    POr(alts) => [kf(tag_pat_or()), arrf("alts", map(enc_pat, alts))]

fn enc_decl(d : Decl, kind : String) : List((String, Json)) =

      omit_list("wheres", map(enc_named, d.wheres)),
      omit_list("requires", map(enc_expr, d.reqs)),
      omit_list("ensures", map(enc_ensure, d.enss)),
      opt_field("decreases", d.measure, enc_expr),
      flag_field("test", d.is_test),
      opt_str_field("total", d.totality),
      opt_str_field("fip", d.fip_word),
      flag_field("replayable", d.is_replayable),
      flag_field("no_alloc", d.is_no_alloc),
      [("span", span_json(d.span))],
    ])

defs.name: enc_item
defs.source:
fn enc_item(it : Item) : Json =
  match it of
    IImport {
      path = path,
      mod_alias = ma,
      names = names,
      glob = glob,
      reexport = reexport,
      span = span,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_import())],
          opt_str_field("alias", ma),
          opt_field("names", names, \(ns) -> JArr(map(JStr, ns))),
          [arrf("path", map(JStr, path))],
          flag_field("glob", glob),
          flag_field("reexport", reexport),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
        ]))
    IData {
      nt = nt,
      name = name,
      params = params,
      param_kinds = pks,
      ctors = ctors,
      derivs = derivs,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [
              kf(if nt then tag_item_newtype() else tag_item_data()),
              ("name", JStr(name)),
            ],
          omit_strs("params", params),
          omit_list("param_kinds", map(enc_kind, pks)),
          omit_list("ctors", map(enc_ctor, ctors)),
          omit_list("deriving", map(enc_deriving, derivs)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IEffect {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      ops = ops,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_effect()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_strs("params", params),
          omit_list("ops", map(enc_effop, ops)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IError {
      name = name,
      arg_types = params,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_error()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_list("params", map(enc_ty, params)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IEffAlias {
      name = name,
      labels = labels,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_effect_alias()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_list("labels", map(enc_efflabel, labels)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    ISynonym {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      ty = ty,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_type_synonym()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_strs("params", params),
          [("ty", enc_ty(ty)), ("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IClass {
      name = name,
      param = param,
      supers = supers,
      methods = methods,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_class()), ("name", JStr(name)), ("param", JStr(param))],
          omit_strs("supers", supers),
          omit_list("methods", map(enc_method, methods)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IInstance {
      name = name,
      cls = cls,
      head = head,
      context = context,
      decls = methods,
      span = span,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [
              kf(tag_item_instance()),
              ("name", JStr(name)),
              ("class", JStr(cls)),
              ("head", enc_ty(head)),
            ],
          omit_list("context", map(enc_constraint, context)),
          omit_list("methods", map(enc_method_decl, methods)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
        ]))
    ICanonical { cls = cls, head = head, name = name, span = span } =>
      node_obj([
          kf(tag_item_canonical()),
          ("class", JStr(cls)),
          ("head", enc_ty(head)),
          ("name", JStr(name)),
          ("span", span_json(span)),
        ])
    IPattern {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      forty = forty,
      viewfn = viewfn,
      makefn = makefn,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_pattern()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_strs("params", params),
          [("for", JStr(forty)), ("view", enc_expr(viewfn))],
          opt_field("make", makefn, enc_expr),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IStable {
      name = name,
      rungs = rungs,
      converters = converters,
      migrations = migrations,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = dep,
    } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          [kf(tag_item_stable()), ("name", JStr(name))],
          omit_list("rungs", map(enc_rung, rungs)),
          omit_list("converters", map(enc_converter, converters)),
          omit_list("migrations", map(enc_migration, migrations)),
          [("span", span_json(span))],
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))
    IDecl { decl = decl, declkind = declkind, vis = vis, dep = dep } =>
      node_obj(flatten([
          enc_decl(decl, declkind),
          vis_frag(vis),
          dep_frag(dep),
        ]))

fn dec_kind(j : Json, path : String) : Kind ! {Decode} =
  match j of
    JStr(s) =>
      if s == tag_kind_type() then
        KType
      elif s == tag_kind_row() then
        KRow
      elif s == tag_kind_nat() then
        KNat
      else
        fail_decode(CodecError { path = path, reason = "unknown kind `{s}`" })
    JObj(fields) =>
      let a = req_at(fields, "from", path, dec_kind)
      KFun(a, req_at(fields, "to", path, dec_kind))
    _ => fail_decode(CodecError { path = path, reason = "expected a kind" })

fn dec_ty_kind2(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Ty ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_ty_state() then
    TyState(req_at(fields, "cell", path, int_of))
  elif kind == tag_ty_forall() then
    let vars = strs_at(fields, "vars", path)
    TyForall(vars, req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_fun() then
    let ps = list_at(fields, "params", path, dec_ty)
    let row = req_at(fields, "effects", path, dec_row)
    TyFun(ps, row, req_at(fields, "ret", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_con() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    TyCon(n, list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_tuple() then
    TyTuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_unboxed_tuple() then
    TyUnboxedTuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_ty_unboxed_record() then
    TyUnboxedRecord(list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_cfield))
  elif kind == tag_ty_row() then
    TyRowLit(req_at(fields, "row", path, dec_row))
  elif kind == tag_ty_nat() then
    TyNat(req_at(fields, "value", path, int_of))
  elif kind == tag_ty_usage() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty)
    TyUsage(b, strs_at(fields, "facts", path))
  else
    fail_decode(
        CodecError {
          path = "{path}.kind",
          reason = "unknown type kind `{kind}`"
        },

defs.name: dec_expr_node
defs.source:
fn dec_expr_node(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_int() then
    EInt(str_at(fields, "value", path), dec_suffix(fields))
  elif kind == tag_expr_float() then
    EFloat(str_at(fields, "value", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_char() then
    EChar(str_at(fields, "value", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_bool() then
    EBool(req_at(fields, "value", path, bool_of))
  elif kind == tag_expr_unit() then
    EUnit
  elif kind == tag_expr_str() then
    EStr(str_at(fields, "value", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_var() then
    EVar(str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_hole() then
    EHole(str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_bin() then
    let op = str_at(fields, "op", path)
    let l = req_at(fields, "lhs", path, dec_expr)
    EBin(op, l, req_at(fields, "rhs", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_neg() then
    e1(fields, path, "expr", ENeg)
  else
    dec_expr_node2(kind, fields, path)

defs.name: dec_expr_node2
defs.source:
fn dec_expr_node2(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_if() then
    e3(fields, path, "cond", "then", "else", EIf)
  elif kind == tag_expr_let() then
    s2e(fields, path, "name", "value", "body", ELet)
  elif kind == tag_expr_lam() then
    let ps = list_at(fields, "params", path, dec_param)
    ELam(ps, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_call() then
    let h = req_at(fields, "head", path, dec_expr)
    ECall(h, list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_pipe() then
    e2(fields, path, "lhs", "rhs", EPipe)
  elif kind == tag_expr_match() then
    let s = req_at(fields, "scrutinee", path, dec_expr)
    EMatch(s, list_at(fields, "arms", path, dec_arm))
  elif kind == tag_expr_list() then
    EList(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_tuple() then
    ETuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_field() then
    es(fields, path, "expr", "name", EField)
  elif kind == tag_expr_unboxed_tuple() then
    EUnboxedTuple(list_at(fields, "items", path, dec_expr))
  else
    dec_expr_node3(kind, fields, path)

defs.name: dec_expr_node3
defs.source:
fn dec_expr_node3(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_unboxed_record() then
    EUnboxedRecord(list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_named))
  elif kind == tag_expr_unboxed_field() then
    es(fields, path, "expr", "name", EUnboxedField)
  elif kind == tag_expr_record() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    ERecord(n, list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_named))
  elif kind == tag_expr_record_update() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "base", path, dec_expr)
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    ERecordUpdate(b, n, list_at(fields, "fields", path, dec_named))
  elif kind == tag_expr_path_update() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "base", path, dec_expr)
    EPathUpdate(b, list_at(fields, "updates", path, dec_pupdate))
  elif kind == tag_expr_handle() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr)
    EHandle(
        b,
        list_at(fields, "arms", path, dec_harm),
        flagf(fields, "partial"),
      )
  elif kind == tag_expr_mask() then
    se(fields, path, "effect", "body", EMask)
  elif kind == tag_expr_inst() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr)
    EInst(b, strs_at(fields, "args", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_index() then
    e2(fields, path, "expr", "index", EIndex)
  elif kind == tag_expr_index_set() then
    e3(fields, path, "expr", "index", "value", EIndexSet)
  else
    dec_expr_node4(kind, fields, path)

defs.name: dec_expr_node4
defs.source:
fn dec_expr_node4(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_ann() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "expr", path, dec_expr)
    EAnn(b, req_at(fields, "ty", path, dec_ty))
  elif kind == tag_expr_marker() then
    EMarker(str_at(fields, "marker", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_named_handle() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    let b = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr)
    ENamedHandle(n, b, list_at(fields, "arms", path, dec_harm))
  elif kind == tag_expr_var_decl() then
    s2e(fields, path, "name", "value", "body", EVarDecl)
  elif kind == tag_expr_assign() then
    se(fields, path, "name", "value", EAssign)
  elif kind == tag_expr_index_assign() then
    e3(fields, path, "expr", "index", "value", EIndexAssign)
  elif kind == tag_expr_throw() then
    let n = str_at(fields, "name", path)
    EThrow(n, list_at(fields, "args", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_try_catch() then
    let b = req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr)
    ETryCatch(b, list_at(fields, "arms", path, dec_catch))
  elif kind == tag_expr_for() then
    let bnd = str_at(fields, "binder", path)
    let seq = req_at(fields, "seq", path, dec_expr)
    let quals = list_at(fields, "quals", path, dec_qual)
    EFor(bnd, seq, quals, req_at(fields, "body", path, dec_expr))
  elif kind == tag_expr_while() then
    e2(fields, path, "cond", "body", EWhile)
  else
    dec_expr_node5(kind, fields, path)

defs.name: dec_expr_node5
defs.source:
fn dec_expr_node5(
  kind : String,
  fields : List((String, Json)),
  path : String
) : Expr ! {Decode} =
  if kind == tag_expr_loop() then
    e1(fields, path, "body", ELoop)
  elif kind == tag_expr_break() then
    EBreak
  elif kind == tag_expr_continue() then
    EContinue
  elif kind == tag_expr_return() then
    e1(fields, path, "value", EReturn)
  elif kind == tag_expr_comprehension() then
    let h = req_at(fields, "head", path, dec_expr)
    let bnd = str_at(fields, "binder", path)
    let seq = req_at(fields, "seq", path, dec_expr)
    EComp(h, bnd, seq, list_at(fields, "quals", path, dec_qual))
  elif kind == tag_expr_default() then
    e2(fields, path, "expr", "fallback", EDefault)
  elif kind == tag_expr_transact() then
    e2(fields, path, "body", "fallback", ETransact)
  elif kind == tag_expr_probe() then
    se(fields, path, "name", "body", EProbe)
  elif kind == tag_expr_reflect() then
    EReflect(str_at(fields, "decl", path), str_at(fields, "name", path))
  elif kind == tag_expr_opt_chain() then
    es(fields, path, "expr", "name", EOptChain)
  elif kind == tag_expr_range() then
    let prefix = list_at(fields, "prefix", path, dec_expr)
    ERange(prefix, req_at(fields, "end", path, dec_expr))
  else
    dec_expr_node6(kind, fields, path)
