defs.name: lx_interp
lx_interp_go
defs.ty: (String, Int, Int, Int, Buf, Int, Bool, List(Syntax.Token.Token)) -> Result(List(Syntax.Token.Token), Syntax.Lex.LexError)
defs.source:
fn lx_interp_go(
  text : String,
  p : Int,
  hi : Int,
  endq : Int,
  seg : Buf,
  seg_from : Int,
  first : Bool,
  acc : List(Token)
) : Result(List(Token), LexError) =
  if p >= hi then
    let iend =
      Token {
        kind = TIEnd,
        span = Span { lo = seg_from, hi = endq },
        value = Some(string_of_buf(seg))
      }
    Ok(reverse(Cons(iend, acc)))
  else
    let b = byte_at(text, p)
    if b == lx_b("\\") then
      if p + 1 >= hi then
        Err(LxInvalid(p))
      else
        match lx_esc_byte(byte_at(text, p + 1)) of
          Some(db) =>
            lx_interp_go(
                text,
                p + 2,
                hi,
                endq,
                buf_push(seg, db),
                seg_from,
                first,
                acc,
              )
          None => Err(LxInvalid(p + 1))
    elif b == lx_b("\{") then
      match lx_scan_hole(text, p + 1, hi) of
        None => Err(LxUntermHole(p))
        Some(close) =>
          if lx_blank_range(text, p + 1, close) then
            Err(LxEmptyHole(p))
          else
            let sk =
              if first then
                TIStart
              else
                TIMid
            let segtok =
              Token {
                kind = sk,
                span = Span { lo = seg_from, hi = p + 1 },
                value = Some(string_of_buf(seg))
              }
            match lx_hole_tokens(text, p + 1, close) of
              Err(e) => Err(e)
              Ok(htoks) =>
                let acc2 = lx_rev_append(htoks, Cons(segtok, acc))
                lx_interp_go(
                    text,
                    close + 1,
                    hi,
                    endq,
                    buf_empty(),
                    close,
                    false,
                    acc2,
                  )
    else
      lx_interp_go(
          text,
          p + lx_cp_len(b),
          hi,
          endq,
          lx_push_cp(text, p, seg),
          seg_from,
          first,
          acc,
        )

defs.name: lex_raw
defs.source:
fn lex_raw(text : String) : Result(LexRaw, LexError) =
  lx_loop(text, byte_len(text), 0, 0, Nil, Nil, lx_tabs())
defs.doc: Tokenize `text` into the raw token stream and its interleaved trivia, reproducing the compiler's `lex_raw` layer: kinds, byte spans, decoded values, interpolation splitting, comments, and blank-line runs. No layout virtuals.

defs.name: lex_incomplete
defs.source:
fn lex_incomplete(text : String) : Bool =
  match lex_raw(text) of
    Err(LxUntermStr(_)) => true
    Err(LxUntermHole(_)) => true
    Err(_) => false
    Ok(_) => false
defs.doc: Whether `text` fails to lex only because a string literal or interpolation hole runs off the end: the lexer-observable half of the compiler's `incomplete` classification, telling an interactive reader to keep reading rather than to reject. Any other lexing failure, or a clean lex, is complete.

defs.name: lx_loop
defs.ty: (String, Int, Int, Int, List(Syntax.Token.Token), List(Syntax.Token.Trivia), Syntax.Lex@LxTabs) -> Result(Syntax.Lex.LexRaw, Syntax.Lex.LexError)
defs.source:
fn lx_loop(
  text : String,
  n : Int,
  i : Int,
  cursor : Int,
  toks : List(Token),
  trivs : List(Trivia),
  tb : LxTabs
) : Result(LexRaw, LexError) =
  if i >= n then
    Ok(LexRaw { tokens = reverse(toks), trivia = reverse(trivs) })
  else
    let c = byte_at(text, i)
    if lx_ws(c) then
      lx_loop(text, n, lx_skip_ws(text, i, n), cursor, toks, trivs, tb)
    elif lx_raw_opens(text, i, n) then
      match lx_raw_end(text, i + 4, n) of
        None => Err(LxUntermStr(i))
        Some(q) =>
          let endq = q + 3
          let tok =
            Token {
              kind = TStr,
              span = Span { lo = i, hi = endq },
              value = Some(lx_raw_cook(text, i + 4, q))
            }
          lx_loop(
              text,
              n,
              endq,
              endq,
              Cons(tok, toks),
              lx_add_blank(trivs, text, cursor, i),
              tb,
            )
    elif c == lx_b("\"") then
      match lx_str_end(text, i, n) of
        Err(e) => Err(e)
        Ok(endq) =>
          let trivs2 = lx_add_blank(trivs, text, cursor, i)
          if lx_has_hole(text, i + 1, endq - 1) then
            match lx_interp(text, i, endq) of
              Err(e) => Err(e)
              Ok(itoks) =>
                lx_loop(
                    text,
                    n,
                    endq,
                    endq,
                    lx_rev_append(itoks, toks),
                    trivs2,
                    tb,
                  )
          else
            match lx_cook(text, i, i + 1, endq - 1) of
              Err(e) => Err(e)
              Ok(v) =>
                let tok =
                  Token {
                    kind = TStr,
                    span = Span { lo = i, hi = endq },
                    value = Some(v)
                  }
                lx_loop(text, n, endq, endq, Cons(tok, toks), trivs2, tb)
    else
      match lx_classify(text, i, n, tb) of
        LxErr(e) => Err(e)
        LxComment(j) =>
          let trivs2 = Cons(
              TComment(Span { lo = i, hi = j }),
              lx_add_blank(trivs, text, cursor, i),
            )
          lx_loop(text, n, j, j, toks, trivs2, tb)
        LxTok(k, j) =>
          let tok =
            Token {
              kind = k,
              span = Span { lo = i, hi = j },
              value = lx_value(text, k, i, j)
            }
          let trivs2 = lx_add_blank(trivs, text, cursor, i)
          lx_loop(text, n, j, j, Cons(tok, toks), trivs2, tb)

defs.name: ParseFailure
defs.source: type ParseFailure = ParseLex(LexError) | ParseSyntax(Diagnostic)
defs.doc: A source-level parse failure, preserving whether lexing or parsing refused the input.

defs.name: parse_program_tokens
defs.source:
fn parse_program_tokens(
  tokens : List(Token),
  stop : Int
) : Result(List(Item), Diagnostic) =
  match parse_program(cursor_of(tokens, stop), depth_budget()) of
    PTook(items, _) => Ok(items)
    PStuck(c) => Err(cursor_diagnostic(c))
    PFault(d) => Err(d)
defs.doc: Parse an already-laid-out whole-program token stream.

defs.name: parse_source
defs.source:
fn parse_source(text : String) : Result(List(Item), ParseFailure) =
  parse_source_budgeted(depth_budget(), text)
defs.doc: Lex, lay out, and parse one complete Prism source file.

defs.name: parse_source_budgeted
defs.source:
fn parse_source_budgeted(
  budget : Int,
  text : String
) : Result(List(Item), ParseFailure) =
  match layout(text) of
    Err(e) => Err(ParseLex(e))
    Ok(tokens) =>
      match parse_program(cursor_of(tokens, str_len(text)), budget) of
        PTook(items, _c) => Ok(items)
        PStuck(c) => Err(ParseSyntax(cursor_diagnostic(c)))
        PFault(d) => Err(ParseSyntax(d))
defs.doc: `parse_source` under an explicit recursion budget. The default budget is deep enough that no realistic program meets it; a harness probing the depth contract (acceptance below the budget, the structured refusal beyond it) passes a small budget here instead of paying for thousands of nesting levels. The refusal machinery exercised is identical at every budget.

defs.name: parse_expr_tokens
defs.source:
fn parse_expr_tokens(
  tokens : List(Token),
  stop : Int
) : Result(Sp(Expr), Diagnostic) =
  let c0 = cursor_of(tokens, stop)
  match parse_expr(c0, depth_budget()) of
    PStuck(c) => Err(cursor_diagnostic(c))
    PFault(d) => Err(d)
    PTook(expr, c1) =>
      match cursor_expect_end(c1) of
        Took(_, _) => Ok(expr)
        Stuck(c2) => Err(cursor_diagnostic(c2))
defs.doc: Parse one expression from a token cursor and require complete consumption.

defs.name: parse_expr_source
defs.source:
fn parse_expr_source(text : String) : Result(Sp(Expr), ParseFailure) =
  match layout(text) of
    Err(e) => Err(ParseLex(e))
    Ok(tokens) =>
      let c0 = cursor_of(tokens, str_len(text))
      match take_kind(c0, TVOpen) of
        PStuck(c1) => Err(ParseSyntax(cursor_diagnostic(c1)))
        PFault(d) => Err(ParseSyntax(d))
        PTook(_, c1) =>
          match parse_expr(c1, depth_budget()) of
            PStuck(c2) => Err(ParseSyntax(cursor_diagnostic(c2)))
            PFault(d) => Err(ParseSyntax(d))
            PTook(expr, c2) =>
              match take_kind(c2, TVClose) of
                PStuck(c3) => Err(ParseSyntax(cursor_diagnostic(c3)))
                PFault(d) => Err(ParseSyntax(d))
                PTook(_, c3) =>
                  match cursor_expect_end(c3) of
                    Took(_, _) => Ok(expr)
                    Stuck(c4) => Err(ParseSyntax(cursor_diagnostic(c4)))
defs.doc: Lex, lay out, and parse a standalone expression. Layout wraps a complete input in its top-level virtual block, so the expression entry removes that envelope before requiring the stream end.

defs.name: authored
defs.doc: An authored node covering `[lo, hi)`: written by the user, spanned by its own tokens.

defs.name: synthesized
defs.doc: A synthesized node covering `[lo, hi)`: invented by the parser while desugaring an authored form, spanning the source it stands for.

defs.name: zero_width
defs.doc: A zero-width node at `at`: a piece that corresponds to no source text of its own, carrying the position it conceptually occupies.

defs.name: widened
defs.doc: Rewrap a node with a delimiter's extent: parentheses and brackets widen the span of the node they enclose while the node itself is unchanged.

defs.name: operands_span
defs.source:
fn operands_span(l : Sp(a), r : Sp(b)) : Span =
  Span { lo = l.span.lo, hi = r.span.hi }
defs.doc: The span an infix application covers: from its left operand's start to its right operand's end.

defs.name: PVis
defs.source: type PVis = VPrivate | VPublic | VOpaque deriving (Eq)

defs.name: RetSpec
defs.source: type RetSpec = RetSpec { ret: Option(Ty), eff: Option(Row), no_alloc: Bool }

defs.name: FnSpec
defs.source:
type FnSpec = FnSpec {
  ret: Option(Ty),
  eff: Option(Row),
  constraints: List(Constraint),
  reqs: List(Sp(Expr)),
  enss: List(Ensure),
  measure: Option(Sp(Expr)),
  no_alloc: Bool
}

defs.name: vis_value
defs.source:
fn vis_value(v : PVis) : Option(String) =
  match v of
    VPrivate => None
    VPublic => Some("pub")
    VOpaque => Some("opaque")

defs.name: is_sep
defs.source: fn is_sep(c : Cursor) : Bool = at_kind(c, TVSemi) || at_fixed(c, ",")

defs.name: skip_sep
defs.source:
fn skip_sep(c : Cursor) : Cursor =
  if is_sep(c) then
    cursor_advance(c)
  else
    c

defs.name: at_close
defs.source:
fn at_close(c : Cursor, close : String) : Bool =
  if close == "v\}" then
    at_kind(c, TVClose)
  else
    at_fixed(c, close)

defs.name: take_close
defs.source:
fn take_close(c : Cursor, close : String) : Parsed(Token) =
  if close == "v\}" then
    take_kind(c, TVClose)
  else
    take_fixed(c, close)

defs.name: name_token
defs.source:
fn name_token(c : Cursor) : Parsed(String) =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    Some(TIdent) => take_word(c, TIdent)
    Some(TUid) => take_word(c, TUid)
    Some(TQual) => take_word(c, TQual)
    _ => PStuck(cursor_note_name(c, "name"))

defs.name: upper_name
defs.source:
fn upper_name(c : Cursor) : Parsed(String) =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    Some(TUid) => take_word(c, TUid)
    Some(TQual) => take_word(c, TQual)
    _ => PStuck(cursor_note_name(c, "uid"))

defs.name: path_parts
defs.source: fn path_parts(s : String) : List(String) = split(char_at(".", 0), s)

defs.name: parse_visibility
defs.source:
fn parse_visibility(c : Cursor) : (PVis, Cursor) =
  if at_fixed(c, "pub") then
    (VPublic, cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_fixed(c, "opaque") then
    (VOpaque, cursor_advance(c))
  else
    (VPrivate, c)

defs.name: parse_program
defs.source:
fn parse_program(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(Item)) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(d, c1) =>
      match take_kind(c1, TVOpen) of
        PFault(e) => PFault(e)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_items(c2, d, Nil) of
            PFault(e) => PFault(e)
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PTook(items, c3) =>
              match take_kind(c3, TVClose) of
                PFault(e) => PFault(e)
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match cursor_expect_end(c4) of
                    Took(_, c5) => PTook(items, c5)
                    Stuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
defs.doc: Parse the complete post-layout token stream as a whole source file.

defs.name: parse_items
defs.source:
fn parse_items(c : Cursor, depth : Int, rev : List(Item)) : Parsed(List(Item)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  elif at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
    parse_items(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match parse_item(c, depth) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(item, c1) =>
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PFault(refuse(cursor_span(c), "declaration parser made no progress"))
        else
          parse_items(skip_sep(c1), depth, Cons(item, rev))

defs.name: parse_item
defs.source:
fn parse_item(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Item) =
  if at_kind(c, TIdent) && peek_word(c) == "deprecated" then
    parse_deprecated(c, depth)
  else
    let (vis, c1) = parse_visibility(c)
    let saved = c1
    if (vis == VPublic && at_kind(c1, TIdent) && peek_word(c1) == "deprecated") then
      parse_deprecated(c1, depth)
    elif at_fixed(c1, "import") then
      parse_import(saved, c1, vis)
    elif at_fixed(c1, "type") then
      parse_data(saved, c1, vis, false, depth)
    elif at_fixed(c1, "newtype") then
      parse_data(saved, c1, vis, true, depth)
    elif at_fixed(c1, "effect") then
      parse_effect_item(c1, depth, vis_value(vis))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "alias") then
      parse_alias_item(c1, depth, vis_value(vis))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "class") then
      parse_class_item(c1, depth, vis_value(vis))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "instance") then
      parse_instance_item(c1, depth, vis_value(vis))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "canonical") then
      parse_canonical_item(c1, depth, vis_value(vis))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "pattern") then
      parse_pattern_decl(c1, depth, vis_value(vis))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "stable") then
      parse_stable_decl(c1, depth, vis_value(vis))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "error") then
      parse_error_decl(saved, c1, vis, depth)
    elif at_fixed(c1, "let") then
      parse_const(saved, c1, vis, depth)
    elif at_fixed(c1, "logic") then
      parse_logic_fn(c1, vis, depth)
    elif (at_fixed(c1, "fn")
        || at_fixed(c1, "replayable")
        || at_fixed(c1, "fip")
        || at_fixed(c1, "fbip")
        || at_kind(c1, TIdent)) then
      parse_fn(saved, c1, vis, depth, "fn")
    else
      PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, "declaration"))
defs.doc: Parse one top-level item, including its optional visibility prefix.

defs.name: parse_deprecated
defs.source:
fn parse_deprecated(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_word(c1, TStr) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PTook(msg, c2) =>
          match take_kind(c2, TVSemi) of
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              if (at_kind(c3, TIdent) && peek_word(c3) == "deprecated") then
                PFault(
                    refuse(
                        cursor_since(saved, c2),
                        "a `deprecated` annotation must be followed by a declaration",
                      ),
                  )
              else
                match parse_item(c3, depth) of
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PTook(item, c4) =>
                    match attach_deprecation(item, msg) of
                      None =>
                        PFault(
                            refuse(
                                cursor_since(saved, c2),
                                "a `deprecated` annotation must precede a named declaration",
                              ),
                          )
                      Some(tagged) => PTook(tagged, c4)

defs.name: attach_deprecation
defs.source:
fn attach_deprecation(item : Item, msg : String) : Option(Item) =
  match item of
    IImport { .. } => None
    IInstance { .. } => None
    ICanonical { .. } => None
    IData {
      nt = nt,
      name = name,
      params = params,
      param_kinds = pks,
      ctors = ctors,
      derivs = derivs,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = _,
    } =>
      Some(
          IData {
            nt = nt,
            name = name,
            params = params,
            param_kinds = pks,
            ctors = ctors,
            derivs = derivs,
            span = span,
            vis = vis,
            dep = Some(msg)
          },
        )
    IEffect {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      ops = ops,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = _,
    } =>
      Some(
          IEffect {
            name = name,
            params = params,
            ops = ops,
            span = span,
            vis = vis,
            dep = Some(msg)
          },
        )
    IError { name = name, arg_types = args, span = span, vis = vis, dep = _ } =>
      Some(
          IError {
            name = name,
            arg_types = args,
            span = span,
            vis = vis,
            dep = Some(msg)
          },
        )
    IEffAlias { name = name, labels = labels, span = span, vis = vis, dep = _ } =>
      Some(
          IEffAlias {
            name = name,
            labels = labels,
            span = span,
            vis = vis,
            dep = Some(msg)
          },
        )
    ISynonym {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      ty = ty,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = _,
    } =>
      Some(
          ISynonym {
            name = name,
            params = params,
            ty = ty,
            span = span,
            vis = vis,
            dep = Some(msg)
          },
        )
    IClass {
      name = name,
      param = param,
      supers = supers,
      methods = methods,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = _,
    } =>
      Some(
          IClass {
            name = name,
            param = param,
            supers = supers,
            methods = methods,
            span = span,
            vis = vis,
            dep = Some(msg)
          },
        )
    IPattern {
      name = name,
      params = params,
      forty = forty,
      viewfn = viewfn,
      makefn = makefn,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = _,
    } =>
      Some(
          IPattern {
            name = name,
            params = params,
            forty = forty,
            viewfn = viewfn,
            makefn = makefn,
            span = span,
            vis = vis,
            dep = Some(msg)
          },
        )
    IStable {
      name = name,
      rungs = rungs,
      converters = converters,
      migrations = migrations,
      span = span,
      vis = vis,
      dep = _,
    } =>
      Some(
          IStable {
            name = name,
            rungs = rungs,
            converters = converters,
            migrations = migrations,
            span = span,
            vis = vis,
            dep = Some(msg)
          },
        )
    IDecl { decl = decl, declkind = kind, vis = vis, dep = _ } =>
      Some(IDecl { decl = decl, declkind = kind, vis = vis, dep = Some(msg) })

defs.name: parse_import
defs.source:
fn parse_import(saved : Cursor, c : Cursor, vis : PVis) : Parsed(Item) =
  match take_fixed(c, "import") of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match upper_name(c1) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PTook(path, c2) =>
          match parse_import_alias(c2) of
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PTook(mod_alias, c3) =>
              match parse_import_names(c3) of
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PTook(spec, c4) =>
                  match spec of
                    (names, glob) =>
                      PTook(
                          IImport {
                            path = path_parts(path),
                            mod_alias = mod_alias,
                            names = names,
                            glob = glob,
                            reexport = vis == VPublic,
                            span = cursor_since(saved, c4)
                          },
                          c4,
                        )

defs.name: parse_import_alias
defs.source:
fn parse_import_alias(c : Cursor) : Parsed(Option(String)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "as") then
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TUid) of
      PTook(n, c1) => PTook(Some(n), c1)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.name: parse_import_names
defs.source:
fn parse_import_names(c : Cursor) : Parsed((Option(List(String)), Bool)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "(")) then
    PTook((None, false), c)
  else
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "..") then
      match take_fixed(cursor_advance(c1), ")") of
        PTook(_, c2) => PTook((None, true), c2)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    else
      match parse_names_until(c1, ")", Nil) of
        PTook(ns, c2) => PTook((Some(ns), false), c2)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)

defs.name: parse_names_until
defs.source:
fn parse_names_until(
  c : Cursor,
  close : String,
  rev : List(String)
) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if at_fixed(c, close) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match name_token(c) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(n, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_names_until(cursor_advance(c1), close, Cons(n, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, close) then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(n, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, close))

defs.name: parse_data
defs.source:
fn parse_data(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  vis : PVis,
  is_newtype : Bool,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  match take_word(c1, TUid) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PTook(name, c2) =>
      match parse_type_params(c2) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PTook(tp, c3) =>
          match take_fixed(c3, "=") of
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PTook(_, c4) =>
              match parse_ctors(c4, depth, Nil) of
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PTook(ctor_spec, c5) =>
                  match ctor_spec of
                    (ctors, opened) =>
                      match parse_deriving(c5, Nil) of
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PTook(derivs, c6) =>
                          let c7 =
                            if opened && at_kind(c6, TVClose) then
                              cursor_advance(c6)
                            else
                              c6
                          match tp of
                            (params, kinds) =>
                              if (is_newtype && not(newtype_shape(ctors))) then
                                PFault(
                                    refuse(
                                        cursor_since(saved, c7),
                                        "a newtype must have exactly one constructor with one field",
                                      ),
                                  )
                              else
                                PTook(
                                    IData {
                                      nt = is_newtype,
                                      name = name,
                                      params = params,
                                      param_kinds = if is_newtype then Nil else kinds,
                                      ctors = ctors,
                                      derivs = derivs,
                                      span = cursor_since(saved, c7),
                                      vis = vis_value(vis),
                                      dep = None
                                    },
                                    c7,
                                  )

defs.name: newtype_shape
defs.source:
fn newtype_shape(ctors : List(Ctor)) : Bool =
  match ctors of
    Cons(c, Nil) =>
      match c.shape of
        CPositional(Cons(_, Nil)) => true
        CRecord(Cons(_, Nil)) => true
        _ => false
    _ => false

defs.name: parse_type_params
defs.source:
fn parse_type_params(c : Cursor) : Parsed((List(String), List(Kind))) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "(")) then
    PTook((Nil, Nil), c)
  else
    parse_type_params_go(cursor_advance(c), Nil, Nil)

defs.name: parse_type_params_go
defs.source:
fn parse_type_params_go(
  c : Cursor,
  names : List(String),
  kinds : List(Kind)
) : Parsed((List(String), List(Kind))) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook((reverse(names), reverse(kinds)), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match parse_kind_ann(c1) of
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PTook(kind, c2) =>
            if at_fixed(c2, ",") then
              parse_type_params_go(
                  cursor_advance(c2),
                  Cons(name, names),
                  Cons(kind, kinds),
                )
            elif at_fixed(c2, ")") then
              PTook(
                  (reverse(Cons(name, names)), reverse(Cons(kind, kinds))),
                  cursor_advance(c2),
                )
            else
              PStuck(cursor_note_name(c2, ")"))

defs.name: parse_kind_ann
defs.source:
fn parse_kind_ann(c : Cursor) : Parsed(Kind) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, ":")) then
    PTook(KType, c)
  else
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TUid) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(k, c1) =>
        if k == "Type" then
          PTook(KType, c1)
        elif k == "Row" then
          PTook(KRow, c1)
        elif k == "Nat" then
          PTook(KNat, c1)
        else
          PFault(refuse(cursor_since(c, c1), "unknown kind `{k}`"))

defs.name: parse_ctors
defs.source:
fn parse_ctors(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Ctor)
) : Parsed((List(Ctor), Bool)) =
  let opened = at_kind(c, TVOpen)
  let c1 =
    if opened then
      cursor_advance(c)
    else
      c
  match parse_ctors_go(c1, depth, rev, opened) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PTook(ctors, c2) => PTook((ctors, opened), c2)

defs.name: parse_ctors_go
defs.source:
fn parse_ctors_go(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Ctor),
  virtual : Bool
) : Parsed(List(Ctor)) =
  let after_sep =
    if at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
      cursor_advance(c)
    else
      c
  let c0 =
    if at_fixed(after_sep, "|") then
      cursor_advance(after_sep)
    else
      after_sep
  if virtual && at_kind(c0, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c0))
  elif virtual && at_fixed(c0, "deriving") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c0)
  elif not(virtual) && not(at_kind(c0, TUid)) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c0)
  else
    match parse_ctor(c0, depth) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(ctor, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, "|") || at_kind(c1, TVSemi) then
          parse_ctors_go(c1, depth, Cons(ctor, rev), virtual)
        elif virtual && at_kind(c1, TVClose) then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(ctor, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PTook(reverse(Cons(ctor, rev)), c1)

defs.name: parse_ctor
defs.source:
fn parse_ctor(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Ctor) =
  match take_word(c, TUid) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      if at_fixed(c1, "\{") then
        match parse_ctor_fields(cursor_advance(c1), depth, Nil) of
          PTook(fs, c2) => PTook(Ctor { name = name, shape = CRecord(fs) }, c2)
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      elif at_fixed(c1, "(") then
        match parse_types_until(cursor_advance(c1), ")", depth, Nil) of
          PTook(ts, c2) =>
            PTook(Ctor { name = name, shape = CPositional(ts) }, c2)
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      else
        PTook(Ctor { name = name, shape = CPositional(Nil) }, c1)

defs.name: parse_ctor_fields
defs.source:
fn parse_ctor_fields(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(CField)
) : Parsed(List(CField)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, ":") of
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_type(c2, depth) of
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PTook(ty, c3) =>
                let field = CField { name = name, ty = ty }
                if at_fixed(c3, ",") then
                  parse_ctor_fields(cursor_advance(c3), depth, Cons(field, rev))
                elif at_fixed(c3, "\}") then
                  PTook(reverse(Cons(field, rev)), cursor_advance(c3))
                else
                  let c4 = cursor_note(c3, TFixed(","))
                  PStuck(cursor_note(c4, TFixed("\}")))

defs.name: parse_types_until
defs.source:
fn parse_types_until(
  c : Cursor,
  close : String,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Ty)
) : Parsed(List(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, close) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match parse_type_arg(c, depth) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(ty, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_types_until(cursor_advance(c1), close, depth, Cons(ty, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, close) then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(ty, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          let c2 = cursor_note(c1, TFixed(","))
          PStuck(cursor_note(c2, TFixed(close)))

defs.name: parse_deriving
defs.source:
fn parse_deriving(c : Cursor, rev : List(Deriving)) : Parsed(List(Deriving)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "deriving")) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  else
    match take_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "(") of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(_, c1) => parse_deriving_go(c1, Nil)

defs.name: parse_deriving_go
defs.source:
fn parse_deriving_go(
  c : Cursor,
  rev : List(Deriving)
) : Parsed(List(Deriving)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    let start = c
    match take_word(c, TUid) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        let d = Deriving { name = name, span = cursor_since(start, c1) }
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_deriving_go(cursor_advance(c1), Cons(d, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, ")") then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(d, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, ")"))

defs.name: parse_error_decl
defs.source:
fn parse_error_decl(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  vis : PVis,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TUid) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      if at_fixed(c1, "(") then
        match parse_types_until(cursor_advance(c1), ")", depth, Nil) of
          PTook(ts, c2) =>
            PTook(
                IError {
                  name = name,
                  arg_types = ts,
                  span = cursor_since(saved, c2),
                  vis = vis_value(vis),
                  dep = None
                },
                c2,
              )
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      else
        PTook(
            IError {
              name = name,
              arg_types = Nil,
              span = cursor_since(saved, c1),
              vis = vis_value(vis),
              dep = None
            },
            c1,
          )

defs.name: parse_logic_fn
defs.source:
fn parse_logic_fn(c : Cursor, vis : PVis, depth : Int) : Parsed(Item) =
  parse_fn(cursor_advance(c), cursor_advance(c), vis, depth, "logic-fn")

defs.name: parse_fn
defs.source:
fn parse_fn(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  vis : PVis,
  depth : Int,
  kind : String
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match parse_fn_mods(c) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(mods, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "fn") of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match take_word(c2, TIdent) of
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PTook(name, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, "(") of
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_params(c4, depth, 0, Nil) of
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PTook(params, c5) =>
                      match parse_fn_spec(c5, depth) of
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PTook(spec, c6) =>
                          match take_fixed(c6, "=") of
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                            PTook(_, c7) =>
                              match parse_expr_or_block(c7, depth) of
                                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                PStuck(c8) => PStuck(c8)
                                PTook(body, c8) =>
                                  match parse_where_block(c8, depth) of
                                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                    PStuck(c9) => PStuck(c9)
                                    PTook(wheres, c9) =>
                                      match mods of
                                        (
                                          is_test,
                                          totality,
                                          fip_mode,
                                          is_replayable
                                        ) =>
                                          let decl =
                                            Decl {
                                              name = name,
                                              params = params,
                                              ret = spec.ret,
                                              eff = spec.eff,
                                              constraints = spec.constraints,
                                              body = body,
                                              wheres = wheres,
                                              reqs = spec.reqs,
                                              enss = spec.enss,
                                              measure = spec.measure,
                                              is_test = is_test,
                                              totality = totality,
                                              fip_word = fip_mode,
                                              is_replayable = is_replayable,
                                              is_no_alloc = spec.no_alloc,
                                              span = cursor_since(saved, c9)
                                            }
                                          PTook(
                                              IDecl {
                                                decl = decl,
                                                declkind = kind,
                                                vis = vis_value(vis),
                                                dep = None
                                              },
                                              c9,
                                            )

defs.name: parse_fn_spec
defs.source:
fn parse_fn_spec(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(FnSpec) =
  match parse_ret_spec(c, depth) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(ret, c1) =>
      match parse_given(c1, depth) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PTook(constraints, c2) =>
          match parse_requires(c2, depth, Nil) of
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PTook(reqs, c3) =>
              match parse_ensures(c3, depth, Nil) of
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PTook(enss, c4) =>
                  match parse_decreases(c4, depth) of
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PTook(measure, c5) =>
                      PTook(
                          FnSpec {
                            ret = ret.ret,
                            eff = ret.eff,
                            constraints = constraints,
                            reqs = reqs,
                            enss = enss,
                            measure = measure,
                            no_alloc = ret.no_alloc
                          },
                          c5,
                        )

defs.name: parse_ret_spec
defs.source:
fn parse_ret_spec(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(RetSpec) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, ":")) then
    PTook(RetSpec { ret = None, eff = None, no_alloc = false }, c)
  else
    let after_colon = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(after_colon, "!") then
      parse_retired_ret_spec(c, after_colon, depth)
    else
      match parse_type_head(after_colon, depth) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c1) =>
          -- RetAnn also has the two retired `: ! ...` productions. Their
          -- leading bang is part of this entry-state expectation union.
          if c1.pos == after_colon.pos then
            PStuck(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("!")))
          else
            PStuck(c1)
        PTook(raw, c1) =>
          if at_fixed(c1, "!") then
            match parse_effect_row(c1, depth) of
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
              PTook(row, c2) =>
                match attach_return_effect(raw, row) of
                  Some(with_eff) =>
                    match lift_noalloc(with_eff) of
                      (ret, no_alloc) =>
                        PTook(
                            RetSpec {
                              ret = Some(ret),
                              eff = None,
                              no_alloc = no_alloc
                            },
                            c2,
                          )
                  None =>
                    match lift_noalloc(raw) of
                      (ret, no_alloc) =>
                        PTook(
                            RetSpec {
                              ret = Some(ret),
                              eff = Some(row),
                              no_alloc = no_alloc
                            },
                            c2,
                          )
          else
            match lift_noalloc(raw) of
              (ret, no_alloc) =>
                PTook(
                    RetSpec {
                      ret = Some(ret),
                      eff = None,
                      no_alloc = no_alloc
                    },
                    c1,
                  )

defs.name: parse_retired_ret_spec
defs.source:
fn parse_retired_ret_spec(
  start : Cursor,
  bang : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(RetSpec) =
  let braced = at_fixed(cursor_advance(bang), "\{")
  match parse_effect_row(bang, depth) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match parse_type(c1, depth) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c2) =>
          if not(braced) && c2.pos == c1.pos then
            PStuck(cursor_note(c2, TFixed("\{")))
          else
            PStuck(c2)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_since(start, c2),
                  "the effect row now follows the result type: write `: Result ! \{Effects\}` instead of `: !\{Effects\} Result`",
                ),
            )

defs.name: lift_noalloc
defs.source:
fn lift_noalloc(t : Ty) : (Ty, Bool) =
  match t of
    TyUsage(inner, facts) =>
      match facts of
        Cons(f, Nil) =>
          if f == "noalloc" then
            (inner, true)
          else
            (TyUsage(inner, facts), false)
        _ => (TyUsage(inner, facts), false)
    _ => (t, false)

defs.name: attach_return_effect
defs.source:
fn attach_return_effect(t : Ty, row : Row) : Option(Ty) =
  match t of
    TyFun(params, _, cod) => Some(TyFun(params, row, cod))
    TyForall(vars, body) =>
      match attach_return_effect(body, row) of
        Some(inner) => Some(TyForall(vars, inner))
        None => None
    _ => None

defs.name: parse_given
defs.source:
fn parse_given(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(Constraint)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "given")) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    parse_constraints(cursor_advance(c), depth, Nil)

defs.name: parse_constraints
defs.source:
fn parse_constraints(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Constraint)
) : Parsed(List(Constraint)) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TUid) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(cls, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "(") of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_type(c2, depth) of
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PTook(ty, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, ")") of
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  let con = Constraint {
                    cls = cls,
                    ty = ty,
                    span = cursor_since(saved, c4)
                  }
                  if at_fixed(c4, ",") then
                    parse_constraints(cursor_advance(c4), depth, Cons(con, rev))
                  else
                    PTook(reverse(Cons(con, rev)), c4)

defs.name: parse_requires
defs.source:
fn parse_requires(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Sp(Expr))
) : Parsed(List(Sp(Expr))) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "requires")) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  else
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(e, c1) => parse_requires(c1, depth, Cons(e, rev))

defs.name: parse_ensures
defs.source:
fn parse_ensures(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Ensure)
) : Parsed(List(Ensure)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "ensures")) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  else
    match take_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "|") of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(_, c1) =>
        match take_word(c1, TIdent) of
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PTook(binder, c2) =>
            match take_fixed(c2, "|") of
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                match parse_expr(c3, depth) of
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PTook(e, c4) =>
                    parse_ensures(
                        c4,
                        depth,
                        Cons(Ensure { binder = binder, expr = e }, rev),
                      )

defs.name: parse_decreases
defs.source:
fn parse_decreases(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Sp(Expr))) =
  if peek_word(c) /= "decreases" then
    PTook(None, c)
  else
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PTook(e, c1) => PTook(Some(e), c1)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)

defs.name: parse_where_block
defs.source:
fn parse_where_block(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "where")) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    match take_kind(cursor_advance(c), TVOpen) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(_, c1) => parse_where_bindings(c1, depth, Nil)

defs.name: parse_where_bindings
defs.source:
fn parse_where_bindings(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(NamedExpr)
) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
    parse_where_bindings(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PTook(value, c3) =>
                parse_where_bindings(
                    c3,
                    depth,
                    Cons(NamedExpr { name = name, value = value }, rev),
                  )

defs.name: parse_fn_mods
defs.source:
fn parse_fn_mods(c : Cursor) : Parsed((Bool, Option(String), Option(String), Bool)) =
  let (words, c1, remaining) = take_fn_mod_words(c, 3, Nil)
  if fn_mod_follow(c1) then
    match classify_fn_mod_words(words) of
      None =>
        let written = str_join(" ", words)
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(c, c1),
                concat(
                    "`",
                    concat(
                        written,
                        "` is not a declaration modifier; expected `test`, `total`, or `assume total` before `fn`",
                      ),
                  ),
              ),
          )
      Some((is_test, totality)) => parse_reserved_fn_mods(c1, is_test, totality)
  else
    -- DeclMods reduces, and runs its deliberate validation, only when its
    -- lookahead is a reserved modifier or `fn`. A fourth identifier or a
    -- layout boundary is instead a generic miss at that lookahead.
    PStuck(note_fn_mod_follow(c1, remaining > 0, remaining == 2))

defs.name: take_fn_mod_words
defs.source:
fn take_fn_mod_words(
  c : Cursor,
  remaining : Int,
  rev : List(String)
) : (List(String), Cursor, Int) =
  if remaining > 0 && at_kind(c, TIdent) then
    take_fn_mod_words(cursor_advance(c), remaining - 1, Cons(peek_word(c), rev))
  else
    (reverse(rev), c, remaining)

defs.name: fn_mod_follow
defs.source:
fn fn_mod_follow(c : Cursor) : Bool =
  at_fixed(c, "replayable")
    || at_fixed(c, "fip")
    || at_fixed(c, "fbip")
    || at_fixed(c, "fn")

defs.name: note_fn_mod_follow
classify_fn_mod_words
defs.source:
fn classify_fn_mod_words(words : List(String)) : Option((Bool, Option(String))) =
  match words of
    Nil => Some((false, None))
    Cons(a, Nil) =>
      if a == "test" then
        Some((true, None))
      elif a == "total" then
        Some((false, Some("prove")))
      else
        None
    Cons(a, Cons(b, Nil)) =>
      if a == "test" && b == "total" then
        Some((true, Some("prove")))
      elif a == "assume" && b == "total" then
        Some((false, Some("assume")))
      else
        None
    Cons(a, Cons(b, Cons(c, Nil))) =>
      if a == "test" && b == "assume" && c == "total" then
        Some((true, Some("assume")))
      else
        None
    _ => None

defs.name: parse_reserved_fn_mods
defs.ty: (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Bool, Option(String)) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed((Bool, Option(String), Option(String), Bool))
defs.source:
fn parse_reserved_fn_mods(
  c : Cursor,
  is_test : Bool,
  totality : Option(String)
) : Parsed((Bool, Option(String), Option(String), Bool)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "replayable") then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "fip") || at_fixed(c1, "fbip") then
      let mode =
        if at_fixed(c1, "fip") then
          "fip"
        else
          "fbip"
      let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
      if at_fixed(c2, "fn") then
        PTook((is_test, totality, Some(mode), true), c2)
      else
        PStuck(cursor_note(c2, TFixed("fn")))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "fn") then
      PTook((is_test, totality, None, true), c1)
    else
      let c2 = cursor_note(c1, TFixed("fip"))
      let c3 = cursor_note(c2, TFixed("fbip"))
      PStuck(cursor_note(c3, TFixed("fn")))
  elif at_fixed(c, "fip") || at_fixed(c, "fbip") then
    let mode =
      if at_fixed(c, "fip") then
        "fip"
      else
        "fbip"
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "fn") then
      PTook((is_test, totality, Some(mode), false), c1)
    else
      PStuck(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("fn")))
  else
    PTook((is_test, totality, None, false), c)

defs.name: parse_params
defs.source:
fn parse_params(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  index : Int,
  rev : List(Param)
) : Parsed(List(Param)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    let borrowed = at_fixed(c, "borrow")
    let c0 =
      if borrowed then
        cursor_advance(c)
      else
        c
    match parse_pattern(c0, depth) of
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PStuck(c1) =>
        -- At the parameter's first token the closing paren and the borrow
        -- marker are live alternatives beside a pattern start; once anything
        -- of the pattern has been consumed, its own expectations stand alone.
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(c1, TFixed(")")), TFixed("borrow")))
        else
          PStuck(c1)
      PTook(pat, c1) =>
        match parse_param_type(c1, depth) of
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PTook(ty, c2) =>
            let had_default = at_fixed(c2, ":=")
            match parse_param_default(c2, depth) of
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PTook(dflt, c3) =>
                let param =
                  match pat.node of
                    PVar(n) =>
                      Param {
                        name = n,
                        pat = None,
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                    PWild =>
                      Param {
                        name = "_",
                        pat = None,
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                    _ =>
                      Param {
                        name = "arg@{index}",
                        pat = Some(pat),
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                if at_fixed(c3, ",") then
                  parse_params(
                      cursor_advance(c3),
                      depth,
                      index + 1,
                      Cons(param, rev),
                    )
                elif at_fixed(c3, ")") then
                  PTook(reverse(Cons(param, rev)), cursor_advance(c3))
                else
                  -- Param has reduced at this exact position. The enclosing
                  -- comma list and the optional default are all still live.
                  let c4 = cursor_note(c3, TFixed(","))
                  let c5 =
                    if had_default then
                      c4
                    else
                      cursor_note(c4, TFixed(":="))
                  PStuck(cursor_note(c5, TFixed(")")))

defs.name: parse_param_type
defs.source:
fn parse_param_type(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":") then

      PTook(t, c1) => PTook(Some(t), c1)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.source:

      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.name: parse_ret
defs.source:
fn parse_ret(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":") then
