defs.name: parse_const
defs.source:
fn parse_const(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  vis : PVis,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match parse_ret(c1, depth) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PTook(ret, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "=") of
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match parse_expr_or_block(c3, depth) of
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PTook(body, c4) =>
                  let decl =
                    Decl {
                      name = name,
                      params = Nil,
                      ret = ret,
                      eff = None,
                      constraints = Nil,
                      body = body,
                      wheres = Nil,
                      reqs = Nil,
                      enss = Nil,
                      measure = None,
                      is_test = false,
                      totality = None,
                      fip_word = None,
                      is_replayable = false,
                      is_no_alloc = false,
                      span = cursor_since(saved, c4)
                    }
                  PTook(
                      IDecl {
                        decl = decl,
                        declkind = "const",
                        vis = vis_value(vis),
                        dep = None
                      },
                      c4,
                    )

defs.name: at_sep
defs.source: fn at_sep(c : Cursor) : Bool = at_fixed(c, ",") || at_kind(c, TVSemi)

defs.name: skip_sep
defs.source:
fn skip_sep(c : Cursor) : Cursor =
  if at_sep(c) then
    cursor_advance(c)
  else
    c

defs.name: expect_layout_open
defs.source:
fn expect_layout_open(c : Cursor, family : String) : Parsed(Token) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    let member =
      if family == "effect" then
        "operation"
      elif family == "class" then
        "method"
      else
        "member"
    PFault(
        refuse(
            cursor_span(c),
            "{family} bodies use layout: remove the braces and put each {member} on its own indented line",
          ),
      )
  else
    take_kind(c, TVOpen)

defs.name: take_uid
defs.source: fn take_uid(c : Cursor) : Parsed(String) = take_word(c, TUid)

defs.name: take_ident
defs.source: fn take_ident(c : Cursor) : Parsed(String) = take_word(c, TIdent)

defs.name: parse_ty_params
defs.source:
fn parse_ty_params(c : Cursor) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "(")) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    parse_ty_params_go(cursor_advance(c), Nil)

defs.name: parse_ty_params_go
defs.source:
fn parse_ty_params_go(c : Cursor, rev : List(String)) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match take_ident(c) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_ty_params_go(cursor_advance(c1), Cons(name, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, ")") then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(name, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, ")"))

defs.name: parse_given_clause
defs.source:
fn parse_given_clause(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(Constraint)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "given")) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    match parse_constraint(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(first, c1) => parse_given_more(c1, depth, [first])
defs.doc: Parse an optional `given Class(Type), ...` clause.  This is public because ordinary function declarations and the other declaration-family modules use exactly the same qualifier.

defs.name: parse_given_more
defs.source:
fn parse_given_more(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  acc : List(Constraint)
) : Parsed(List(Constraint)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ",") then
    match parse_constraint(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(next, c1) => parse_given_more(c1, depth, append(acc, [next]))
  else
    PTook(acc, c)

defs.name: parse_constraint
defs.source:
fn parse_constraint(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Constraint) =
  let saved = c
  match take_uid(c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(cls, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "(") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_type(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(ty, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, ")") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  PTook(
                      Constraint {
                        cls = cls,
                        ty = ty,
                        span = cursor_since(saved, c4)
                      },
                      c4,
                    )

defs.name: constraint_names
defs.source:
fn constraint_names(cs : List(Constraint)) : List(String) =
  match cs of
    Nil => Nil
    Cons(c, rest) => Cons(c.cls, constraint_names(rest))

defs.name: parse_effect_item
defs.source:
fn parse_effect_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "effect") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_uid(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match parse_ty_params(c2) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(params, c3) =>
              match expect_layout_open(c3, "effect") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_effect_ops(c4, depth, Nil) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(ops, c5) =>
                      match take_kind(c5, TVClose) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(_, c6) =>
                          PTook(
                              IEffect {
                                name = name,
                                params = params,
                                ops = ops,
                                span = cursor_since(saved, c6),
                                vis = vis,
                                dep = None
                              },
                              c6,
                            )
defs.doc: Parse an `effect` item. `c` points at the keyword, and `vis` is the already-decoded visibility prefix (`None`, `Some("pub")`, or `Some("opaque")`).

defs.name: parse_effect_ops
defs.source:
fn parse_effect_ops(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(EffOp)
) : Parsed(List(EffOp)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  elif at_sep(c) then
    parse_effect_ops(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match parse_effect_op(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(op, c1) =>
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_span(c),
                  "effect operation parser made no progress",
                ),
            )
        else
          parse_effect_ops(skip_sep(c1), depth, Cons(op, rev))

defs.name: parse_effect_op
defs.source:
fn parse_effect_op(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(EffOp) =
  let first = peek_word(c)
  let graded = at_kind(c, TIdent) && at_kind(cursor_advance(c), TIdent)
  if graded then
    if first == "never" then
      parse_effect_op_named(cursor_advance(c), depth, Some("never"))
    elif first == "once" then
      parse_effect_op_named(cursor_advance(c), depth, Some("once"))
    elif first == "many" then
      parse_effect_op_named(cursor_advance(c), depth, None)
    else
      PFault(
          refuse(
              cursor_span(c),
              "`{first}` is not a grade: an operation grade is `never`, `once`, or `many`, or omit it for `many`",
            ),
        )
  else
    parse_effect_op_named(c, depth, None)

defs.name: parse_effect_op_named
defs.source:
fn parse_effect_op_named(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  grade : Option(String)
) : Parsed(EffOp) =
  match take_ident(c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "(") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_effect_params(c2, depth, Nil) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(params, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, ":") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_type(c4, depth) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(ret, c5) =>
                      PTook(
                          EffOp {
                            name = name,
                            params = params,
                            ret = ret,
                            grade = grade
                          },
                          c5,
                        )

defs.name: parse_effect_params
defs.source:
fn parse_effect_params(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Ty)
) : Parsed(List(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match parse_effect_param(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(ty, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_effect_params(cursor_advance(c1), depth, Cons(ty, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, ")") then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(ty, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, ")"))

defs.name: parse_effect_param
defs.source:
fn parse_effect_param(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Ty) =
  if at_kind(c, TIdent) && at_fixed(cursor_advance(c), ":") then
    parse_type(cursor_advance(cursor_advance(c)), depth)
  else
    parse_type(c, depth)

defs.name: parse_alias_item
defs.source:
fn parse_alias_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "alias") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_uid(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match parse_ty_params(c2) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(params, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, "=") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  if at_fixed(c4, "\{") then
                    parse_effect_alias_rhs(saved, name, c4, depth, vis)
                  else
                    match parse_type(c4, depth) of
                      PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(ty, c5) =>
                        PTook(
                            ISynonym {
                              name = name,
                              params = params,
                              ty = ty,
                              span = cursor_since(saved, c5),
                              vis = vis,
                              dep = None
                            },
                            c5,
                          )
defs.doc: Parse the shared `alias` family. A brace RHS constructs an effect alias; every other RHS is a type synonym. The optional parameter list is retained only for a synonym, matching the bootstrap AST.

defs.name: parse_effect_alias_rhs
defs.source:
fn parse_effect_alias_rhs(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match parse_alias_labels(cursor_advance(c), depth, Nil) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(labels, c1) =>
      PTook(
          IEffAlias {
            name = name,
            labels = labels,
            span = cursor_since(saved, c1),
            vis = vis,
            dep = None
          },
          c1,
        )

defs.name: parse_alias_labels
defs.source:
fn parse_alias_labels(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(EffLabel)
) : Parsed(List(EffLabel)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match parse_eff_label(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(label, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_alias_labels(cursor_advance(c1), depth, Cons(label, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, "\}") then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(label, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(cursor_note_name(c1, "\}"))

defs.name: parse_class_item
defs.source:
fn parse_class_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "class") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_uid(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "(") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match take_ident(c3) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(param, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, ")") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match parse_given_clause(c5, depth) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(supers, c6) =>
                          parse_class_body(
                              saved,
                              name,
                              param,
                              constraint_names(supers),
                              c6,
                              depth,
                              vis,
                            )
defs.doc: Parse a class declaration, including marker classes without a body and layout bodies containing method signatures.

defs.name: parse_class_body
defs.ty: (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, String, String, List(String), Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int, Option(String)) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(Syntax.Ast.Item)
defs.source:
fn parse_class_body(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  param : String,
  supers : List(String),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    match expect_layout_open(c, "class") of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) => PStuck(c1)
  elif not(at_kind(c, TVOpen)) then
    PTook(
        IClass {
          name = name,
          param = param,
          supers = supers,
          methods = Nil,
          span = cursor_since(saved, c),
          vis = vis,
          dep = None
        },
        c,
      )
  else
    match take_kind(c, TVOpen) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) =>
        match parse_class_methods(c1, depth, Nil) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(methods, c2) =>
            match take_kind(c2, TVClose) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                PTook(
                    IClass {
                      name = name,
                      param = param,
                      supers = supers,
                      methods = methods,
                      span = cursor_since(saved, c3),
                      vis = vis,
                      dep = None
                    },
                    c3,
                  )

defs.name: parse_class_methods
defs.source:
fn parse_class_methods(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Method)
) : Parsed(List(Method)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  elif at_sep(c) then
    parse_class_methods(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match take_ident(c) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, ":") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_type(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(ty, c3) =>
                parse_class_methods(
                    skip_sep(c3),
                    depth,
                    Cons(Method { name = name, ty = ty }, rev),
                  )

defs.name: parse_instance_item
defs.source:
fn parse_instance_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "instance") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_ident(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, ":") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match take_uid(c3) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(cls, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "(") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match parse_type(c5, depth) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(head, c6) =>
                          match take_fixed(c6, ")") of
                            PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PTook(_, c7) =>
                              match parse_given_clause(c7, depth) of
                                PStuck(c8) => PStuck(c8)
                                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                PTook(context, c8) =>
                                  parse_instance_body(
                                      saved,
                                      name,
                                      cls,
                                      head,
                                      context,
                                      c8,
                                      depth,
                                      vis,
                                    )
defs.doc: Parse an instance declaration, including marker instances and layout bodies of complete function declarations. Visibility is accepted for the uniform dispatcher API; the phase-independent instance AST has no visibility field, matching the bootstrap export.

defs.name: parse_instance_body
defs.ty: (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, String, String, Syntax.Ast.Ty, List(Syntax.Ast.Constraint), Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int, Option(String)) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(Syntax.Ast.Item)
defs.source:
fn parse_instance_body(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  cls : String,
  head : Ty,
  context : List(Constraint),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  _vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    match expect_layout_open(c, "instance") of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) => PStuck(c1)
  elif not(at_kind(c, TVOpen)) then
    PTook(
        IInstance {
          name = name,
          cls = cls,
          head = head,
          context = context,
          decls = Nil,
          span = cursor_since(saved, c)
        },
        c,
      )
  else
    match take_kind(c, TVOpen) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) =>
        match parse_instance_methods(c1, depth, Nil) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(methods, c2) =>
            match take_kind(c2, TVClose) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                PTook(
                    IInstance {
                      name = name,
                      cls = cls,
                      head = head,
                      context = context,
                      decls = methods,
                      span = cursor_since(saved, c3)
                    },
                    c3,
                  )

defs.name: parse_instance_methods
defs.source:
fn parse_instance_methods(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Decl)
) : Parsed(List(Decl)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)
  elif at_sep(c) then
    parse_instance_methods(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match parse_method_decl(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(method, c1) =>
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PFault(
              refuse(cursor_span(c), "instance method parser made no progress"),
            )
        else
          parse_instance_methods(skip_sep(c1), depth, Cons(method, rev))

defs.name: parse_method_mods
defs.source:
fn parse_method_mods(c : Cursor) : Parsed((Bool, Option(String), Cursor)) =
  let is_test = peek_word(c) == "test"
  let c1 =
    if is_test then
      cursor_advance(c)
    else
      c
  if peek_word(c1) == "assume" then
    let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
    if peek_word(c2) == "total" then
      PTook((is_test, Some("assume"), cursor_advance(c2)), c)
    else
      PFault(
          refuse(
              cursor_span(c1),
              "`assume` is not a declaration modifier by itself; write `assume total`",
            ),
        )
  elif peek_word(c1) == "total" then
    PTook((is_test, Some("prove"), cursor_advance(c1)), c)
  else
    PTook((is_test, None, c1), c)

defs.name: parse_method_decl
defs.source:
fn parse_method_decl(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Decl) =
  let saved = c
  match parse_method_mods(c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(mods, _) =>
      match mods of
        (is_test, totality, c1) =>
          let is_replayable = at_fixed(c1, "replayable")
          let c2 =
            if is_replayable then
              cursor_advance(c1)
            else
              c1
          let fip_word =
            if at_fixed(c2, "fip") then
              Some("fip")
            elif at_fixed(c2, "fbip") then
              Some("fbip")
            else
              None
          let c3 =
            match fip_word of
              None => c2
              Some(_) => cursor_advance(c2)
          match take_fixed(c3, "fn") of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c4) =>
              match take_ident(c4) of
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(name, c5) =>
                  match take_fixed(c5, "(") of
                    PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c6) =>
                      match parse_method_params(c6, depth, 0, Nil) of
                        PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(params, c7) =>
                          parse_method_after_params(
                              saved,
                              name,
                              params,
                              c7,
                              depth,
                              is_test,
                              totality,
                              fip_word,
                              is_replayable,
                            )

defs.name: parse_method_after_params
defs.ty: (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, String, List(Syntax.Ast.Param), Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int, Bool, Option(String), Option(String), Bool) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(Syntax.Ast.Decl)
defs.source:
fn parse_method_after_params(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  params : List(Param),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  is_test : Bool,
  totality : Option(String),
  fip_word : Option(String),
  is_replayable : Bool
) : Parsed(Decl) =
  match parse_return_ann(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(ann, c1) =>
      match ann of
        (ret0, eff, no_alloc) =>
          match parse_given_clause(c1, depth) of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(constraints, c2) =>
              match parse_requires(c2, depth, Nil) of
                PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(reqs, c3) =>
                  match parse_ensures(c3, depth, Nil) of
                    PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(enss, c4) =>
                      match parse_decreases(c4, depth) of
                        PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(measure, c5) =>
                          match take_fixed(c5, "=") of
                            PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PTook(_, c6) =>
                              match parse_expr_or_block(c6, depth) of
                                PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                PTook(body, c7) =>
                                  match parse_where_block(c7, depth) of
                                    PStuck(c8) => PStuck(c8)
                                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                    PTook(wheres, c8) =>
                                      PTook(
                                          Decl {
                                            name = name,
                                            params = params,
                                            ret = ret0,
                                            eff = eff,
                                            constraints = constraints,
                                            body = body,
                                            wheres = wheres,
                                            reqs = reqs,
                                            enss = enss,
                                            measure = measure,
                                            is_test = is_test,
                                            totality = totality,
                                            fip_word = fip_word,
                                            is_replayable = is_replayable,
                                            is_no_alloc = no_alloc,
                                            span = cursor_since(saved, c8)
                                          },
                                          c8,
                                        )

defs.name: parse_method_params
defs.source:
fn parse_method_params(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  index : Int,
  rev : List(Param)
) : Parsed(List(Param)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    let borrowed = at_fixed(c, "borrow")
    let c0 =
      if borrowed then
        cursor_advance(c)
      else
        c
    match parse_pattern(c0, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(pat, c1) =>
        match parse_optional_type(c1, depth) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(ty, c2) =>
            match parse_optional_default(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(dflt, c3) =>
                let param =
                  match pat.node of
                    PVar(n) =>
                      Param {
                        name = n,
                        pat = None,
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                    PWild =>
                      Param {
                        name = "_",
                        pat = None,
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                    _ =>
                      Param {
                        name = "arg@{index}",
                        pat = Some(pat),
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      }
                if at_fixed(c3, ",") then
                  parse_method_params(
                      cursor_advance(c3),
                      depth,
                      index + 1,
                      Cons(param, rev),
                    )
                elif at_fixed(c3, ")") then
                  PTook(reverse(Cons(param, rev)), cursor_advance(c3))
                else
                  PStuck(cursor_note_name(c3, ")"))

defs.name: parse_optional_type
defs.source:
fn parse_optional_type(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":") then
    match parse_type(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(ty, c1) => PTook(Some(ty), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.name: parse_optional_default
defs.source:
fn parse_optional_default(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Sp(Expr))) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":=") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => PTook(Some(e), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.name: parse_return_ann
defs.source:
fn parse_return_ann(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed((Option(Ty), Option(Row), Bool)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, ":")) then
    PTook((None, None, false), c)
  elif at_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "!") then
    PFault(
        refuse(
            cursor_since(c, cursor_advance(cursor_advance(c))),
            "the effect row now follows the result type: write `: Result ! \{Effects\}` instead of `: !\{Effects\} Result`",
          ),
      )
  else
    let start = cursor_advance(c)
    match find_top_bang(start, start.pos, 0, 0, 0) of
      None =>
        match parse_type(start, depth) of
          PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(ty, c1) =>
            match lift_noalloc(ty) of
              (ret, no_alloc) => PTook((Some(ret), None, no_alloc), c1)
      Some(stop) =>
        let capped = cap_cursor(start, stop)
        match parse_type(capped, depth) of
          PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(ty, c1) =>
            if c1.pos /= stop then
              PStuck(cursor_note_name(full_cursor(start, c1), "type"))
            else
              let c2 = full_cursor(start, c1)
              match parse_effect_row(c2, depth) of
                PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(row, c3) =>
                  match attach_decl_effect(ty, row) of
                    (ret, eff) =>
                      match lift_noalloc(ret) of
                        (ret2, no_alloc) =>
                          PTook((Some(ret2), eff, no_alloc), c3)

defs.name: lift_noalloc
defs.source:
fn lift_noalloc(ty : Ty) : (Ty, Bool) =
  match ty of
    TyUsage(inner, facts) =>
      match facts of
        Cons(fact, Nil) =>
          if fact == "noalloc" then
            (inner, true)
          else
            (ty, false)
        _ => (ty, false)
    _ => (ty, false)

defs.name: attach_decl_effect
defs.source:
fn attach_decl_effect(ty : Ty, row : Row) : (Ty, Option(Row)) =
  match ty of
    TyFun(params, _, ret) => (TyFun(params, row, ret), None)
    TyForall(vars, body) =>
      match attach_decl_effect(body, row) of
        (body2, None) => (TyForall(vars, body2), None)
        (_, Some(eff)) => (ty, Some(eff))
    _ => (ty, Some(row))

defs.name: cap_cursor
full_cursor
defs.source:
fn full_cursor(base : Cursor, parsed : Cursor) : Cursor =
  Cursor { ..base, pos = parsed.pos }

defs.name: find_top_bang
defs.source:
fn find_top_bang(
  c : Cursor,
  i : Int,
  parens : Int,
  brackets : Int,
  braces : Int
) : Option(Int) =
  if i >= cursor_count(c) then
    None
  else
    let t = array_get(c.toks, i)
    match t.kind of
      TVOpen =>
        if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      TVSemi =>
        if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      TVClose =>
        if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      TFixed(s) =>
        if s == "(" then
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens + 1, brackets, braces)
        elif s == ")" then
          if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
            None
          else
            find_top_bang(c, i + 1, max(0, parens - 1), brackets, braces)
        elif s == "[" then
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets + 1, braces)
        elif s == "]" then
          if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
            None
          else
            find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, max(0, brackets - 1), braces)
        elif s == "\{" then
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces + 1)
        elif s == "\}" then
          if parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
            None
          else
            find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, max(0, braces - 1))
        elif s == "!" && parens == 0 && brackets == 0 && braces == 0 then
          Some(i)
        elif ((s == "="
            || s == ","
            || s == "given"
            || s == "requires"
            || s == "ensures"
            || s == "where")
            && parens == 0
            && brackets == 0
            && braces == 0) then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      TIdent =>
        if (token_text(t) == "decreases"
            && parens == 0
            && brackets == 0
            && braces == 0) then
          None
        else
          find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)
      _ => find_top_bang(c, i + 1, parens, brackets, braces)

defs.name: parse_requires
defs.source:
fn parse_requires(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Sp(Expr))
) : Parsed(List(Sp(Expr))) =
  if at_fixed(c, "requires") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => parse_requires(c1, depth, Cons(e, rev))
  else
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)

defs.name: parse_ensures
defs.source:
fn parse_ensures(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Ensure)
) : Parsed(List(Ensure)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "ensures") then
    match take_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "|") of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) =>
        match take_ident(c1) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(binder, c2) =>
            match take_fixed(c2, "|") of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                match parse_expr(c3, depth) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(expr, c4) =>
                    parse_ensures(
                        c4,
                        depth,
                        Cons(Ensure { binder = binder, expr = expr }, rev),
                      )
  else
    PTook(reverse(rev), c)

defs.name: parse_decreases
defs.source:
fn parse_decreases(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Sp(Expr))) =
  if peek_word(c) == "decreases" then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => PTook(Some(e), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.name: parse_where_block
defs.source:
fn parse_where_block(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, "where")) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    match take_kind(cursor_advance(c), TVOpen) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) => parse_where_bindings(c1, depth, Nil)

defs.name: parse_where_bindings
defs.source:
fn parse_where_bindings(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(NamedExpr)
) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
    parse_where_bindings(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match take_ident(c) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c3) =>
                parse_where_bindings(
                    c3,
                    depth,
                    Cons(NamedExpr { name = name, value = value }, rev),
                  )

defs.name: parse_canonical_item
defs.source:
fn parse_canonical_item(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  _vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(c, "canonical") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_uid(c1) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(cls, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "(") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match parse_type(c3, depth) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(head, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, ")") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match take_fixed(c5, "=") of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(_, c6) =>
                          match take_ident(c6) of
                            PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PTook(name, c7) =>
                              PTook(
                                  ICanonical {
                                    cls = cls,
                                    head = head,
                                    name = name,
                                    span = cursor_since(saved, c7)
                                  },
                                  c7,
                                )
defs.doc: Parse `canonical Class(Head) = instance_name`.

defs.name: PatternClause
defs.source: type PatternClause = PatternClause { word: String, expr: Sp(Expr), span: Span }

defs.name: StableEntry
defs.source:
type StableEntry
  = SERung(Rung)
  | SEConverter(Converter)
  | SEMigrations(List(Migration))

defs.name: StableParts
defs.source:
type StableParts = StableParts {
  rungs: List(Rung),
  converters: List(Converter),
  migrations: List(Migration),
  has_migrations: Bool,
  saw_body: Bool
}

defs.name: Checked
defs.source: type Checked(a) = CheckBad(Diagnostic) | CheckOk(a)

defs.name: parse_pattern_decl
defs.source:
fn parse_pattern_decl(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(d, c1) => parse_pattern_decl_body(c1, d, vis)
defs.doc:
Parse a complete `pattern` declaration.

The clause assembler enforces the surface contract at parse time: one one-argument `view`, at most one `make`, and a `make` arity equal to the pattern parameter count. A bare name is admitted for `view` because it may name a class-dispatched view method; every other clause body must be a lambda.

defs.name: parse_pattern_decl_body
defs.source:
fn parse_pattern_decl_body(
  saved : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match take_fixed(saved, "pattern") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_word(c1, TUid) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "(") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match parse_ident_list(c3, ")", Nil) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(params, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "for") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match take_word(c5, TUid) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(for_ty, c6) =>
                          match take_fixed(c6, "=") of
                            PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                            PTook(_, c7) =>
                              match parse_pattern_clauses(c7, depth) of
                                PStuck(c8) => PStuck(c8)
                                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                                PTook(clauses, c8) =>
                                  assemble_pattern(
                                      saved,
                                      c8,
                                      name,
                                      params,
                                      for_ty,
                                      clauses,
                                      vis,
                                    )

defs.name: parse_ident_list
defs.source:
fn parse_ident_list(
  c : Cursor,
  close : String,
  rev : List(String)
) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if at_fixed(c, close) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_ident_list(cursor_advance(c1), close, Cons(name, rev))
        elif at_fixed(c1, close) then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(name, rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
        else
          PStuck(note_comma_or(c1, close))

defs.name: parse_pattern_clauses
defs.source:
fn parse_pattern_clauses(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(List(PatternClause)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVOpen) then
    parse_pattern_clause_block(cursor_advance(c), depth, Nil)
  else
    match parse_pattern_clause(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(clause, c1) => PTook([clause], c1)

defs.name: parse_pattern_clause_block
defs.source:
fn parse_pattern_clause_block(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(PatternClause)
) : Parsed(List(PatternClause)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
    parse_pattern_clause_block(cursor_advance(c), depth, rev)
  else
    match parse_pattern_clause(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(clause, c1) =>
        if at_kind(c1, TVSemi) then
          parse_pattern_clause_block(
              cursor_advance(c1),
              depth,
              Cons(clause, rev),
            )
        elif at_kind(c1, TVClose) then
          parse_pattern_clause_block(c1, depth, Cons(clause, rev))
        else
          let c2 = cursor_note(c1, TVSemi)
          PStuck(cursor_note(c2, TVClose))

defs.name: parse_pattern_clause
defs.source:
fn parse_pattern_clause(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(PatternClause) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(word, c1) =>
      match parse_expr(c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(expr, c2) =>
          if word /= "view" && word /= "make" then
            PFault(
                refuse(
                    cursor_since(saved, c2),
                    "expected `view` or `make` in pattern declaration",
                  ),
              )
          else
            PTook(
                PatternClause {
                  word = word,
                  expr = expr,
                  span = cursor_since(saved, c2)
                },
                c2,
              )

defs.name: assemble_pattern
defs.source:
fn assemble_pattern(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  name : String,
  params : List(String),
  for_ty : String,
  clauses : List(PatternClause),
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match (collect_pattern_clauses(name, length(params), clauses, None, None)) of
    CheckBad(d) => PFault(d)
    CheckOk(parts) =>
      match parts of
        (None, _) =>
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_since(saved, c),
                  "pattern `{name}` needs a `view` clause",
                ),
            )
        (Some(viewfn), makefn) =>
          PTook(
              IPattern {
                name = name,
                params = params,
                forty = for_ty,
                viewfn = viewfn,
                makefn = makefn,
                span = cursor_since(saved, c),
                vis = vis,
                dep = None
              },
              c,
            )

defs.name: collect_pattern_clauses
defs.source:
fn collect_pattern_clauses(
  pattern_name : String,
  make_arity : Int,
  clauses : List(PatternClause),
  viewfn : Option(Sp(Expr)),
  makefn : Option(Sp(Expr))
) : Checked((Option(Sp(Expr)), Option(Sp(Expr)))) =
  match clauses of
    Nil => CheckOk((viewfn, makefn))
    Cons(clause, rest) =>
      let want =
        if clause.word == "view" then
          1
        else
          make_arity
      match clause_arity(clause.word, clause.expr) of
        None =>
          CheckBad(
              refuse(clause.span, "`{clause.word}` clause must be a lambda"),
            )
        Some(got) =>
          if got /= want then
            CheckBad(
                refuse(
                    clause.span,
                    "`{clause.word}` for pattern `{pattern_name}` must take {want} argument(s), this lambda takes {got}",
                  ),
              )
          elif clause.word == "view" then
            match viewfn of
              Some(_) =>
                CheckBad(
                    refuse(
                        clause.span,
                        "duplicate `view` clause in pattern `{pattern_name}`",
                      ),
                  )
              None =>
                collect_pattern_clauses(
                    pattern_name,
                    make_arity,
                    rest,
                    Some(clause.expr),
                    makefn,
                  )
          else
            match makefn of
              Some(_) =>
                CheckBad(
                    refuse(
                        clause.span,
                        "duplicate `make` clause in pattern `{pattern_name}`",
                      ),
                  )
              None =>
                collect_pattern_clauses(
                    pattern_name,
                    make_arity,
                    rest,
                    viewfn,
                    Some(clause.expr),
                  )

defs.name: clause_arity
defs.source:
fn clause_arity(word : String, e : Sp(Expr)) : Option(Int) =
  match e.node of
    ELam(params, _) => Some(length(params))
    EVar(_) =>
      if word == "view" then
        Some(1)
      else
        None
    _ => None

defs.name: parse_stable_decl
defs.source:
fn parse_stable_decl(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(d, c1) => parse_stable_decl_body(c1, d, vis)
defs.doc:
Parse a complete `stable` declaration, including rungs, converters, and an optional migrations table.

Stable entries are parsed in their authored order. The assembler rejects an empty family, a rung after converters or migrations, and duplicate migration tables before constructing the `IStable` item.

defs.name: parse_stable_decl_body
defs.source:
fn parse_stable_decl_body(
  saved : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  vis : Option(String)
) : Parsed(Item) =
  match take_fixed(saved, "stable") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_word(c1, TUid) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "\{") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              let empty =
                StableParts {
                  rungs = Nil,
                  converters = Nil,
                  migrations = Nil,
                  has_migrations = false,
                  saw_body = false
                }
              match (parse_stable_entries(saved, c3, depth, name, empty)) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(parts, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "\}") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      if length(parts.rungs) == 0 then
                        PFault(
                            refuse(
                                cursor_since(saved, c5),
                                "`stable {name}` declares no version rungs",
                              ),
                          )
                      else
                        PTook(
                            IStable {
                              name = name,
                              rungs = parts.rungs,
                              converters = parts.converters,
                              migrations = parts.migrations,
                              span = cursor_since(saved, c5),
                              vis = vis,
                              dep = None
                            },
                            c5,
                          )

defs.name: parse_stable_entries
defs.source:
fn parse_stable_entries(
  decl_start : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  family : String,
  parts : StableParts
) : Parsed(StableParts) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(parts, c)
  else
    match parse_stable_entry(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(entry, c1) =>
        match add_stable_entry(decl_start, c1, family, parts, entry) of
          CheckBad(d) => PFault(d)
          CheckOk(next) =>
            if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
              parse_stable_entries(
                  decl_start,
                  cursor_advance(c1),
                  depth,
                  family,
                  next,
                )
            elif at_fixed(c1, "\}") then
              PTook(next, c1)
            else
              PStuck(note_comma_or(c1, "\}"))

defs.name: parse_stable_entry
defs.source:
fn parse_stable_entry(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(StableEntry) =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    Some(TUid) =>
      match parse_rung(c, depth) of
        PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(rung, c1) => PTook(SERung(rung), c1)
    Some(TIdent) =>
      let word = peek_word(c)
      if word == "migrations" then
        match parse_migrations(c, depth) of
          PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(rows, c1) => PTook(SEMigrations(rows), c1)
      elif word == "upgrade" || word == "downgrade" then
        match parse_converter(c, depth) of
          PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(converter, c1) => PTook(SEConverter(converter), c1)
      else
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_span(c),
                "expected a version rung, `upgrade`, `downgrade`, or `migrations`, found `{word}`",
              ),
          )
    _ => PStuck(note_stable_entry(c))

defs.name: add_stable_entry
defs.source:
fn add_stable_entry(
  decl_start : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  family : String,
  parts : StableParts,
  entry : StableEntry
) : Checked(StableParts) =
  match entry of
    SERung(rung) =>
      if parts.saw_body then
        CheckBad(
            refuse(
                rung.span,
                "rung `{rung.name}` must come before the converters and migrations in `stable {family}`",
              ),
          )
      else
        CheckOk(StableParts { ..parts, rungs = append(parts.rungs, [rung]) })
    SEConverter(converter) =>
      CheckOk(
          StableParts {
            ..parts,
            converters = append(parts.converters, [converter]),
            saw_body = true
          },
        )
    SEMigrations(rows) =>
      if parts.has_migrations then
        CheckBad(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(decl_start, c),
                "`stable {family}` has two migration tables",
              ),
          )
      else
        CheckOk(
            StableParts {
              ..parts,
              migrations = rows,
              has_migrations = true,
              saw_body = true
            },
          )

defs.name: parse_rung
defs.source:
fn parse_rung(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Rung) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TUid) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "\{") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match parse_rung_body(c3, depth) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(body, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "\}") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match parse_frozen_badge(c5) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(frozen, c6) =>
                          match body of
                            (base, fields) =>
                              PTook(
                                  Rung {
                                    name = name,
                                    base = base,
                                    fields = fields,
                                    frozen = frozen,
                                    span = cursor_since(saved, c6)
                                  },
                                  c6,
                                )

defs.name: parse_rung_body
defs.source:
fn parse_rung_body(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed((Option(String), List(RungField))) =
  if at_fixed(c, "..") then
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TUid) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(base, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, "\}") then
          PTook((Some(base), Nil), c1)
        elif at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          match parse_rung_field(cursor_advance(c1), depth) of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(field, c2) =>
              match parse_rung_field_tail(c2, depth, [field], false) of
                PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(fields, c3) => PTook((Some(base), fields), c3)
        else
          PStuck(note_comma_or(c1, "\}"))
  elif at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook((None, Nil), c)
  else
    match parse_rung_field(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(field, c1) =>
        match parse_rung_field_tail(c1, depth, [field], true) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(fields, c2) => PTook((None, fields), c2)

defs.name: parse_rung_field_tail
defs.source:
fn parse_rung_field_tail(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  fields : List(RungField),
  allow_trailing : Bool
) : Parsed(List(RungField)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, ",")) then
    PTook(fields, c)
  else
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "\}") && allow_trailing then
      PTook(fields, c1)
    else
      match parse_rung_field(c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(field, c2) =>
          parse_rung_field_tail(
              c2,
              depth,
              append(fields, [field]),
              allow_trailing,
            )

defs.name: parse_rung_field
defs.source:
fn parse_rung_field(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(RungField) =
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, ":") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_type(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(ty, c3) =>
              if at_fixed(c3, "=") then
                match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c3), depth) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(dflt, c4) =>
                    PTook(
                        RungField { name = name, ty = ty, dflt = Some(dflt) },
                        c4,
                      )
              else
                PTook(RungField { name = name, ty = ty, dflt = None }, c3)

defs.name: parse_frozen_badge
defs.source:
fn parse_frozen_badge(c : Cursor) : Parsed(Option(String)) =
  if not(at_kind(c, TIdent)) then
    PTook(None, c)
  else
    let saved = c
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(word, c1) =>
        if word /= "frozen" then
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_since(saved, c1),
                  "expected `frozen` after a rung, found `{word}`",
                ),
            )
        else
          match take_word(c1, TStr) of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(digest, c2) => PTook(Some(digest), c2)

defs.name: parse_converter
defs.source:
fn parse_converter(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Converter) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(dir, c1) =>
      if dir /= "upgrade" && dir /= "downgrade" then
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(saved, c1),
                "expected `upgrade` or `downgrade`, found `{dir}`",
              ),
          )
      else
        match take_word(c1, TUid) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(from, c2) =>
            match take_fixed(c2, "->") of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                match take_word(c3, TUid) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(to, c4) =>
                    match take_fixed(c4, "=") of
                      PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(_, c5) =>
                        match parse_converter_body(c5, depth) of
                          PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                          PTook(body, c6) =>
                            match parse_drop_loss(c6) of
                              PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                              PTook(dropped, c7) =>
                                match body of
                                  (base, overrides) =>
                                    PTook(
                                        Converter {
                                          dir = dir,
                                          from = from,
                                          to = to,
                                          base = base,
                                          overrides = overrides,
                                          drop_loss = dropped,
                                          span = cursor_since(saved, c7)
                                        },
                                        c7,
                                      )

defs.name: parse_converter_body
defs.source:
fn parse_converter_body(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed((Sp(Expr), List(NamedExpr))) =
  match take_fixed(c, "\{") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "..") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(base, c3) =>
              match parse_converter_fields(c3, depth, Nil) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(fields, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "\}") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) => PTook((base, fields), c5)

defs.name: parse_converter_fields
defs.source:
fn parse_converter_fields(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  fields : List(NamedExpr)
) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if not(at_fixed(c, ",")) then
    PTook(fields, c)
  else
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c3) =>
                parse_converter_fields(c3, depth, append(fields, [
                    NamedExpr { name = name, value = value },
                  ]))

defs.name: parse_drop_loss
defs.source:
fn parse_drop_loss(c : Cursor) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if not(at_kind(c, TIdent)) then
    PTook(Nil, c)
  else
    let saved = c
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(word, c1) =>
        if word /= "drop_loss" then
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_since(saved, c1),
                  "expected `drop_loss`, found `{word}`",
                ),
            )
        else
          match take_fixed(c1, "(") of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c2) => parse_ident_list(c2, ")", Nil)

defs.name: parse_migrations
defs.source:
fn parse_migrations(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(Migration)) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(word, c1) =>
      if word /= "migrations" then
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(saved, c1),
                "expected `migrations`, found `{word}`",
              ),
          )
      else
        match take_fixed(c1, "\{") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_migration_rows(c2, depth, Nil) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(rows, c3) =>
                match take_fixed(c3, "\}") of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(_, c4) => PTook(rows, c4)

defs.name: parse_migration_rows
defs.source:
fn parse_migration_rows(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rows : List(Migration)
) : Parsed(List(Migration)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(rows, c)
  else
    match parse_migration_row(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(row, c1) =>
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PFault(refuse(cursor_span(c), "migration parser made no progress"))
        else
          parse_migration_rows(c1, depth, append(rows, [row]))

defs.name: parse_migration_row
defs.source:
fn parse_migration_row(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Migration) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TUid) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(from, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "->") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match take_word(c2, TUid) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(to, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, "=") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_migration_route(c4, depth) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(route, c5) =>
                      PTook(
                          Migration {
                            from = from,
                            to = to,
                            route = route,
                            span = cursor_since(saved, c5)
                          },
                          c5,
                        )

defs.name: parse_migration_route
defs.source:
fn parse_migration_route(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(MigrationRoute) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(word, c1) =>
      if at_fixed(c1, "(") then
        parse_version_route(saved, word, cursor_advance(c1), depth)
      elif word == "auto" then
        PTook(MAuto, c1)
      else
        PFault(
            refuse(
                cursor_since(saved, c1),
                "expected `auto` or `version(...)`, found `{word}`",
              ),
          )

defs.name: parse_version_route
defs.source:
fn parse_version_route(
  saved : Cursor,
  word : String,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(MigrationRoute) =
  match parse_version_arg(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(up, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, ",") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_version_arg(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(down, c3) =>
              let c4 =
                if at_fixed(c3, ",") then
                  cursor_advance(c3)
                else
                  c3
              match take_fixed(c4, ")") of
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c5) =>
                  match (up, down) of
                    ((up_name, up_dir), (down_name, down_dir)) =>
                      if word /= "version" then
                        PFault(
                            refuse(
                                cursor_since(saved, c5),
                                "expected `auto` or `version(...)`, found `{word}`",
                              ),
                          )
                      elif (up_name /= "upgrade" || down_name /= "downgrade") then
                        PFault(
                            refuse(
                                cursor_since(saved, c5),
                                "`version(...)` takes `upgrade = ..., downgrade = ...`",
                              ),
                          )
                      else
                        PTook(MVersion(up_dir, down_dir), c5)

defs.name: parse_version_arg
defs.source:
fn parse_version_arg(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed((String, MigrationDir)) =
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(expr, c3) => PTook((name, migration_dir(expr)), c3)

defs.name: migration_dir
defs.source:
fn migration_dir(e : Sp(Expr)) : MigrationDir =
  match e.node of
    EVar(name) =>
      if name == "auto" then
        DAuto
      else
        DExpr(e)
    _ => DExpr(e)
