defs.source:
fn split_int(raw : String) : (String, Suffix) =
  let n = byte_len(raw)
  if ends_with("i64", raw) then
    (surface_int(substring(raw, 0, n - 3)), SufI64)
  elif ends_with("u64", raw) then
    (surface_int(substring(raw, 0, n - 3)), SufU64)
  else
    (surface_int(raw), SufNone)

defs.name: infix_binding
defs.source:
fn infix_binding(k : TokenKind) : Option(Binding) =
  match k of
    TFixed(s) =>
      if s == "??" then
        Some(Binding { op = s, left = 1, right = 1, compare = false, tag = 1 })
      elif s == "|>" then
        Some(Binding { op = s, left = 2, right = 3, compare = false, tag = 2 })
      elif s == ">>" then
        Some(Binding { op = s, left = 4, right = 5, compare = false, tag = 3 })
      elif s == "<<" then
        Some(Binding { op = s, left = 4, right = 5, compare = false, tag = 4 })
      elif s == "||" then
        Some(Binding { op = s, left = 6, right = 7, compare = false, tag = 0 })
      elif s == "&&" then
        Some(Binding { op = s, left = 8, right = 9, compare = false, tag = 0 })
      elif (s == "==" || s == "/=" || s == "<" || s == "<=" || s == ">" || s == ">=") then
        Some(Binding { op = s, left = 10, right = 11, compare = true, tag = 0 })
      elif s == "+" || s == "-" then
        Some(
            Binding {
              op = s,
              left = 12,
              right = 13,
              compare = false,
              tag = 0
            },
          )
      elif s == "*" || s == "/" || s == "%" then
        Some(
            Binding {
              op = s,
              left = 14,
              right = 15,
              compare = false,
              tag = 0
            },
          )
      elif s == "^" then
        Some(
            Binding {
              op = s,
              left = 17,
              right = 16,
              compare = false,
              tag = 0
            },
          )
      else
        None
    _ => None

defs.name: retired_dot
defs.source:
fn retired_dot(k : TokenKind) : Option(String) =
  match k of
    TFixed(s) =>
      if s == "==." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `==.` was removed: write `==`")
      elif s == "/=." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `/=.` was removed: write `/=`")
      elif s == "<." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `<.` was removed: write `<`")
      elif s == "<=." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `<=.` was removed: write `<=`")
      elif s == ">." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `>.` was removed: write `>`")
      elif s == ">=." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `>=.` was removed: write `>=`")
      elif s == "+." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `+.` was removed: write `+`")
      elif s == "-." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `-.` was removed: write `-`")
      elif s == "*." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `*.` was removed: write `*`")
      elif s == "/." then
        Some("the float dot-operator `/.` was removed: write `/`")
      else
        None
    _ => None

defs.name: infix_node
defs.source:
fn infix_node(b : Binding, lhs : Sp(Expr), rhs : Sp(Expr)) : Expr =
  if b.tag == 1 then
    EDefault(lhs, rhs)
  elif b.tag == 2 then
    EPipe(lhs, rhs)
  elif b.tag == 3 then
    ECompose("forward", lhs, rhs)
  elif b.tag == 4 then
    ECompose("backward", lhs, rhs)
  else
    EBin(b.op, lhs, rhs)

defs.name: parse_bp
defs.source:
fn parse_bp(c : Cursor, depth : Int, min_bp : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(d, _) =>
      match parse_prefix(c, d) of
        PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
        PFault(diag) => PFault(diag)
        PTook(lhs, c1) => parse_infix_loop(lhs, c1, d, min_bp, false)

defs.name: parse_prefix
defs.source:
fn parse_prefix(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "-") then
    let saved = c
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    match parse_bp(c1, depth, 16) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c2) => PTook(made(saved, c2, ENeg(e)), c2)
  else
    parse_postfix(c, depth)

defs.name: parse_infix_loop
defs.source:
fn parse_infix_loop(
  lhs : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  min_bp : Int,
  blocked_compare : Bool
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    None => PTook(lhs, c)
    Some(k) =>
      match retired_dot(k) of
        Some(msg) => fail_at(c, msg)
        None =>
          match infix_binding(k) of
            None => PTook(lhs, c)
            Some(b) =>
              if b.left < min_bp || b.compare && blocked_compare then
                PTook(lhs, c)
              else
                let saved = c
                let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
                match parse_bp(c1, depth, b.right) of
                  PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(rhs, c2) =>
                    let s = operands_span(lhs, rhs)
                    let next = authored(infix_node(b, lhs, rhs), s.lo, s.hi)
                    parse_infix_loop(next, c2, depth, min_bp, b.compare)

defs.name: parse_postfix
defs.source:
fn parse_postfix(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_atom(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(e, c1) => parse_postfix_loop(e, c1, depth)

defs.name: parse_postfix_loop
defs.source:
fn parse_postfix_loop(
  recv : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "(") then
    parse_call_tail(recv, c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "[") then
    parse_index_tail(recv, c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, ".") then
    parse_dot_tail(recv, c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "?.") then
    let saved = c
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        let whole = authored(
            EOptChain(recv, name),
            recv.span.lo,
            cursor_since(saved, c1).hi,
          )
        parse_postfix_loop(whole, c1, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "?") then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    let marker = zero_width(EMarker("try"), recv.span.lo)
    let whole =
      authored(ECall(marker, [recv]), recv.span.lo, cursor_since(c, c1).hi)
    parse_postfix_loop(whole, c1, depth)
  else
    PTook(recv, c)

defs.name: parse_trailing_lambda
defs.source:
fn parse_trailing_lambda(c : Cursor, lo : Int, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  match parse_trailer_params(c1, depth) of
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(params, c2) =>
      match parse_block(c2, depth) of
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(body, c3) =>
          PTook(authored(ELam(params, body), lo, body.span.hi), c3)

defs.name: parse_trailer_params
defs.source:
fn parse_trailer_params(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(Param)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "(") then
    match parse_param(cursor_advance(c), depth, 0) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(first, c1) => parse_trailer_param_rest(c1, depth, 1, [first])
  else
    PTook(Nil, c)

defs.name: parse_trailer_param_rest
defs.source:
fn parse_trailer_param_rest(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  index : Int,
  acc : List(Param)
) : Parsed(List(Param)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ",") then
    match parse_param(cursor_advance(c), depth, index) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(param, c1) =>
        parse_trailer_param_rest(c1, depth, index + 1, append(acc, [param]))
  else
    match take_fixed(c, ")") of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) => PTook(acc, c1)

defs.name: parse_call_tail
defs.source:
fn parse_call_tail(
  callee : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  match parse_call_args(c1, depth, Nil) of
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(pair, c2) =>
      match pair of
        (args, inst) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, ")") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              let hi = cursor_since(saved, c3).hi
              match inst of
                None =>
                  if at_fixed(c3, "fn") then
                    match (parse_trailing_lambda(c3, callee.span.lo, depth)) of
                      PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(lam, c4) =>
                        let call = authored(
                            ECall(callee, append(args, [lam])),
                            callee.span.lo,
                            lam.span.hi,
                          )
                        parse_postfix_loop(call, c4, depth)
                  else
                    let call = authored(ECall(callee, args), callee.span.lo, hi)
                    parse_postfix_loop(call, c3, depth)
                Some(names) =>
                  let head = authored(EInst(callee, names), callee.span.lo, hi)
                  let call = authored(ECall(head, args), callee.span.lo, hi)
                  parse_postfix_loop(call, c3, depth)

defs.name: parse_call_args
defs.source:
fn parse_call_args(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  rev : List(Sp(Expr))
) : Parsed((List(Sp(Expr)), Option(List(String)))) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook((reverse(rev), None), c)
  elif at_fixed(c, "using") then
    match parse_using(cursor_advance(c), Nil) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(names, c1) => PTook((reverse(rev), Some(names)), c1)
  else
    match parse_expr(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
          if at_fixed(c2, "using") then
            match parse_using(cursor_advance(c2), Nil) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(names, c3) =>
                PTook((reverse(Cons(e, rev)), Some(names)), c3)
          elif at_fixed(c2, ")") then
            PTook((reverse(Cons(e, rev)), None), c2)
          else
            parse_call_args(c2, depth, Cons(e, rev))
        else
          PTook((reverse(Cons(e, rev)), None), c1)

defs.name: parse_using
defs.source:
fn parse_using(c : Cursor, rev : List(String)) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
        let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
        if at_fixed(c2, ")") then
          PTook(reverse(Cons(name, rev)), c2)
        else
          parse_using(c2, Cons(name, rev))
      else
        PTook(reverse(Cons(name, rev)), c1)

defs.name: parse_index_tail
defs.source:
fn parse_index_tail(
  recv : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  match parse_expr(c1, depth) of
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(first, c2) =>
      match parse_more_indices(c2, depth, [first]) of
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(indices, c3) =>
          match take_fixed(c3, "]") of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c4) =>
              let hi = cursor_since(saved, c4).hi
              let key =
                if length(indices) == 1 then
                  match indices of
                    Cons(one, _) => one
                    Nil => first
                else
                  synthesized(EList(indices), recv.span.lo, hi)
              let whole = authored(EIndex(recv, key), recv.span.lo, hi)
              parse_postfix_loop(whole, c4, depth)

defs.name: parse_more_indices
defs.source:
fn parse_more_indices(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  acc : List(Sp(Expr))
) : Parsed(List(Sp(Expr))) =
  if at_fixed(c, ",") then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "]") && length(acc) > 1 then
      PTook(acc, c1)
    else
      match parse_expr(c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(e, c2) => parse_more_indices(c2, depth, append(acc, [e]))
  else
    PTook(acc, c)

defs.name: parse_dot_tail
defs.source:
fn parse_dot_tail(recv : Sp(Expr), c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_fixed(c1, "#") then
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c1), TIdent) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c2) =>
        let hi = cursor_since(saved, c2).hi
        parse_postfix_loop(
            authored(EUnboxedField(recv, name), recv.span.lo, hi),
            c2,
            depth,
          )
  elif at_fixed(c1, "[") then
    match parse_path_steps(cursor_advance(c1), depth) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(path, c2) =>
        match take_fixed(c2, "]") of
          PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c3) =>
            let hi = cursor_since(saved, c3).hi
            parse_postfix_loop(
                authored(EReadPath(recv, path), recv.span.lo, hi),
                c3,
                depth,
              )
  else
    match take_word(c1, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c2) =>
        if at_fixed(c2, "(") then
          parse_dot_call(recv, name, saved, c2, depth)
        elif at_fixed(c2, "fn") then
          match parse_trailing_lambda(c2, recv.span.lo, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(lam, c3) =>
              let head = synthesized(EVar(name), recv.span.lo, recv.span.lo)
              let whole =
                authored(ECall(head, [recv, lam]), recv.span.lo, lam.span.hi)
              parse_postfix_loop(whole, c3, depth)
        else
          let hi = cursor_since(saved, c2).hi
          parse_postfix_loop(
              authored(EField(recv, name), recv.span.lo, hi),
              c2,
              depth,
            )

defs.name: parse_dot_call
defs.source:
fn parse_dot_call(
  recv : Sp(Expr),
  name : String,
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_call_args(cursor_advance(c), depth, Nil) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(pair, c1) =>
      match pair of
        (args0, inst) =>
          match inst of
            Some(_) =>
              fail_run(saved, c1, "`using` is not accepted on a dot call")
            None =>
              match take_fixed(c1, ")") of
                PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c2) =>
                  let head = synthesized(EVar(name), recv.span.lo, recv.span.lo)
                  let args = Cons(recv, args0)
                  if at_fixed(c2, "fn") then
                    match (parse_trailing_lambda(c2, recv.span.lo, depth)) of
                      PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(lam, c3) =>
                        let whole = authored(
                            ECall(head, append(args, [lam])),
                            recv.span.lo,
                            lam.span.hi,
                          )
                        parse_postfix_loop(whole, c3, depth)
                  else
                    let whole = authored(
                        ECall(head, args),
                        recv.span.lo,
                        cursor_since(saved, c2).hi,
                      )
                    parse_postfix_loop(whole, c2, depth)

defs.name: parse_atom
defs.source:
fn parse_atom(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match cursor_peek(c) of
    None => PStuck(note_expr(c))
    Some(t) =>
      match t.kind of
        TInt =>
          let pair = split_int(token_text(t))
          match pair of
            (digits, suffix) =>
              let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
              PTook(made(c, c1, EInt(digits, suffix)), c1)
        TFloat =>
          let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
          PTook(made(c, c1, EFloat(surface_float(token_text(t)))), c1)
        TChar =>
          let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
          PTook(made(c, c1, EChar(token_text(t))), c1)
        TStr =>
          let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
          PTook(made(c, c1, EStr(token_text(t))), c1)
        TIStart => parse_interpolation(c, depth)
        TIdent =>
          let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
          PTook(made(c, c1, EVar(token_text(t))), c1)
        TUid => parse_uid_atom(c, depth)
        TQual =>
          let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
          PTook(made(c, c1, EVar(token_text(t))), c1)
        TFixed(s) => parse_fixed_atom(c, depth, s)
        _ => PStuck(note_expr(c))

defs.name: parse_fixed_atom
defs.source:
fn parse_fixed_atom(c : Cursor, depth : Int, s : String) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if s == "true" then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    PTook(made(c, c1, EBool(true)), c1)
  elif s == "false" then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    PTook(made(c, c1, EBool(false)), c1)
  elif s == "break" then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    PTook(made(c, c1, EBreak), c1)
  elif s == "continue" then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    PTook(made(c, c1, EContinue), c1)
  elif s == "(" then
    parse_paren(c, depth)
  elif s == "[" then
    parse_list_atom(c, depth)
  elif s == "#" then
    parse_unboxed_atom(c, depth)
  elif s == "\{" then
    parse_path_update_atom(c, depth)
  elif s == "?" then
    parse_hole(c)
  elif s == "mask" then
    parse_mask(c, depth)
  elif s == "error" then
    parse_error_call(c, depth)
  else
    PStuck(note_expr(c))

defs.name: parse_hole
defs.source:
fn parse_hole(c : Cursor) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) => PTook(made(c, c1, EHole(name)), c1)

defs.name: parse_uid_atom
parse_paren
defs.source:
fn parse_paren(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_fixed(c1, ")") then
    let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
    PTook(made(c, c2, EUnit), c2)
  else
    match parse_expr(c1, depth) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(first, c2) =>
        if at_fixed(c2, ":") then
          match parse_type(cursor_advance(c2), depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(ty, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, ")") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) => PTook(made(c, c4, EAnn(first, ty)), c4)
        elif at_fixed(c2, ",") then
          match (parse_expr_comma(cursor_advance(c2), depth, ")", [first])) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(items, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, ")") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) => PTook(made(c, c4, ETuple(items)), c4)
        else
          match take_fixed(c2, ")") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              let s = cursor_since(c, c3)
              PTook(widened(first, s.lo, s.hi), c3)

defs.name: parse_expr_comma
defs.source:
fn parse_expr_comma(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  close : String,
  acc : List(Sp(Expr))
) : Parsed(List(Sp(Expr))) =
  if at_fixed(c, close) then
    PTook(acc, c)
  else
    match parse_expr(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) =>
        let next = append(acc, [e])
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_expr_comma(cursor_advance(c1), depth, close, next)
        else
          PTook(next, c1)

defs.name: parse_interpolation
defs.source:
fn parse_interpolation(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match cursor_peek(c) of
    None => PStuck(cursor_note(c, TIStart))
    Some(first) =>
      let lo = first.span.lo
      let initial = [zero_width(EStr(token_text(first)), lo)]
      parse_interp_hole(c, cursor_advance(c), depth, initial)

defs.name: parse_interp_hole
parse_mask
defs.source:
fn parse_mask(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  match take_fixed(c1, "<") of
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c2) =>
      match take_word(c2, TUid) of
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(eff, c3) =>
          match take_fixed(c3, ">") of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c4) =>
              match take_fixed(c4, "(") of
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c5) =>
                  match parse_expr(c5, depth) of
                    PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(body, c6) =>
                      match take_fixed(c6, ")") of
                        PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(_, c7) => PTook(made(c, c7, EMask(eff, body)), c7)

defs.name: parse_error_call
parse_unboxed_atom
defs.source:
fn parse_unboxed_atom(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_fixed(c1, "(") then
    let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
    match parse_expr_comma(c2, depth, ")", Nil) of
      PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(items, c3) =>
        match take_fixed(c3, ")") of
          PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c4) => PTook(made(c, c4, EUnboxedTuple(items)), c4)
  elif at_fixed(c1, "\{") then
    match parse_named_fields(cursor_advance(c1), depth, "\}", Nil) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(fields, c2) =>
        match take_fixed(c2, "\}") of
          PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c3) => PTook(made(c, c3, EUnboxedRecord(fields)), c3)
  else
    let noted = cursor_note(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("(")), TFixed("\{"))
    PStuck(noted)

defs.name: parse_named_fields
defs.source:
fn parse_named_fields(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  close : String,
  acc : List(NamedExpr)
) : Parsed(List(NamedExpr)) =
  if at_fixed(c, close) then
    PTook(acc, c)
  else
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c3) =>
                let next =
                  append(acc, [NamedExpr { name = name, value = value }])
                if at_fixed(c3, ",") then
                  parse_named_fields(cursor_advance(c3), depth, close, next)
                else
                  PTook(next, c3)

defs.name: parse_record_atom
defs.source:
fn parse_record_atom(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  brace : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c = cursor_advance(brace)
  if at_fixed(c, "..") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(base, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          match (parse_named_fields(cursor_advance(c1), depth, "\}", Nil)) of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(fields, c2) =>
              match take_fixed(c2, "\}") of
                PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c3) =>
                  PTook(made(saved, c3, ERecordUpdate(base, name, fields)), c3)
        else
          match take_fixed(c1, "\}") of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c2) =>
              PTook(made(saved, c2, ERecordUpdate(base, name, Nil)), c2)
  else
    match parse_named_fields(c, depth, "\}", Nil) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(fields, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "\}") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) => PTook(made(saved, c2, ERecord(name, fields)), c2)

defs.name: parse_list_atom
defs.source:
fn parse_list_atom(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_fixed(c1, "]") then
    let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
    PTook(made(c, c2, EList(Nil)), c2)
  else
    match parse_expr(c1, depth) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(first, c2) =>
        if at_fixed(c2, "for") then
          parse_comp_tail(c, first, cursor_advance(c2), depth)
        else
          parse_list_more(c, c2, depth, [first])

defs.name: parse_list_more
defs.source:
fn parse_list_more(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  acc : List(Sp(Expr))
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "..") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(hi, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "]") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) => PTook(made(saved, c2, ERange(acc, hi)), c2)
  elif at_fixed(c, ",") then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "]") then
      let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
      PTook(made(saved, c2, EList(acc)), c2)
    elif at_fixed(c1, "..") then
      match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c1), depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(hi, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "]") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) => PTook(made(saved, c3, ERange(acc, hi)), c3)
    else
      match parse_expr(c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(e, c2) => parse_list_more(saved, c2, depth, append(acc, [e]))
  else
    match take_fixed(c, "]") of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c1) => PTook(made(saved, c1, EList(acc)), c1)

defs.name: parse_comp_tail
defs.source:
fn parse_comp_tail(
  saved : Cursor,
  head : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(binder, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "in") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(seq, c3) =>
              match parse_quals(c3, depth, Nil, "]") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(qs, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "]") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      PTook(made(saved, c5, EComp(head, binder, seq, qs)), c5)

defs.name: parse_quals
defs.source:
fn parse_quals(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  acc : List(Qual),
  close : String
) : Parsed(List(Qual)) =
  if at_fixed(c, close) then
    PTook(acc, c)
  elif at_fixed(c, ",") then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "let") then
      match take_word(cursor_advance(c1), TIdent) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, "=") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match parse_expr(c3, depth) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(e, c4) =>
                  parse_quals(c4, depth, append(acc, [QBind(name, e)]), close)
    elif at_fixed(c1, "if") then
      match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c1), depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(e, c2) => parse_quals(c2, depth, append(acc, [QGuard(e)]), close)
    else
      let noted = cursor_note(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("let")), TFixed("if"))
      PStuck(noted)
  else
    PTook(acc, c)

defs.name: parse_path_update_atom
defs.source:
fn parse_path_update_atom(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  match parse_expr(c1, depth) of
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(base, c2) =>
      match take_fixed(c2, "|") of
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c3) =>
          match parse_path_updates(c3, depth, Nil) of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(ups, c4) =>
              match take_fixed(c4, "\}") of
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c5) => PTook(made(c, c5, EPathUpdate(base, ups)), c5)

defs.name: parse_path_updates
defs.source:
fn parse_path_updates(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  acc : List(PathUpdate)
) : Parsed(List(PathUpdate)) =
  match parse_path_steps(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(path, c1) =>
      if at_fixed(c1, "=") || at_fixed(c1, "~") then
        let modify = at_fixed(c1, "~")
        match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c1), depth) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(value, c2) =>
            let op =
              if modify then
                POModify(value)
              else
                POSet(value)
            let next = append(acc, [PathUpdate { path = path, op = op }])
            if at_fixed(c2, ",") then
              let c3 = cursor_advance(c2)
              if at_fixed(c3, "\}") then
                PTook(next, c3)
              else
                parse_path_updates(c3, depth, next)
            else
              PTook(next, c2)
      else
        let noted = cursor_note(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("=")), TFixed("~"))
        PStuck(noted)

defs.name: parse_path_steps
defs.source:
fn parse_path_steps(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(PathStep)) =
  match parse_path_segment(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(first, c1) => parse_path_rest(c1, depth, first)

defs.name: parse_path_rest
defs.source:
fn parse_path_rest(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  acc : List(PathStep)
) : Parsed(List(PathStep)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ".") then
    match parse_path_segment(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(seg, c1) => parse_path_rest(c1, depth, append(acc, seg))
  else
    PTook(acc, c)

defs.name: parse_path_segment
defs.source:
fn parse_path_segment(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(PathStep)) =
  match cursor_peek(c) of
    None =>
      let c1 = cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TIdent), TFixed("each"))
      PStuck(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("[")))
    Some(t) =>
      if t.kind == TIdent then
        parse_path_indexes(cursor_advance(c), depth, [PSField(token_text(t))])
      elif t.kind == TFixed("each") then
        parse_path_indexes(cursor_advance(c), depth, [PSEach])
      elif t.kind == TFixed("?") then
        parse_case_segment(cursor_advance(c), depth)
      elif t.kind == TFixed("(") then
        parse_filtered_segment(c, depth)
      elif t.kind == TFixed("[") then
        parse_path_indexes(c, depth, Nil)
      else
        let c1 = cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TIdent), TFixed("each"))
        PStuck(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("[")))

defs.name: parse_case_segment
defs.source:
fn parse_case_segment(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(PathStep)) =
  match cursor_peek(c) of
    None => PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TUid), TQual))
    Some(t) =>
      if t.kind == TUid then
        parse_path_indexes(cursor_advance(c), depth, [PSCase(token_text(t))])
      elif t.kind == TQual then
        let pieces = split(char_at(".", 0), token_text(t))
        match pieces of
          Nil => PStuck(cursor_note(c, TQual))
          Cons(ctor, fields) =>
            let steps =
              Cons(PSCase(ctor), map(\(field) -> PSField(field), fields))
            parse_path_indexes(cursor_advance(c), depth, steps)
      else
        PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TUid), TQual))

defs.name: parse_filtered_segment
defs.source:
fn parse_filtered_segment(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(PathStep)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  match parse_path_steps(c1, depth) of
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(inner, c2) =>
      match take_fixed(c2, "where") of
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c3) =>
          match parse_expr(c3, depth) of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(pred, c4) =>
              match take_fixed(c4, ")") of
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c5) =>
                  parse_path_indexes(c5, depth, append(inner, [PSWhere(pred)]))

defs.name: parse_path_indexes
defs.source:
fn parse_path_indexes(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  acc : List(PathStep)
) : Parsed(List(PathStep)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "[") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(index, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "]") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            parse_path_indexes(c2, depth, append(acc, [PSIndex(index)]))
  elif length(acc) > 0 then
    PTook(acc, c)
  else
    PStuck(cursor_note(c, TFixed("[")))

defs.name: parse_expr
defs.source:
fn parse_expr(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(d, _) => parse_expr_top(c, d)
defs.doc: Parse one expression from `c`, leaving the first following token unconsumed. The caller supplies the remaining structural depth budget.

defs.name: parse_expr_top
defs.source:
fn parse_expr_top(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "if") then
    parse_if_form(c, depth, false)
  elif at_fixed(c, "let") then
    parse_let_form(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "\\") then
    parse_lambda(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "match") then
    parse_match(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "handle") then
    parse_handle(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "throw") then
    parse_throw(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "try") then
    parse_try(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "transact") then
    parse_transact(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "probe") then
    parse_probe(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "for") then
    parse_for(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "while") then
    parse_while(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "loop") then
    parse_loop(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "return") then
    parse_return(c, depth)
  elif (peek_word(c) == "reflect"
      && (fixed_at(c, 1, "fn") || fixed_at(c, 1, "type"))) then
    parse_reflect(c)
  else
    match parse_bp(c, depth, 0) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(lhs, c1) => parse_assignment_tail(c, lhs, c1, depth)

defs.name: parse_assignment_tail
defs.source:
fn parse_assignment_tail(
  saved : Cursor,
  lhs : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":=") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(value, c1) =>
        match lhs.node of
          EVar(name) => PTook(made(saved, c1, EAssign(name, value)), c1)
          EIndex(recv, key) =>
            PTook(made(saved, c1, EIndexAssign(recv, key, value)), c1)
          _ =>
            PFault(
                refuse(
                    lhs.span,
                    "the left side of `:=` must be a variable or an index `a[i]`",
                  ),
              )
  elif (at_fixed(c, "+=")
      || at_fixed(c, "-=")
      || at_fixed(c, "*=")
      || at_fixed(c, "%=")) then
    let op =
      if at_fixed(c, "+=") then
        "+"
      elif at_fixed(c, "-=") then
        "-"
      elif at_fixed(c, "*=") then
        "*"
      else
        "%"
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(value, c1) => build_compound(saved, lhs, op, value, c1)
  else
    PTook(lhs, c)

defs.name: build_compound
parse_expr_or_block
defs.source:
fn parse_expr_or_block(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVOpen) then
    parse_block(c, depth)
  else
    parse_expr(c, depth)
defs.doc: Parse an expression or a layout-delimited statement block. Declaration bodies use the same production as control-flow branches, so this seam is public to `Syntax.Parse.Decl` rather than duplicated there.

defs.name: parse_if_form
defs.source:
fn parse_if_form(
  saved : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  allow_open : Bool
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_expr(cursor_advance(saved), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(cond, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "then") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(yes, c3) =>
              match (parse_if_finish(saved, cond, yes, c3, depth, allow_open)) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(branch, c4) => PTook(branch.expr, c4)

defs.name: parse_if_finish
defs.source:
fn parse_if_finish(
  saved : Cursor,
  cond : Sp(Expr),
  yes : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  allow_open : Bool
) : Parsed(IfBranch) =
  let tail =
    if (at_kind(c, TVSemi) && (fixed_at(c, 1, "else") || fixed_at(c, 1, "elif"))) then
      cursor_advance(c)
    else
      c
  if at_fixed(tail, "else") then
    match parse_expr_or_block(cursor_advance(tail), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(no, c1) =>
        PTook(
            IfBranch {
              expr = made(saved, c1, EIf(cond, yes, no)),
              open = false
            },
            c1,
          )
  elif at_fixed(tail, "elif") then
    match parse_elif(c, tail, depth, allow_open) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(branch, c1) =>
        let no =
          if branch.open then
            widen_if_chain(branch.expr, cursor_span(saved).lo)
          else
            branch.expr
        PTook(
            IfBranch {
              expr = made(saved, c1, EIf(cond, yes, no)),
              open = branch.open
            },
            c1,
          )
  elif allow_open then
    let unit = zero_width(EUnit, yes.span.hi)
    PTook(
        IfBranch { expr = made(saved, c, EIf(cond, yes, unit)), open = true },
        c,
      )
  else
    let c1 = cursor_note(cursor_note(tail, TFixed("else")), TFixed("elif"))
    PStuck(c1)

defs.name: parse_elif
defs.source:
fn parse_elif(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  allow_open : Bool
) : Parsed(IfBranch) =
  match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(cond, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "then") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(yes, c3) =>
              parse_if_finish(saved, cond, yes, c3, depth, allow_open)

defs.name: widen_if_chain
parse_let_form
defs.source:
fn parse_let_form(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_kind(c1, TIdent) then
    match take_word(c1, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c2) =>
        match take_fixed(c2, "=") of
          PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c3) =>
            match parse_expr(c3, depth) of
              PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c4) =>
                match take_fixed(c4, "in") of
                  PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(_, c5) =>
                    match parse_expr(c5, depth) of
                      PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(body, c6) =>
                        PTook(made(saved, c6, ELet(name, value, body)), c6)
  else
    match parse_pattern(c1, depth) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(pat, c2) =>
        match take_fixed(c2, "=") of
          PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c3) =>
            match parse_expr(c3, depth) of
              PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c4) =>
                match take_fixed(c4, "in") of
                  PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(_, c5) =>
                    match parse_expr(c5, depth) of
                      PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(body, c6) =>
                        let arm = Arm { pat = pat, guard = None, body = body }
                        PTook(
                            synthesized(
                                EMatch(value, [arm]),
                                cursor_span(saved).lo,
                                cursor_span(saved).lo,
                              ),
                            c6,
                          )

defs.name: parse_lambda
defs.source:
fn parse_lambda(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  match take_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "(") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match parse_params(c1, depth, 0, Nil) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(params, c2) =>
          match take_fixed(c2, ")") of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              match take_fixed(c3, "->") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_expr(c4, depth) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(body, c5) =>
                      PTook(made(saved, c5, ELam(params, body)), c5)

defs.name: parse_throw
defs.source:
fn parse_throw(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TUid) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      if at_fixed(c1, "(") then
        match parse_expr_comma(cursor_advance(c1), depth, ")", Nil) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(args, c2) =>
            match take_fixed(c2, ")") of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) => PTook(made(saved, c3, EThrow(name, args)), c3)
      else
        PTook(made(saved, c1, EThrow(name, Nil)), c1)

defs.name: parse_return
defs.source:
fn parse_return(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(value, c1) => PTook(made(c, c1, EReturn(value)), c1)

defs.name: parse_while
defs.source:
fn parse_while(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(cond, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "do") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(body, c3) => PTook(made(c, c3, EWhile(cond, body)), c3)

defs.name: parse_loop
defs.source:
fn parse_loop(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_expr_or_block(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(body, c1) => PTook(made(c, c1, ELoop(body)), c1)

defs.name: parse_transact
defs.source:
fn parse_transact(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_expr_or_block(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(body, c1) =>
      let c2 =
        if at_kind(c1, TVSemi) then
          cursor_advance(c1)
        else
          c1
      match take_fixed(c2, "else") of
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c3) =>
          match parse_expr_or_block(c3, depth) of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(fallback, c4) =>
              PTook(made(c, c4, ETransact(body, fallback)), c4)

defs.name: parse_probe
defs.source:
fn parse_probe(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TStr) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "do") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(body, c3) => PTook(made(c, c3, EProbe(name, body)), c3)

defs.name: parse_reflect
defs.source:
fn parse_reflect(c : Cursor) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  let decl =
    if at_fixed(c1, "fn") then
      "fn"
    else
      "type"
  let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
  match cursor_peek(c2) of
    None =>
      PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(cursor_note(c2, TIdent), TUid), TQual))
    Some(t) =>
      if t.kind == TIdent || t.kind == TUid || t.kind == TQual then
        let c3 = cursor_advance(c2)
        PTook(made(c, c3, EReflect(decl, token_text(t))), c3)
      else
        PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(cursor_note(c2, TIdent), TUid), TQual))

defs.name: parse_for
defs.source:
fn parse_for(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(binder, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "in") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(seq, c3) =>
              match parse_quals(c3, depth, Nil, "do") of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(qs, c4) =>
                  match take_fixed(c4, "do") of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      match parse_expr_or_block(c5, depth) of
                        PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                        PTook(body, c6) =>
                          PTook(made(c, c6, EFor(binder, seq, qs, body)), c6)

defs.name: parse_params
defs.source:
fn parse_params(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  index : Int,
  acc : List(Param)
) : Parsed(List(Param)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(acc, c)
  else
    match parse_param(c, depth, index) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(param, c1) =>
        let next = append(acc, [param])
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_params(cursor_advance(c1), depth, index + 1, next)
        else
          PTook(next, c1)

defs.name: parse_param
defs.source:
fn parse_param(c : Cursor, depth : Int, index : Int) : Parsed(Param) =
  let borrowed = at_fixed(c, "borrow")
  let c1 =
    if borrowed then
      cursor_advance(c)
    else
      c
  match parse_pattern(c1, depth) of
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(pat, c2) =>
      match parse_param_type(c2, depth) of
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(ty, c3) =>
          match parse_param_default(c3, depth) of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(dflt, c4) =>
              match pat.node of
                PVar(name) =>
                  PTook(
                      Param {
                        name = name,
                        pat = None,
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      },
                      c4,
                    )
                PWild =>
                  PTook(
                      Param {
                        name = "_",
                        pat = None,
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      },
                      c4,
                    )
                _ =>
                  PTook(
                      Param {
                        name = "arg@{index}",
                        pat = Some(pat),
                        ty = ty,
                        is_borrow = borrowed,
                        dflt = dflt
                      },
                      c4,
                    )

defs.name: parse_param_type
defs.source:
fn parse_param_type(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":") then
    match parse_type(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(ty, c1) => PTook(Some(ty), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.name: parse_param_default
defs.source:
fn parse_param_default(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Sp(Expr))) =
  if at_fixed(c, ":=") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => PTook(Some(e), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.name: parse_brace_open
defs.source:
fn parse_brace_open(c : Cursor) : Parsed(Bool) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    PTook(false, cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_kind(c, TVOpen) then
    PTook(true, cursor_advance(c))
  else
    let c1 = cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed("\{")), TVOpen)
    PStuck(c1)

defs.name: at_brace_close
defs.source:
fn at_brace_close(c : Cursor, layout : Bool) : Bool =
  if layout then
    at_kind(c, TVClose)
  else
    at_fixed(c, "\}")

defs.name: take_brace_close
defs.source:
fn take_brace_close(c : Cursor, layout : Bool) : Parsed(Token) =
  if layout then
    take_kind(c, TVClose)
  else
    take_fixed(c, "\}")

defs.name: note_arm_close_if_same
defs.source:
fn note_arm_close_if_same(
  start : Cursor,
  failed : Cursor,
  layout : Bool
) : Cursor =
  if failed.pos == start.pos then
    if layout then
      cursor_note(failed, TVClose)
    else
      cursor_note(failed, TFixed("\}"))
  else
    failed

defs.name: skip_arm_sep
defs.source:
fn skip_arm_sep(c : Cursor) : (Bool, Cursor) =
  if at_fixed(c, ",") || at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
    (true, cursor_advance(c))
  else
    (false, c)

defs.name: parse_match
defs.source:
fn parse_match(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(scrutinee, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "of") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_brace_open(c2) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(layout, c3) =>
              match parse_match_arms(c3, depth, layout, Nil) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(arms, c4) =>
                  match take_brace_close(c4, layout) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c5) =>
                      PTook(made(saved, c5, EMatch(scrutinee, arms)), c5)

defs.name: parse_match_arms
defs.source:
fn parse_match_arms(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  layout : Bool,
  acc : List(Arm)
) : Parsed(List(Arm)) =
  if at_brace_close(c, layout) then
    PTook(acc, c)
  else
    match parse_pattern(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(note_arm_close_if_same(c, c1, layout))
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(pat, c1) =>
        match parse_guard(c1, depth) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(guard, c2) =>
            match take_fixed(c2, "=>") of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                match parse_expr_or_block(c3, depth) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(body, c4) =>
                    let next = append(acc, [
                        Arm { pat = pat, guard = guard, body = body },
                      ])
                    let sep = skip_arm_sep(c4)
                    match sep of
                      (true, c5) => parse_match_arms(c5, depth, layout, next)
                      (false, c5) =>
                        if at_brace_close(c5, layout) then
                          PTook(next, c5)
                        else
                          let c6 =
                            cursor_note(cursor_note(c5, TFixed(",")), TVSemi)
                          PStuck(c6)

defs.name: parse_guard
defs.source:
fn parse_guard(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Option(Sp(Expr))) =
  if at_fixed(c, "if") then
    match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(g, c1) => PTook(Some(g), c1)
  else
    PTook(None, c)

defs.name: parse_try
defs.source:
fn parse_try(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  match parse_expr_or_block(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(body, c1) =>
      let c2 =
        if at_kind(c1, TVSemi) then
          cursor_advance(c1)
        else
          c1
      match take_fixed(c2, "catch") of
        PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c3) =>
          match parse_brace_open(c3) of
            PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(layout, c4) =>
              match parse_catch_arms(c4, depth, layout, Nil) of
                PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(arms, c5) =>
                  match take_brace_close(c5, layout) of
                    PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(_, c6) =>
                      PTook(made(saved, c6, ETryCatch(body, arms)), c6)

defs.name: parse_catch_arms
defs.source:
fn parse_catch_arms(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  layout : Bool,
  acc : List(CatchArm)
) : Parsed(List(CatchArm)) =
  if at_brace_close(c, layout) then
    PTook(acc, c)
  else
    let saved = c
    match take_word(c, TUid) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match parse_binders_maybe(c1) of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(binders, c2) =>
            match take_fixed(c2, "=>") of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                match parse_expr_or_block(c3, depth) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(body, c4) =>
                    let arm = CatchArm {
                      name = name,
                      binders = binders,
                      body = body,
                      span = cursor_since(saved, c4)
                    }
                    let next = append(acc, [arm])
                    let sep = skip_arm_sep(c4)
                    match sep of
                      (true, c5) => parse_catch_arms(c5, depth, layout, next)
                      (false, c5) =>
                        if at_brace_close(c5, layout) then
                          PTook(next, c5)
                        else
                          PStuck(
                              cursor_note(cursor_note(c5, TFixed(",")), TVSemi),
                            )

defs.name: parse_binders_maybe
defs.source:
fn parse_binders_maybe(c : Cursor) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "(") then
    parse_binders(cursor_advance(c), Nil)
  else
    PTook(Nil, c)

defs.name: parse_binders
defs.source:
fn parse_binders(c : Cursor, acc : List(String)) : Parsed(List(String)) =
  if at_fixed(c, ")") then
    PTook(acc, cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        let next = append(acc, [name])
        if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
          parse_binders(cursor_advance(c1), next)
        else
          match take_fixed(c1, ")") of
            PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c2) => PTook(next, c2)

defs.name: parse_handle
defs.source:
fn parse_handle(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  match parse_expr(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(body, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "with") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          let partial = peek_word(c2) == "partial"
          let c3 =
            if partial then
              cursor_advance(c2)
            else
              c2
          if at_kind(c3, TIdent) then
            fail_at(c3, "unknown handler mode (expected `partial`)")
          else
            match parse_brace_open(c3) of
              PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(layout, c4) =>
                match parse_handler_arms(c4, depth, layout, Nil) of
                  PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(arms, c5) =>
                    match take_brace_close(c5, layout) of
                      PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(_, c6) =>
                        PTook(made(saved, c6, EHandle(body, arms, partial)), c6)

defs.name: parse_handler_arms
defs.source:
fn parse_handler_arms(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  layout : Bool,
  acc : List(HandlerArm)
) : Parsed(List(HandlerArm)) =
  if at_brace_close(c, layout) then
    PTook(acc, c)
  else
    match parse_handler_arm(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(arm, c1) =>
        let next = append(acc, [arm])
        let sep = skip_arm_sep(c1)
        match sep of
          (true, c2) => parse_handler_arms(c2, depth, layout, next)
          (false, c2) =>
            if at_brace_close(c2, layout) then
              PTook(next, c2)
            else
              PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(c2, TFixed(",")), TVSemi))

defs.name: parse_handler_arm
defs.source:
fn parse_handler_arm(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(HandlerArm) =
  if at_fixed(c, "return") then
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "=>") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(body, c3) => PTook(HReturn(name, body), c3)
  elif at_fixed(c, "val") then
    match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c1) =>
        match take_fixed(c1, "=") of
          PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c2) =>
            match parse_expr_or_block(c2, depth) of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(body, c3) => PTook(HVal(name, body), c3)
  elif at_kind(c, TIdent) && kind_at(c, 1, TIdent) then
    parse_graded_arm(c, depth)
  else
    parse_operation_arm(c, depth)

defs.name: parse_graded_arm
defs.source:
fn parse_graded_arm(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(HandlerArm) =
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(grade, c1) =>
      match take_word(c1, TIdent) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(name, c2) =>
          if grade == "many" then
            fail_run(
                c,
                c2,
                "a `many` clause binds a continuation after `resume` and takes no leading grade",
              )
          elif grade /= "once" && grade /= "never" then
            fail_run(
                c,
                c2,
                "unknown handler grade (expected `once` or `never`)",
              )
          else
            match take_fixed(c2, "(") of
              PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(_, c3) =>
                match parse_binders(c3, Nil) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(params, c4) =>
                    match take_fixed(c4, "=>") of
                      PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(_, c5) =>
                        match parse_expr_or_block(c5, depth) of
                          PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                          PTook(body, c6) =>
                            if grade == "once" then
                              PTook(HOnce(name, params, body), c6)
                            else
                              PTook(HNever(name, params, body), c6)

defs.name: parse_operation_arm
defs.source:
fn parse_operation_arm(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(HandlerArm) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, "(") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_binders(c2, Nil) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(params, c3) =>
              if peek_word(c3) /= "resume" then
                fail_run(
                    saved,
                    c3,
                    "a multishot clause names its continuation after `resume`",
                  )
              else
                match take_word(cursor_advance(c3), TIdent) of
                  PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(resume, c4) =>
                    match take_fixed(c4, "=>") of
                      PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(_, c5) =>
                        match parse_expr_or_block(c5, depth) of
                          PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                          PTook(body, c6) =>
                            PTook(HOp(name, params, resume, body), c6)

defs.name: parse_block
defs.source:
fn parse_block(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c0) => PStuck(c0)
    PFault(d0) => PFault(d0)
    PTook(spent, _c0) => parse_block_at(c, spent)

defs.name: parse_block_at
defs.source:
fn parse_block_at(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  match take_kind(c, TVOpen) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      match parse_stmts(c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(body, c2) =>
          match take_kind(c2, TVClose) of
            PStuck(c3) =>
              -- A completed Stmts can either continue through its separator
              -- or let BlockExpr consume the close. Do not merge an older
              -- position if the close primitive ever gains consuming failure.
              if c3.pos == c2.pos then
                PStuck(cursor_note(c3, TVSemi))
              else
                PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) =>
              let span = cursor_since(saved, c3)
              PTook(
                  Sp { node = body.node, span = span, synth = body.synth },
                  c3,
                )

defs.name: parse_stmts
defs.source:
fn parse_stmts(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "let") then
    parse_let_stmt(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "var") then
    parse_var_stmt(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "with") then
    parse_with_stmt(c, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c, "if") then
    match parse_if_form(c, depth, true) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => parse_stmt_rest(c, e, c1, depth)
  elif at_kind(c, TVClose) then
    PStuck(note_expr(c))
  else
    match parse_expr(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(e, c1) => parse_stmt_rest(c, e, c1, depth)

defs.name: parse_stmt_rest
defs.source:
fn parse_stmt_rest(
  saved : Cursor,
  e : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  if at_kind(c, TVSemi) then
    match parse_stmts(cursor_advance(c), depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(rest, c1) =>
        match try_scrutinee(e) of
          Some(scrutinee) =>
            PTook(
                build_try_stmt(None, scrutinee, rest, cursor_span(saved).lo),
                c1,
              )
          None => PTook(made(saved, c1, ELet("_", e, rest)), c1)
  else
    PTook(e, c)

defs.name: try_scrutinee
defs.source:
fn try_scrutinee(e : Sp(Expr)) : Option(Sp(Expr)) =
  match e.node of
    ECall(head, args) =>
      match head.node of
        EMarker(marker) =>
          if marker == "try" then
            match args of
              Cons(scrutinee, Nil) => Some(scrutinee)
              _ => None
          else
            None
        _ => None
    _ => None

defs.name: build_try_stmt
build_pattern_let_stmt
defs.source:
fn build_pattern_let_stmt(
  pat : Sp(Pat),
  value : Sp(Expr),
  rest : Sp(Expr),
  lo : Int
) : Sp(Expr) =
  match try_scrutinee(value) of
    Some(scrutinee) => build_try_stmt(Some(pat), scrutinee, rest, lo)
    None =>
      let arm = Arm { pat = pat, guard = None, body = rest }
      synthesized(EMatch(value, [arm]), lo, lo)

defs.name: parse_with_rest
parse_with_stmt
defs.source:
fn parse_with_stmt(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_kind(c1, TIdent) && fixed_at(c1, 1, "<-") then
    match take_word(c1, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c2) =>
        match take_fixed(c2, "<-") of
          PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c3) =>
            if at_fixed(c3, "handler") then
              parse_named_with_handler(c, name, cursor_advance(c3), depth)
            else
              match parse_postfix(c3, depth) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(call, c4) =>
                  finish_with_call(c, Some(name), call, c4, depth)
  elif at_fixed(c1, "handler") then
    parse_anonymous_with_handler(c, cursor_advance(c1), depth)
  else
    match parse_postfix(c1, depth) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(call, c2) => finish_with_call(c, None, call, c2, depth)

defs.name: finish_with_call
defs.source:
fn finish_with_call(
  saved : Cursor,
  binder : Option(String),
  call : Sp(Expr),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_with_rest(saved, c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(rest, c1) =>
      let params =
        match binder of
          None => Nil
          Some(name) =>
            [
                Param {
                  name = name,
                  pat = None,
                  ty = None,
                  is_borrow = false,
                  dflt = None
                },
              ]
      let lo = cursor_span(saved).lo
      let lam = synthesized(ELam(params, rest), lo, lo)
      let node =
        match call.node of
          ECall(head, args) => ECall(head, append(args, [lam]))
          _ => ECall(call, [lam])
      PTook(authored(node, lo, cursor_since(saved, c1).hi), c1)

defs.name: parse_with_handler_arms
defs.source:
fn parse_with_handler_arms(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(HandlerArm)) =
  match parse_brace_open(c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(layout, c1) =>
      match parse_handler_arms(c1, depth, layout, Nil) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(arms, c2) =>
          match take_brace_close(c2, layout) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(_, c3) => PTook(arms, c3)

defs.name: parse_named_with_handler
defs.source:
fn parse_named_with_handler(
  saved : Cursor,
  name : String,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_with_handler_arms(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(arms, c1) =>
      match parse_with_rest(saved, c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(rest, c2) =>
          PTook(made(saved, c2, ENamedHandle(name, rest, arms)), c2)

defs.name: parse_anonymous_with_handler
defs.source:
fn parse_anonymous_with_handler(
  saved : Cursor,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  match parse_with_handler_arms(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(arms, c1) =>
      match parse_with_rest(saved, c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(rest, c2) =>
          let lo = cursor_span(saved).lo
          PTook(synthesized(EHandle(rest, arms, false), lo, lo), c2)

defs.name: parse_let_stmt
defs.source:
fn parse_let_stmt(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_kind(c1, TIdent) then
    match take_word(c1, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(name, c2) =>
        match take_fixed(c2, "=") of
          PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c3) =>
            match parse_expr_or_block(c3, depth) of
              PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c4) =>
                let c5 =
                  if at_fixed(c4, "in") then
                    cursor_advance(c4)
                  else
                    c4
                match take_kind(c5, TVSemi) of
                  PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(_, c6) =>
                    match parse_stmts(c6, depth) of
                      PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(rest, c7) =>
                        match try_scrutinee(value) of
                          Some(scrutinee) =>
                            let binder = authored(
                                PVar(name),
                                scrutinee.span.lo,
                                scrutinee.span.hi,
                              )
                            PTook(
                                build_try_stmt(
                                    Some(binder),
                                    scrutinee,
                                    rest,
                                    cursor_span(saved).lo,
                                  ),
                                c7,
                              )
                          None =>
                            PTook(made(saved, c7, ELet(name, value, rest)), c7)
  else
    match parse_let_pattern(c1, depth) of
      PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(pat, c2) =>
        match take_fixed(c2, "=") of
          PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)
          PTook(_, c3) =>
            match parse_expr_or_block(c3, depth) of
              PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
              PFault(d) => PFault(d)
              PTook(value, c4) =>
                let c5 =
                  if at_fixed(c4, "in") then
                    cursor_advance(c4)
                  else
                    c4
                match take_kind(c5, TVSemi) of
                  PStuck(c6) => PStuck(c6)
                  PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                  PTook(_, c6) =>
                    match parse_stmts(c6, depth) of
                      PStuck(c7) => PStuck(c7)
                      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                      PTook(rest, c7) =>
                        PTook(
                            build_pattern_let_stmt(
                                pat,
                                value,
                                rest,
                                cursor_span(saved).lo,
                              ),
                            c7,
                          )

defs.name: parse_var_stmt
defs.source:
fn parse_var_stmt(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Expr)) =
  let saved = c
  match take_word(cursor_advance(c), TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(name, c1) =>
      match take_fixed(c1, ":=") of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(_, c2) =>
          match parse_expr(c2, depth) of
            PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
            PFault(d) => PFault(d)
            PTook(value, c3) =>
              match take_kind(c3, TVSemi) of
                PStuck(c4) => PStuck(c4)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(_, c4) =>
                  match parse_stmts(c4, depth) of
                    PStuck(c5) => PStuck(c5)
                    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                    PTook(rest, c5) =>
                      PTook(made(saved, c5, EVarDecl(name, value, rest)), c5)

defs.name: generated_bind
defs.ty: forall a b. (Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(a), (a, Syntax.Cursor.Cursor) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(b)) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(b)
defs.source:
fn generated_bind(
  parsed : Parsed(a),
  next : (a, Cursor) -> Parsed(b)
) : Parsed(b) =
  match parsed of
    PTook(value, c) => next(value, c)
    PStuck(c) => PStuck(c)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)

defs.name: generated_spend
defs.ty: forall a. (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int, (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(a)) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(a)
defs.source:
fn generated_spend(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  body : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(a)
) : Parsed(a) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(d, c1) => body(c1, d)

defs.name: generated_repeat
defs.ty: forall a. (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int, Int, (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(a)) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(List(a))
defs.source:
fn generated_repeat(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  minimum : Int,
  parse_item : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(a)
) : Parsed(List(a)) =
  if minimum > 0 then
    match parse_item(c, depth) of
      PTook(item, c1) => generated_repeat_more(c1, depth, parse_item, [item])
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
  else
    generated_repeat_more(c, depth, parse_item, Nil)

defs.name: generated_repeat_more
defs.ty: forall a. (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int, (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(a), List(a)) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(List(a))
defs.source:
fn generated_repeat_more(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_item : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(a),
  rev : List(a)
) : Parsed(List(a)) =
  match parse_item(c, depth) of
    PTook(item, c1) =>
      if c1.pos == c.pos then
        PTook(reverse(rev), c1)
      else
        generated_repeat_more(c1, depth, parse_item, Cons(item, rev))
    PStuck(c1) =>
      if c1.pos == c.pos then
        PTook(reverse(rev), cursor_restore(c, c1))
      else
        PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)

defs.name: generated_choice
defs.source:
fn generated_choice(
  c : Cursor,
  left : (Cursor) -> Parsed(a),
  right : (Cursor) -> Parsed(a)
) : Parsed(a) =
  match left(c) of
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(l, lc) =>
      match right(c) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(r, rc) =>
          if rc.pos > lc.pos then
            PTook(r, generated_merge_cursor(rc, lc, rc))
          else
            PTook(l, generated_merge_cursor(lc, lc, rc))
        PStuck(rc) =>
          if rc.far > lc.pos then
            PStuck(generated_merge_cursor(rc, lc, rc))
          else
            PTook(l, generated_merge_cursor(lc, lc, rc))
    PStuck(lc) =>
      match right(c) of
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(r, rc) =>
          if lc.far > rc.pos then
            PStuck(generated_merge_cursor(lc, lc, rc))
          else
            PTook(r, generated_merge_cursor(rc, lc, rc))
        PStuck(rc) =>
          PStuck(
              generated_merge_cursor(
                  if lc.far >= rc.far then lc else rc,
                  lc,
                  rc,
                ),
            )

defs.ty: forall a b c. (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int, String, Syntax.Parse.GeneratedControl.GeneratedSeparatedPhase, (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(a), (a) -> b, (a) -> c, (Syntax.Parse.GeneratedControl.GeneratedSeparatedPhase, Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, String) -> Syntax.Parse.GeneratedControl.GeneratedSeparatedDecision, (Syntax.Parse.GeneratedControl.GeneratedSeparatedPhase, Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, c, String) -> Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, List(b)) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(List(b))
