defs.name: generated_separated_at
defs.ty: forall a b c. (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int, String, (Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, Int) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(a), (a) -> b, (a) -> c, (Syntax.Parse.GeneratedControl.GeneratedSeparatedPhase, Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, String) -> Syntax.Parse.GeneratedControl.GeneratedSeparatedDecision, (Syntax.Parse.GeneratedControl.GeneratedSeparatedPhase, Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, c, String) -> Syntax.Cursor.Cursor, List(b), Syntax.Parse.GeneratedControl.GeneratedSeparatedPhase, Bool) -> Syntax.Parse.Support.Parsed(List(b))
defs.source:
fn generated_separated_at(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  close : String,
  parse_item : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(x),
  item_value : (x) -> a,
  item_receipt : (x) -> r,
  before_item : (GeneratedSeparatedPhase, Cursor, String) -> GeneratedSeparatedDecision,
  note_follow : (GeneratedSeparatedPhase, Cursor, r, String) -> Cursor,
  rev : List(a),
  phase : GeneratedSeparatedPhase,
  consume_close : Bool
) : Parsed(List(a)) =
  let required =
    match phase of
      GSRequiredFirst => true
      _ => false
  if not(required) && at_fixed(c, close) then
    PTook(reverse(rev), if consume_close then cursor_advance(c) else c)
  else
    match before_item(phase, c, close) of
      GSReject(failed) => PStuck(failed)
      GSEnter =>
        match parse_item(c, depth) of
          PTook(item, c1) =>
            let value = item_value(item)
            let receipt = item_receipt(item)
            if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
              let next_phase =
                match phase of
                  GSRequiredFirst => GSInitial
                  _ => GSAfterSeparator
              generated_separated_at(
                  cursor_advance(c1),
                  depth,
                  close,
                  parse_item,
                  item_value,
                  item_receipt,
                  before_item,
                  note_follow,
                  Cons(value, rev),
                  next_phase,
                  consume_close,
                )
            elif at_fixed(c1, close) then
              PTook(
                  reverse(Cons(value, rev)),
                  if consume_close then cursor_advance(c1) else c1,
                )
            else
              PStuck(note_follow(phase, c1, receipt, close))
          PStuck(c1) =>
            PStuck(
                if c1.pos == c.pos then cursor_note(c1, TFixed(close)) else c1,
              )
          PFault(d) => PFault(d)

pattern_note_start
defs.source:
fn pattern_note_start(c : Cursor) : Cursor =
  foldl(cursor_note, c, [
      TIdent,
      TUid,
      TQual,
      TInt,
      TFloat,
      TChar,
      TFixed("true"),
      TFixed("false"),
      TFixed("-"),
      TFixed("["),
      TFixed("("),
    ])

defs.name: pattern_suppress
defs.source:
fn pattern_suppress(c : Cursor) : Bool =
  at_fixed(c, ":")
    || at_fixed(c, ":=")
    || at_fixed(c, "if")
    || at_fixed(c, "=>")
    || at_fixed(c, ")")
    || at_fixed(c, "]")
    || at_fixed(c, "\}")

defs.name: generated_pattern_note_receipt
defs.source:
fn generated_pattern_note_receipt(
  c : Cursor,
  receipt : GeneratedPatternReceipt
) : Cursor =
  if pattern_suppress(c) then
    c
  else
    match receipt of
      PRPlain => cursor_note(c, TFixed("|"))
      PRBareUid =>
        cursor_note(
            cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed("(")), TFixed("\{")),
            TFixed("|"),
          )
      PRBareQual => cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed("(")), TFixed("|"))

defs.name: generated_let_note_receipt
defs.source:
fn generated_let_note_receipt(
  c : Cursor,
  receipt : GeneratedLetReceipt
) : Cursor =
  match receipt of
    GLNamed =>
      if at_fixed(c, "=") then
        c
      else
        cursor_note(c, TFixed("("))
    GLClosed => c

generated_parse_let_pattern
generated_pattern_body
defs.source:
fn generated_pattern_body(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  let start = c
  generated_bind(generated_pat_alt(c, depth)) fn(first, c1)
    if at_fixed(c1, "|") then
      generated_or_tail(start, depth, c1, [pattern_value(first)])
    else
      PTook(first, c1)

defs.name: generated_or_tail
defs.source:
fn generated_or_tail(
  start : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  c : Cursor,
  rev : List(Sp(Pat))
) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  generated_bind(generated_pat_alt(cursor_advance(c), depth)) fn(next, c1)
    let rev1 = Cons(pattern_value(next), rev)
    if at_fixed(c1, "|") then
      generated_or_tail(start, depth, c1, rev1)
    else
      pattern_done(POr(reverse(rev1)), start, c1, pattern_receipt(next))

defs.name: generated_let_body
defs.source:
fn generated_let_body(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(GeneratedLetDone) =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    Some(TUid) => generated_let_ctor(c, depth)
    Some(TQual) => generated_let_ctor(c, depth)
    Some(TFixed(s)) =>
      if s == "(" then
        generated_bind(generated_tuple(c, depth)) fn(done, c1)
          PTook(LetDone(pattern_value(done), GLClosed), c1)
      else
        generated_let_miss(c)
    _ => generated_let_miss(c)

defs.name: generated_let_ctor
generated_let_miss
defs.source:
fn generated_let_miss(c : Cursor) : Parsed(GeneratedLetDone) =
  PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TUid), TQual), TFixed("(")))

defs.name: generated_pat_alt
defs.source:
fn generated_pat_alt(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    Some(TUid) => generated_uid(c, depth)
    Some(TQual) => generated_ctor(c, depth, PRBareQual)
    Some(TIdent) => generated_ident(c)
    Some(TInt) => generated_number(c, c, false, false)
    Some(TFloat) => generated_number(c, c, false, true)
    Some(TChar) =>
      pattern_done(PChar(peek_word(c)), c, cursor_advance(c), PRPlain)
    Some(TFixed(s)) =>
      if s == "true" then
        pattern_done(PBool(true), c, cursor_advance(c), PRPlain)
      elif s == "false" then
        pattern_done(PBool(false), c, cursor_advance(c), PRPlain)
      elif s == "-" then
        generated_negative(c)
      elif s == "[" then
        generated_list(c, depth)
      elif s == "(" then
        generated_tuple(c, depth)
      else
        PStuck(pattern_note_start(c))
    _ => PStuck(pattern_note_start(c))

defs.name: generated_uid
generated_ctor
generated_ident
generated_number
generated_negative
defs.source:
fn generated_negative(c : Cursor) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_kind(c1, TInt) then
    generated_number(c, c1, true, false)
  elif at_kind(c1, TFloat) then
    generated_number(c, c1, true, true)
  else
    PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(c1, TInt), TFloat))

defs.name: generated_args
defs.source:
fn generated_args(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(List(Sp(Pat))) =
  generated_pattern_separated(
      cursor_advance(c),
      depth,
      ")",
      "]",
      GSInitial,
      Nil,
    )

defs.name: generated_list
defs.source:
fn generated_list(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_fixed(c1, "]") then
    generated_list_done(c, Nil, cursor_advance(c1))
  else
    generated_bind(generated_pattern_separated(c1, depth, "]", ")", GSRequiredFirst, Nil)) fn(items, c2)
      generated_list_done(c, items, c2)

defs.name: generated_list_done
generated_tuple
defs.source:
fn generated_tuple(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  generated_bind(generated_parse_pattern(cursor_advance(c), depth)) fn(first, c1)
    match take_fixed(c1, ",") of
      PStuck(c2) =>
        PStuck(generated_pattern_note_receipt(c2, pattern_receipt(first)))
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(_, c2) =>
        generated_bind(generated_pattern_separated(c2, depth, ")", "]", GSInitial, [
            pattern_value(first),
          ])) fn(items, c3)
          pattern_done(PTuple(items), c, c3, PRPlain)

defs.name: generated_pattern_separated
defs.source:
fn generated_pattern_separated(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  close : String,
  wrong : String,
  start_phase : GeneratedSeparatedPhase,
  rev : List(Sp(Pat))
) : Parsed(List(Sp(Pat))) =
  generated_separated(
      c,
      depth,
      close,
      start_phase,
      generated_parse_pattern,
      pattern_value,
      pattern_receipt,
      \(phase, at, want) -> pattern_before(phase, at, want, wrong),
      \(phase, at, receipt, want) -> pattern_follow(phase, at, receipt, want, wrong),
      rev,
    )

defs.name: pattern_before
defs.source:
fn pattern_before(
  phase : GeneratedSeparatedPhase,
  c : Cursor,
  close : String,
  wrong : String
) : GeneratedSeparatedDecision =
  match phase of
    GSAfterSeparator =>
      if str_len(wrong) > 0 && at_fixed(c, wrong) then
        GSReject(cursor_note(c, TFixed(close)))
      else
        GSEnter
    GSRequiredFirst => GSEnter
    GSInitial => GSEnter

defs.name: pattern_follow
defs.source:
fn pattern_follow(
  _phase : GeneratedSeparatedPhase,
  c : Cursor,
  receipt : GeneratedPatternReceipt,
  close : String,
  wrong : String
) : Cursor =
  if str_len(wrong) > 0 && at_fixed(c, wrong) then
    match _phase of
      GSRequiredFirst =>
        generated_pattern_note_receipt(
            cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed(",")), TFixed(close)),
            receipt,
          )
      _ => cursor_note(c, TFixed(close))
  else
    generated_pattern_note_receipt(
        cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed(",")), TFixed(close)),
        receipt,
      )

defs.source:
fn generated_record(
  start : Cursor,
  name : String,
  open : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  generated_record_more(start, name, depth, cursor_advance(open), Nil)

defs.name: generated_record_more
defs.source:
fn generated_record_more(
  start : Cursor,
  name : String,
  depth : Int,
  c : Cursor,
  rev : List(PatField)
) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    generated_record_done(start, name, rev, false, cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_fixed(c, "..") then
    generated_record_rest(start, name, rev, c)
  else
    match generated_record_field(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) =>
        PStuck(
            if c1.pos == c.pos then cursor_note(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("..")), TFixed("\}")) else c1,
          )
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(done, c1) =>
        match done of
          FieldDone(field, receipt) =>
            let rev1 = Cons(field, rev)
            if at_fixed(c1, "\}") then
              generated_record_done(
                  start,
                  name,
                  rev1,
                  false,
                  cursor_advance(c1),
                )
            elif at_fixed(c1, ",") then
              let c2 = cursor_advance(c1)
              if at_fixed(c2, "\}") then
                generated_record_done(
                    start,
                    name,
                    rev1,
                    false,
                    cursor_advance(c2),
                  )
              elif at_fixed(c2, "..") then
                generated_record_rest(start, name, rev1, c2)
              else
                generated_record_more(start, name, depth, c2, rev1)
            else
              PStuck(generated_field_follow(c1, receipt))

defs.name: generated_record_rest
defs.source:
fn generated_record_rest(
  start : Cursor,
  name : String,
  rev : List(PatField),
  c : Cursor
) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  match take_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "\}") of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) => generated_record_done(start, name, rev, true, c1)

defs.source:
fn generated_record_done(
  start : Cursor,
  name : String,
  rev : List(PatField),
  spread : Bool,
  c : Cursor
) : Parsed(GeneratedPatternDone) =
  pattern_done(PRecord(name, reverse(rev), spread), start, c, PRPlain)

fn generated_parse_atype(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_type : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)),
  parse_type_arg : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty))
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    Some(TFixed(spelling)) => generated_fixed(spelling, c, depth, parse_type)
    Some(TIdent) => generated_name(c, depth, false, parse_type_arg)
    Some(TUid) => generated_name(c, depth, true, parse_type_arg)
    Some(TQual) => generated_name(c, depth, true, parse_type_arg)
    _ => generated_atype_miss(c)
defs.doc: Parse the complete 17-alternative AType production.

defs.name: generated_fixed
defs.source:
fn generated_fixed(
  spelling : String,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_type : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty))
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  if spelling == "Int" then
    generated_plain(TyInt, cursor_advance(c))
  elif spelling == "I64" then
    generated_plain(TyI64, cursor_advance(c))
  elif spelling == "U64" then
    generated_plain(TyU64, cursor_advance(c))
  elif spelling == "Bool" then
    generated_plain(TyBool, cursor_advance(c))
  elif spelling == "Unit" then
    generated_plain(TyUnit, cursor_advance(c))
  elif spelling == "Float" then
    generated_plain(TyFloat, cursor_advance(c))
  elif spelling == "Char" then
    generated_plain(TyChar, cursor_advance(c))
  elif spelling == "String" then
    generated_plain(TyStr, cursor_advance(c))
  elif spelling == "[" then
    generated_bind(parse_type(cursor_advance(c), depth)) fn(item, c1)
      let t = generated_child_value(item)
      let receipt = generated_child_receipt(item)
      if at_fixed(c1, "]") then
        generated_plain(TyCon("List", [t]), cursor_advance(c1))
      else
        PStuck(generated_type_note_close_follow(c1, receipt, "]"))
  elif spelling == "(" then
    generated_paren(c, depth, parse_type)
  elif spelling == "#" then
    generated_unboxed(c, depth, parse_type)
  else
    generated_atype_miss(c)

fn generated_paren(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_type : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty))
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  generated_bind(parse_type(cursor_advance(c), depth)) fn(first, c1)
    let t = generated_child_value(first)
    let receipt = generated_child_receipt(first)
    if at_fixed(c1, ",") then
      generated_bind(generated_type_separated(cursor_advance(c1), depth, ")", parse_type, [t])) fn(types, c2)
        generated_plain(TyTuple(types), c2)

fn generated_unboxed(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_type : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty))
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
  if at_fixed(c1, "(") then
    generated_bind(generated_type_separated(cursor_advance(c1), depth, ")", parse_type, Nil)) fn(types, c2)
      generated_plain(TyUnboxedTuple(types), c2)
  elif at_fixed(c1, "\{") then
    generated_bind(generated_type_separated(
        cursor_advance(c1),
        depth,
        "\}",
        \(x, d) -> generated_record_field(x, d, parse_type),
        Nil,
      )) fn(fields, c2)
      generated_plain(TyUnboxedRecord(fields), c2)
  else
    PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("(")), TFixed("\{")))

fn generated_type_suppress_receipt(c : Cursor) : Bool =
  cursor_at_end(c)
    || at_kind(c, TIdent)
    || at_kind(c, TVSemi)
    || at_kind(c, TVOpen)
    || at_kind(c, TVClose)
    || at_fixed(c, ":=")
    || at_fixed(c, "=")
    || at_fixed(c, ")")
    || at_fixed(c, "]")
    || at_fixed(c, "\}")
    || at_fixed(c, ",")
    || at_fixed(c, "given")
    || at_fixed(c, "requires")
    || at_fixed(c, "ensures")
    || at_fixed(c, "decreases")

defs.name: generated_type_note_receipt
defs.source:
fn generated_type_note_receipt(
  c : Cursor,
  receipt : GeneratedTypeReceipt
) : Cursor =
  match receipt of
    TRPlain =>
      cursor_note(
          cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed("!")), TFixed("->")),
          TFixed("@"),
        )
    TRNamed =>
      cursor_note(
          cursor_note(
              cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed("(")), TFixed("!")),
              TFixed("->"),
            ),
          TFixed("@"),
        )
    TRUsage => cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed("!")), TFixed("->"))
    TRBareEffect => cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed("\{")), TFixed("@"))
    TRClosedEffect => cursor_note(c, TFixed("@"))
    TRNat => cursor_note(c, TFixed("+"))
    TRRow => c
    TRDimIdent =>
      cursor_note(
          cursor_note(
              cursor_note(
                  cursor_note(cursor_note(c, TFixed("(")), TFixed("!")),
                  TFixed("->"),
                ),
              TFixed("@"),
            ),
          TFixed("+"),
        )
defs.doc: Exact wanted-token menu for each completed Type state.

fn generated_parse_type_arg_with(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_type_body : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)),
  parse_row_body : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(Row)
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  match descend(depth, c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(d, c1) =>
      generated_parse_type_arg_body(c1, d, parse_type_body, parse_row_body)

defs.name: generated_parse_type_arg_body
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_type_arg_body(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_type_body : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)),
  parse_row_body : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(Row)
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    generated_bind(parse_row_body(cursor_advance(c), depth)) fn(row, c1)
      PTook(TypeDone(TyRowLit(row), TRRow), c1)
  elif at_kind(c, TInt) || at_kind(c, TIdent) then
    match generated_parse_dim_term(c) of
      PTook(_term, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, "+") then
          generated_decline_dimension(c, cursor_advance(c1))
        elif at_kind(c, TInt) then
          generated_parse_natural(c)
        else
          generated_type_arg_fallback(c, depth, parse_type_body)
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
  else
    generated_type_arg_fallback(c, depth, parse_type_body)

defs.name: generated_type_arg_fallback
defs.source:
fn generated_type_arg_fallback(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_type_body : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty))
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  match parse_type_body(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) =>
      if c1.pos == c.pos then
        PStuck(cursor_note(cursor_note(c1, TInt), TFixed("\{")))
      else
        PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(done, c1) =>
      match done of
        TypeDone(t, receipt) =>
          if at_kind(c, TIdent) && c1.pos == c.pos + 1 then
            PTook(TypeDone(t, TRDimIdent), c1)
          else
            PTook(TypeDone(t, receipt), c1)

defs.name: generated_parse_natural
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_natural(c : Cursor) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  match cursor_peek(c) of
    None => PStuck(cursor_note(c, TInt))
    Some(t) =>
      let raw = token_text(t)
      let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
      if ends_with("i64", raw) || ends_with("u64", raw) then
        PFault(
            refuse(
                t.span,
                "a dimension is a plain natural literal; drop the width suffix",
              ),
          )
      else
        match parse_int(raw) of
          Some(n) =>
            if n <= 18446744073709551615 then
              PTook(TypeDone(TyNat(n), TRNat), c1)
            else
              PFault(refuse(t.span, "dimension literal is too large"))
          None => PFault(refuse(t.span, "dimension literal is too large"))

defs.name: generated_decline_dimension
defs.source:
fn generated_decline_dimension(
  saved : Cursor,
  tail : Cursor
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  match generated_parse_dim_tail(tail) of
    PStuck(c) => PStuck(c)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c) =>
      PFault(
          refuse(
              cursor_since(saved, c),
              "arithmetic on dimensions is not supported: a dimension is a plain natural literal (`0`, `1`, `2`, ...) or a type variable, and dimensions unify by equality only",
            ),
        )

defs.name: generated_parse_dim_tail
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_dim_tail(c : Cursor) : Parsed(Unit) =
  match generated_parse_dim_term(c) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c1) =>
      if at_fixed(c1, "+") then
        generated_parse_dim_tail(cursor_advance(c1))
      else
        PTook((), c1)

fn generated_parse_type_mode(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  head : Bool
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "forall") then
    generated_parse_forall(c, depth, head)
  else
    let saved = c
    match generated_parse_arrow_done(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) =>
        if c1.pos == c.pos then
          PStuck(cursor_note(c1, TFixed("forall")))
        else
          PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(done, c1) =>
        if head then
          PTook(done, c1)
        else
          generated_parse_arrow_effect_done(saved, done, c1, depth)

defs.name: generated_forall_tail
defs.source:
fn generated_forall_tail(
  first : String,
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  head : Bool
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  let (more, c1) = generated_ident_run(c, Nil)
  match take_fixed(c1, ".") of
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(generated_note_same(c1, c2, TIdent))
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(_, c2) =>
      let parsed =
        if head then
          generated_parse_type_head(c2, depth)
        else
          generated_parse_type(c2, depth)
      generated_bind(parsed) fn(done, c3)
        match done of
          TypeDone(body, receipt) =>
            PTook(TypeDone(TyForall(Cons(first, more), body), receipt), c3)

defs.name: generated_ident_run
defs.source:
fn generated_ident_run(
  c : Cursor,
  rev : List(String)
) : (List(String), Cursor) =
  match cursor_peek(c) of
    Some(t) =>
      if t.kind == TIdent then
        generated_ident_run(cursor_advance(c), Cons(token_text(t), rev))
      else
        (reverse(rev), c)
    None => (reverse(rev), c)

    cursor_note(failed, wanted)

defs.name: generated_parse_arrow_done
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_arrow_done(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "(") && at_fixed(cursor_advance(c), ")") then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(cursor_advance(c))
    generated_bind(take_fixed(c1, "->")) fn(_arrow, c2)
      generated_bind(generated_parse_arrow_nested(c2, depth)) fn(done, c3)
        match done of
          TypeDone(cod, receipt) =>
            PTook(TypeDone(TyFun(Nil, generated_empty_row(), cod), receipt), c3)
  else
    match generated_parse_usage_type_done(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(done, c1) =>
        if at_fixed(c1, "->") then
          generated_bind(generated_parse_arrow_nested(cursor_advance(c1), depth)) fn(cod_done, c2)
            match done of
              TypeDone(dom, _) =>
                match cod_done of
                  TypeDone(cod, receipt) =>
                    PTook(
                        TypeDone(
                            TyFun(
                                generated_domain_types(dom),
                                generated_empty_row(),
                                cod,
                              ),
                            receipt,
                          ),
                        c2,
                      )
        else
          PTook(done, c1)

generated_domain_types

fn generated_domain_types(t : Ty) : List(Ty) =
  match t of
    TyTuple(ts) => ts
    _ => [t]

defs.name: generated_empty_row
defs.source: fn generated_empty_row() : Row = Row { labels = Nil, tail = None }

defs.name: generated_parse_usage_type_done
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_usage_type_done(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  let saved = c
  match (generated_parse_atype(
        c,
        depth,
        generated_parse_type,
        generated_parse_type_arg,
      )) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(done, c1) =>
      match done of
        TypeDone(t, _) =>
          if at_fixed(c1, "@") then
            generated_bind(generated_parse_usage_parts(cursor_advance(c1))) fn(parts, c2)
              match (validate_usage(saved, t, parts.facts, parts.open_tail, c2)) of
                PStuck(c3) => PStuck(c3)
                PFault(d) => PFault(d)
                PTook(used, c3) => PTook(TypeDone(used, TRUsage), c3)
          else
            PTook(done, c1)

defs.name: generated_parse_arrow_effect_done
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_arrow_effect_done(
  saved : Cursor,
  done : GeneratedChild(Ty),
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int
) : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "!") then
    let braced = at_fixed(cursor_advance(c), "\{")
    generated_bind(generated_parse_effect_row(c, depth)) fn(row, c1)
      if at_fixed(c1, "@") then
        generated_bind(generated_parse_usage_parts(cursor_advance(c1))) fn(_parts, c2)
          PFault(
              refuse(
                  cursor_since(saved, c2),
                  "parenthesize the function type before `@`: write `((a) -> b ! \{E\}) @ fact`",
                ),
            )
      else
        match done of
          TypeDone(t, _) =>
            match t of
              TyFun(ps, _, cod) =>
                PTook(
                    TypeDone(
                        TyFun(ps, row, cod),
                        if braced then TRClosedEffect else TRBareEffect,
                      ),
                    c1,
                  )
              _ =>
                PFault(
                    refuse(
                        cursor_since(saved, c1),
                        "effect row `! \{..\}` only applies to a function type",
                      ),
                  )
  else
    PTook(done, c)

              GeneratedRowItem(

              cursor_advance(c),

fn generated_parse_eff_labels_body(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Row) =

    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(items, c1) =>
      match items of
        GDClosed(labels) => PTook(Row { labels = labels, tail = None }, c1)
        GDOpen(labels, tail) =>

defs.name: generated_parse_delimited
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_delimited(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_item : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedRowItem(a))
) : Parsed(GeneratedDelimited(a)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(GDClosed(Nil), cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_fixed(c, "|") then
    generated_parse_delimited_tail(cursor_advance(c), Nil)
  else
    match parse_item(c, depth) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(generated_note_row_entry(c, c1))
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(item, c1) =>
        match item of
          GeneratedRowItem(value, receipt) =>
            generated_parse_delimited_more(
                c1,
                depth,
                parse_item,
                [value],
                receipt,
              )

defs.name: generated_parse_delimited_more
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_delimited_more(
  c : Cursor,
  depth : Int,
  parse_item : (Cursor, Int) -> Parsed(GeneratedRowItem(a)),
  rev : List(a),
  receipt : GeneratedRowReceipt
) : Parsed(GeneratedDelimited(a)) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\}") then
    PTook(GDClosed(reverse(rev)), cursor_advance(c))
  elif at_fixed(c, "|") then
    generated_parse_delimited_tail(cursor_advance(c), rev)
  elif at_fixed(c, ",") then
    let c1 = cursor_advance(c)
    if at_fixed(c1, "\}") then
      PTook(GDClosed(reverse(rev)), cursor_advance(c1))
    elif at_fixed(c1, "|") then
      generated_parse_delimited_tail(cursor_advance(c1), rev)
    else
      match parse_item(c1, depth) of
        PStuck(c2) => PStuck(generated_note_row_entry(c1, c2))
        PFault(d) => PFault(d)
        PTook(item, c2) =>
          match item of
            GeneratedRowItem(value, next_receipt) =>
              generated_parse_delimited_more(
                  c2,
                  depth,
                  parse_item,
                  Cons(value, rev),
                  next_receipt,
                )
  else
    PStuck(generated_note_row_follow(c, receipt))

fn generated_note_row_entry(saved : Cursor, failed : Cursor) : Cursor =

defs.name: generated_parse_usage_parts
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_usage_parts(c : Cursor) : Parsed(GeneratedUsageParts) =
  if at_fixed(c, "\{") then
    generated_parse_usage_braces(cursor_advance(c))
  else
    match take_word(c, TIdent) of
      PStuck(c1) => PStuck(generated_note_same(c, c1, TFixed("\{")))
      PFault(d) => PFault(d)
      PTook(fact, c1) =>
        PTook(GeneratedUsageParts { facts = [fact], open_tail = false }, c1)

defs.name: generated_parse_usage_braces
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_usage_braces(c : Cursor) : Parsed(GeneratedUsageParts) =
  match generated_parse_delimited(c, 0, generated_parse_usage_item) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(items, c1) =>
      match items of
        GDClosed(facts) =>
          PTook(GeneratedUsageParts { facts = facts, open_tail = false }, c1)
        GDOpen(facts, _) =>
          PTook(GeneratedUsageParts { facts = facts, open_tail = true }, c1)

defs.name: generated_parse_usage_item
defs.source:
fn generated_parse_usage_item(
  c : Cursor,
  _depth : Int
) : Parsed(GeneratedRowItem(String)) =
  match take_word(c, TIdent) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(fact, c1) => PTook(GeneratedRowItem(fact, GRClosedItem), c1)

defs.name: parse_pattern
defs.source:
fn parse_pattern(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Pat)) =
  match generated_parse_pattern(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(done, c1) =>
      match done of
        PatternDone(pat, receipt) =>
          PTook(pat, generated_pattern_note_receipt(c1, receipt))

defs.name: parse_let_pattern
defs.source:
fn parse_let_pattern(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Sp(Pat)) =
  match generated_parse_let_pattern(c, depth) of
    PStuck(c1) => PStuck(c1)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(done, c1) =>
      match done of
        LetDone(pat, receipt) =>
          PTook(pat, generated_let_note_receipt(c1, receipt))

defs.name: pattern_int
pattern_float
pattern_list
pattern_list_tail
defs.source:
fn pattern_list_tail(items : List(Sp(Pat)), rest : Sp(Pat)) : Sp(Pat) =
  match items of
    Nil => rest
    Cons(head, tail) =>
      authored(
          PCtor("Cons", [head, pattern_list_tail(tail, rest)]),
          head.span.lo,
          head.span.hi,
        )

defs.name: Parsed
defs.source: type Parsed(a) = PTook(a, Cursor) | PStuck(Cursor) | PFault(Diagnostic)
defs.doc: One parse step: the value and the cursor after it, an unmet expectation held in the cursor's failure record, or a finished diagnostic that no expectation set can express.

defs.name: from_reply
defs.source:
fn from_reply(r : Reply(a)) : Parsed(a) =
  match r of
    Took(x, c) => PTook(x, c)
    Stuck(c) => PStuck(c)
defs.doc: Lift a cursor reply into a parse outcome.

defs.name: parsed_fault
defs.source:
fn parsed_fault(p : Parsed(a)) : Option(Diagnostic) =
  match p of
    PTook(_, _) => None
    PStuck(c) => Some(cursor_diagnostic(c))
    PFault(d) => Some(d)
defs.doc: Finish a parse outcome as the diagnostic it refuses with: the cursor's own merged-expectation diagnostic for a stuck parse, the carried diagnostic for a fault, and None for a success.

defs.name: refuse
defs.doc:
A deliberate parse refusal: the general parse code, the given span, the given message, and no generic expectation set, because the message names the exact rewrite or bound rather than a token menu. Migration diagnostics are built with this.

```prism
# import Syntax.Cursor (..)
refuse(span_at(3), "the retired form").code
```

```output
E7100
```

defs.name: depth_budget
defs.source: fn depth_budget() : Int = 2048
defs.doc: The recursion budget a whole-file parse starts with. Deep enough that no authored program meets it, small enough that a generated hostile input is refused with a diagnostic instead of exhausting the stack; the supported bound is pinned by test, one point below and one beyond.

defs.name: descend
defs.source:
fn descend(depth : Int, c : Cursor) : Parsed(Int) =
  if depth > 0 then
    PTook(depth - 1, c)
  else
    PFault(
        Diagnostic {
          code = "E7102",
          phase = DPParse,
          span = cursor_span(c),
          message = "nesting exceeds the parser's depth budget",
          expected = Nil,
          related = Nil
        },
      )
defs.doc:
Spend one level of the budget, or refuse structurally: a nesting depth past the budget is a diagnostic at the current token, never an abort.

```prism
# import Syntax.Cursor (..)
match descend(1, cursor_of(Nil, 0)) of
  PTook(d, _) => d
  _ => -1
```

```output
0
```

defs.name: token_text
defs.source:
fn token_text(t : Token) : String =
  match t.value of
    None => ""
    Some(v) => v
defs.doc: The decoded text a token carries, empty for a fixed token.

defs.name: peek_word
defs.source:
fn peek_word(c : Cursor) : String =
  match cursor_peek(c) of
    None => ""
    Some(t) => token_text(t)
defs.doc: The decoded text at the read position without consuming it, empty at the end or on a fixed token: the one lookahead a contextual keyword needs.

defs.name: surface_float
defs.source:
fn surface_float(s : String) : String =
  let ep = index_of("e+", s)
  let cap_ep = index_of("E+", s)
  if ep >= 0 then
    concat(substring(s, 0, ep + 1), substring(s, ep + 2, byte_len(s) - ep - 2))
  elif cap_ep >= 0 then
    concat(
        substring(s, 0, cap_ep + 1),
        substring(s, cap_ep + 2, byte_len(s) - cap_ep - 2),
      )
  elif contains(".", s) || contains("e", s) || contains("E", s) then
    s
  else
    concat(s, ".0")
defs.doc: Match Rust's stable `f64` debug spelling used by syntax artifacts. The Prism lexer has already round-tripped the value through `show_float`, which omits the `.0` on integral finite values.

defs.name: surface_int
defs.source:
fn surface_int(s : String) : String =
  match parse_int(s) of
    Some(n) => show_int(n)
    None => s
defs.doc: Canonical decimal spelling of an already-validated integer token.

defs.name: at_fixed
defs.source:
fn at_fixed(c : Cursor, s : String) : Bool =
  match cursor_peek(c) of
    None => false
    Some(t) => t.kind == TFixed(s)
defs.doc: Whether the token at the read position is the fixed spelling `s`.

defs.name: at_kind
defs.source:
fn at_kind(c : Cursor, k : TokenKind) : Bool =
  match cursor_kind(c) of
    None => false
    Some(kk) => kk == k
defs.doc: Whether the token at the read position is of kind `k`.

defs.name: take_fixed
defs.source:
fn take_fixed(c : Cursor, s : String) : Parsed(Token) =
  from_reply(cursor_expect_fixed(c, s))
defs.doc: Require the fixed spelling `s`, as a parse outcome.

defs.name: take_kind
defs.source:
fn take_kind(c : Cursor, k : TokenKind) : Parsed(Token) =
  from_reply(cursor_expect(c, k))
defs.doc: Require a token of kind `k`, as a parse outcome.

defs.name: take_word
defs.source:
fn take_word(c : Cursor, k : TokenKind) : Parsed(String) =
  match take_kind(c, k) of
    PTook(t, c2) => PTook(token_text(t), c2)
    PStuck(c2) => PStuck(c2)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
defs.doc: Require a token of kind `k` and return its decoded text.

defs.name: skip_fixed
defs.source:
fn skip_fixed(c : Cursor, s : String) : (Bool, Cursor) =
  if at_fixed(c, s) then
    (true, cursor_advance(c))
  else
    (false, c)
defs.doc: Consume the fixed spelling `s` if it is there, reporting whether it was: the optional-token step every trailing separator and modifier needs.

defs.name: parse_type
defs.source:
fn parse_type(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Ty) =
  strip_type_done(generated_parse_type(c, depth))
defs.doc: Parse one complete surface type.

defs.name: parse_type_head
defs.source:
fn parse_type_head(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Ty) =
  strip_type_done(generated_parse_type_head(c, depth))
defs.doc: Parse through the arrow layer while leaving a trailing effect suffix for declaration return-annotation disambiguation.

defs.name: parse_type_arg
defs.source:
fn parse_type_arg(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Ty) =
  strip_type_done(generated_parse_type_arg(c, depth))
defs.doc: Parse a type-constructor argument, including row and natural arguments.

defs.name: parse_effect_row
defs.source:
fn parse_effect_row(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(Row) =
  generated_parse_effect_row(c, depth)
defs.doc: Parse an effect suffix including its leading `!`.

defs.name: parse_eff_label
defs.source:
fn parse_eff_label(c : Cursor, depth : Int) : Parsed(EffLabel) =
  generated_parse_eff_label(c, depth)
defs.doc: Parse one effect label with optional constructor arguments.

defs.name: strip_type_done
defs.source:
fn strip_type_done(p : Parsed(GeneratedChild(Ty))) : Parsed(Ty) =
  match p of
    PStuck(c) => PStuck(c)
    PFault(d) => PFault(d)
    PTook(done, c) =>
      match done of
        TypeDone(t, receipt) =>
          PTook(t, generated_type_note_if_live(c, receipt))

defs.name: validate_usage
defs.source:
fn validate_usage(
  saved : Cursor,
  base : Ty,
  facts : List(String),
  open_tail : Bool,
  c : Cursor
) : Parsed(Ty) =
  let span = cursor_since(saved, c)
  if open_tail then
    PFault(
        refuse(
            span,
            "usage-row polymorphism (`@ \{fact | tail\}`) is reserved but not implemented",
          ),
      )
  else
    match validate_usage_facts(facts, Nil) of
      Ok(validated) => PTook(TyUsage(base, validated), c)
      Err(msg) => PFault(refuse(span, msg))

defs.name: validate_usage_facts
defs.source:
fn validate_usage_facts(
  facts : List(String),
  accepted : List(String)
) : Result(List(String), String) =
  match facts of
    Nil =>
      if is_nil(accepted) then
        Err("a usage row cannot be empty")
      else
        Ok(accepted)
    Cons(fact, rest) =>
      if not(known_usage_fact(fact)) then
        Err("unknown usage fact `{fact}`")
      elif has_usage_fact(fact, accepted) then
        Err("duplicate usage fact `{fact}`")
      else
        match conflicting_usage_fact(fact, accepted) of
          Some(prior) =>
            Err(
                "usage facts `{prior}` and `{fact}` contradict each other (same axis)",
              )
          None => validate_usage_facts(rest, insert_usage_fact(fact, accepted))

defs.name: known_usage_fact
defs.source:
fn known_usage_fact(fact : String) : Bool =
  fact == "aliased"
    || fact == "bounded_stack"
    || fact == "linear"
    || fact == "local"
    || fact == "many"
    || fact == "noalloc"
    || fact == "noescape"
    || fact == "once"
    || fact == "portable"
    || fact == "unique"

defs.name: usage_axis
defs.source:
fn usage_axis(fact : String) : String =
  if fact == "portable" then
    "mobility"
  elif fact == "local" || fact == "noescape" then
    "escape"
  elif fact == "once" || fact == "many" then
    "multiplicity"
  elif fact == "unique" || fact == "aliased" then
    "aliasing"
  elif fact == "noalloc" then
    "allocation"
  else
    "fip"

defs.name: usage_axis_exclusive
defs.source:
fn usage_axis_exclusive(fact : String) : Bool =
  fact /= "linear" && fact /= "bounded_stack"

defs.name: conflicting_usage_fact
defs.source:
fn conflicting_usage_fact(
  fact : String,
  accepted : List(String)
) : Option(String) =
  match accepted of
    Nil => None
    Cons(prior, rest) =>
      if (usage_axis_exclusive(fact) && usage_axis(prior) == usage_axis(fact)) then
        Some(prior)
      else
        conflicting_usage_fact(fact, rest)

defs.name: has_usage_fact
defs.source:
fn has_usage_fact(fact : String, facts : List(String)) : Bool =
  match facts of
    Nil => false
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if x == fact then
        true
      else
        has_usage_fact(fact, rest)

defs.name: insert_usage_fact
defs.source:
fn insert_usage_fact(fact : String, facts : List(String)) : List(String) =
  match facts of
    Nil => [fact]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if fact < x then
        Cons(fact, facts)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_usage_fact(fact, rest))

defs.name: DeclHead
defs.doc: The head of a top-level declaration: its leading keyword, the first name it binds, and the keyword's start offset.

defs.name: KindCount
defs.source: type KindCount = KindCount { kind: String, count: Int } deriving (Eq, Show)
defs.doc: One bucket of the token-kind histogram: a wire kind and how many raw tokens carried it.

defs.name: QueryReport
defs.source:
type QueryReport = QueryReport {
  digest: String,
  imports: List(String),
  comments: List(Span),
  decls: List(DeclHead),
  kinds: List(KindCount)
} deriving (Eq)
defs.doc: The full source inventory of an artifact.

defs.name: q_val
defs.source:
fn q_val(t : Token) : String =
  match t.value of
    Some(s) => s
    None => ""

defs.name: q_is_name
defs.source:
fn q_is_name(k : TokenKind) : Bool =
  match k of
    TIdent => true
    TUid => true
    TQual => true
    _ => false

defs.name: q_comments
defs.source:
fn q_comments(ts : List(Trivia)) : List(Span) =
  match ts of
    Nil => Nil
    Cons(t, rest) =>
      match t of
        TComment(s) => Cons(s, q_comments(rest))
        _ => q_comments(rest)

defs.name: q_bump
defs.source:
fn q_bump(acc : List(KindCount), k : String) : List(KindCount) =
  match acc of
    Nil => Cons(KindCount { kind = k, count = 1 }, Nil)
    Cons(p, rest) =>
      if p.kind == k then
        Cons(KindCount { kind = k, count = p.count + 1 }, rest)
      else
        Cons(p, q_bump(rest, k))

defs.name: q_kinds_go
defs.source:
fn q_kinds_go(ts : List(Token), acc : List(KindCount)) : List(KindCount) =
  match ts of
    Nil => acc
    Cons(t, rest) => q_kinds_go(rest, q_bump(acc, kind_name(t.kind)))

defs.name: q_kinds
defs.source: fn q_kinds(ts : List(Token)) : List(KindCount) = q_kinds_go(ts, Nil)

defs.name: q_flush
defs.source:
fn q_flush(cur : List(Token), out : List(List(Token))) : List(List(Token)) =
  match cur of
    Nil => out
    Cons(_, _) => Cons(reverse(cur), out)

defs.name: q_items_go
defs.source:
fn q_items_go(
  ts : List(Token),
  depth : Int,
  cur : List(Token),
  out : List(List(Token))
) : List(List(Token)) =
  match ts of
    Nil => reverse(q_flush(cur, out))
    Cons(t, rest) =>
      match t.kind of
        TVOpen => q_items_go(rest, depth + 1, cur, out)
        TVClose => q_items_go(rest, depth - 1, cur, out)
        TVSemi =>
          if depth == 1 then
            q_items_go(rest, depth, Nil, q_flush(cur, out))
          else
            q_items_go(rest, depth, cur, out)
        _ =>
          if depth == 1 then
            q_items_go(rest, depth, Cons(t, cur), out)
          else
            q_items_go(rest, depth, cur, out)

defs.name: q_items
defs.source:
fn q_items(parse : List(Token)) : List(List(Token)) =
  q_items_go(parse, 0, Nil, Nil)

defs.name: q_drop_pub
defs.source:
fn q_drop_pub(item : List(Token)) : List(Token) =
  match item of
    Nil => Nil
    Cons(h, rest) =>
      if kind_name(h.kind) == "pub" then
        rest
      else
        item

defs.name: q_first_name
defs.source:
fn q_first_name(ts : List(Token)) : String =
  match ts of
    Nil => ""
    Cons(t, rest) =>
      if q_is_name(t.kind) then
        q_val(t)
      else
        q_first_name(rest)

defs.name: q_head
q_heads
defs.source:
fn q_heads(items : List(List(Token))) : List(DeclHead) =
  match items of
    Nil => Nil
    Cons(it, rest) =>
      match q_head(it) of
        Some(d) => Cons(d, q_heads(rest))
        None => q_heads(rest)

defs.name: q_decls
defs.source: fn q_decls(parse : List(Token)) : List(DeclHead) = q_heads(q_items(parse))

defs.name: q_imports
defs.source:
fn q_imports(decls : List(DeclHead)) : List(String) =
  match decls of
    Nil => Nil
    Cons(d, rest) =>
      if d.keyword == "import" then
        Cons(d.name, q_imports(rest))
      else
        q_imports(rest)

defs.name: query
defs.doc: The full source inventory of a decoded artifact.

defs.name: query_lines
defs.source:
fn query_lines(r : QueryReport) : List(String) =
  flatten([
      ["digest {r.digest}"],
      map(\(m) -> "import {m}", r.imports),
      map(\(s) -> "comment {show_int(s.lo)} {show_int(s.hi)}", r.comments),
      map(\(d) -> "decl {d.keyword} {d.name} {show_int(d.lo)}", r.decls),
      map(\(k) -> "kind {k.kind} {show_int(k.count)}", r.kinds),
    ])
defs.doc: The inventory rendered as one stable line per fact: a `digest` line, then an `import` line per module, a `comment` line per span, a `decl` line per declaration head, and a `kind` line per histogram bucket. The ordering is deterministic, so the text is a machine-readable fingerprint of the source's surface identity.

defs.name: q_join
defs.source:
fn q_join(ls : List(String)) : String =
  match ls of
    Nil => ""
    Cons(l, Nil) => l
    Cons(l, rest) => "{l}\n{q_join(rest)}"

defs.name: query_text
defs.source: fn query_text(r : QueryReport) : String = q_join(query_lines(r))
defs.doc: The inventory rendered as one newline-joined block, ready to print in a single call. Same content and ordering as `query_lines`.

defs.name: RnUse
defs.source: type RnUse = RnUse { id: Int, span: Span, name: String }
defs.doc: One variable reference: the node id the checker facts join on, the exact span of the identifier, and the identifier text sliced from the embedded source.

defs.name: RenameRefusal
defs.source:
type RenameRefusal
  = RnNotAnIdent(String)
  | RnTaken(String)
  | RnUnknown(String)
  | RnUnaddressed(Span)
  | RnBinderInDocument(String, Span)
  | RnSourceUnreadable(LexError)
  deriving (Eq, Show)
defs.doc: Why a rename was refused. Every case is a fact about the document, not a guess about the programmer's intent.

defs.name: rn_message
defs.source:
fn rn_message(r : RenameRefusal) : String =
  match r of
    RnNotAnIdent(to) => "`{to}` is not a single identifier"
    RnTaken(to) => "`{to}` is already used in this document"
    RnUnknown(from) => "`{from}` is not referenced in this document"
    RnUnaddressed(s) =>
      "a reference at {show(s.lo)}..{show(s.hi)} is not addressable in the embedded source"
    RnBinderInDocument(from, s) =>
      "`{from}` is mentioned at {show(s.lo)}..{show(s.hi)} outside any recorded reference, so its binder is in this document and the seam cannot address it"
    RnSourceUnreadable(e) =>
      "the embedded source does not lex: {lex_message(e)}"
defs.doc: A human-readable account of a refusal.

defs.name: rn_occurrences
defs.source:
fn rn_occurrences(doc : ResolvedDoc) : List(RnUse) =
  concat_map(\(f) -> rn_fn_uses(doc.source, f), doc.functions)
defs.doc: Every variable reference in the document, in source order: the occurrence table an editor's find-references is, and the join key column a checker uses to pull `prism-tc-facts-v1` rows.

defs.name: rn_fn_uses
defs.source:
fn rn_fn_uses(src : SourceFile, f : RFunction) : List(RnUse) =
  concat_map(\(n) -> rn_use(src, n), rnode_universe(f.body))

defs.name: rn_use
defs.source:
fn rn_use(src : SourceFile, n : RNode) : List(RnUse) =
  if n.kind == rkind_var() then
    match ed_span_text(src.text, n.span) of
      Some(name) => [RnUse { id = n.id, span = n.span, name = name }]
      None => []
  else
    []

defs.name: rn_unaddressed
defs.source:
fn rn_unaddressed(doc : ResolvedDoc) : List(Span) =
  concat_map(\(f) -> rn_fn_unaddressed(doc.source, f), doc.functions)
defs.doc: Every reference the embedded source cannot address. Non-empty means the document and its source disagree, and every query here should be distrusted.

defs.name: rn_fn_unaddressed
defs.source:
fn rn_fn_unaddressed(src : SourceFile, f : RFunction) : List(Span) =
  concat_map(\(n) -> rn_bad_span(src, n), rnode_universe(f.body))

defs.name: rn_bad_span
defs.source:
fn rn_bad_span(src : SourceFile, n : RNode) : List(Span) =
  if n.kind == rkind_var() then
    match ed_span_text(src.text, n.span) of
      Some(_) => []
      None => [n.span]
  else
    []

defs.name: rn_uses_of
defs.source:
fn rn_uses_of(doc : ResolvedDoc, name : String) : List(RnUse) =
  filter(\(u) -> u.name == name, rn_occurrences(doc))
defs.doc: Every reference to one name, in source order.

defs.name: rn_use_count
defs.source:
fn rn_use_count(doc : ResolvedDoc, name : String) : Int =
  length(rn_uses_of(doc, name))
defs.doc: How many times a name is referenced.

defs.name: rn_is_ident
defs.source:
fn rn_is_ident(s : String) : Bool =
  match lex_raw(s) of
    Err(_) => false
    Ok(raw) =>
      match raw.tokens of
        Cons(t, Nil) => t.kind == TIdent
        _ => false
defs.doc: Whether a string is a single identifier, decided by the real lexer rather than a hand-rolled character predicate. A keyword is not an identifier, so a rename to one is refused here rather than discovered after the edit.

defs.name: rn_mentions
defs.source:
fn rn_mentions(text : String, name : String) : Result(List(Span), LexError) =
  match lex_raw(text) of
    Err(e) => Err(e)
    Ok(raw) =>
      Ok(map(token_span, filter(\(t) -> rn_names(t, name), raw.tokens)))
defs.doc: The span of every identifier token spelling `name`, anywhere in the text. This is the completeness check: a mention the resolver did not record as a reference is a binder, a declaration head, or a parameter, and any of those makes a use-only rewrite wrong.

defs.name: token_span
defs.source: fn token_span(t : Token) : Span = t.span

defs.name: rn_names
defs.source:
fn rn_names(t : Token, name : String) : Bool =
  match t.value of
    Some(v) => t.kind == TIdent && v == name
    None => false

defs.name: rn_plan
defs.source:
fn rn_plan(
  doc : ResolvedDoc,
  from : String,
  to : String
) : Result(List(Edit), RenameRefusal) =
  match rn_unaddressed(doc) of
    Cons(s, _) => Err(RnUnaddressed(s))
    Nil =>
      if not(rn_is_ident(to)) then
        Err(RnNotAnIdent(to))
      else
        rn_plan_checked(doc, from, to)
defs.doc:
The edit set that renames every reference to `from` into `to`, or the reason the seam cannot prove that rewrite is complete.

The checks run in a fixed order, so the refusal a caller sees is always the first thing wrong: the source must lex, every reference must be addressable, `to` must be a single identifier that occurs nowhere in the document, `from` must be referenced at least once, and every mention of `from` must be one of those references.

defs.name: rn_plan_checked
defs.source:
fn rn_plan_checked(
  doc : ResolvedDoc,
  from : String,
  to : String
) : Result(List(Edit), RenameRefusal) =
  match rn_mentions(doc.source.text, to) of
    Err(e) => Err(RnSourceUnreadable(e))
    Ok(Cons(_, _)) => Err(RnTaken(to))
    Ok(Nil) =>
      match rn_mentions(doc.source.text, from) of
        Err(e) => Err(RnSourceUnreadable(e))
        Ok(Nil) => Err(RnUnknown(from))
        Ok(mentions) =>
          rn_plan_complete(rn_uses_of(doc, from), mentions, from, to)

defs.name: rn_plan_complete
defs.source:
fn rn_plan_complete(
  uses : List(RnUse),
  mentions : List(Span),
  from : String,
  to : String
) : Result(List(Edit), RenameRefusal) =
  match uses of
    Nil => Err(RnUnknown(from))
    Cons(_, _) =>
      match rn_stray(map(use_span, uses), mentions) of
        Some(s) => Err(RnBinderInDocument(from, s))
        None => Ok(map(\(u) -> ed_replace(u.span, to), uses))

defs.name: use_span
defs.source: fn use_span(u : RnUse) : Span = u.span

defs.name: rn_stray
defs.source:
fn rn_stray(refs : List(Span), mentions : List(Span)) : Option(Span) =
  match mentions of
    Nil => None
    Cons(m, rest) =>
      if rn_covers(refs, m) then
        rn_stray(refs, rest)
      else
        Some(m)

defs.name: rn_covers
defs.source:
fn rn_covers(refs : List(Span), m : Span) : Bool =
  match refs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      if r.lo == m.lo && r.hi == m.hi then
        true
      else
        rn_covers(rest, m)

defs.name: rn_rename
defs.source:
fn rn_rename(
  doc : ResolvedDoc,
  from : String,
  to : String
) : Result(String, RenameError) =
  match rn_plan(doc, from, to) of
    Err(r) => Err(RnRefused(r))
    Ok(edits) =>
      match ed_apply(doc.source.text, edits) of
        Err(e) => Err(RnEdit(e))
        Ok(out) => Ok(out)
defs.doc: Rename and apply, in one step: the plan, then the edits, then the re-lex `Syntax.Edit` insists on. Either refusal comes back as itself.

defs.name: RenameError
defs.source:
type RenameError
  = RnRefused(RenameRefusal)
  | RnEdit(EditError)
  deriving (Eq, Show)
defs.doc: The two ways a rename can fail: the seam refused to prove it, or the edits did not survive being applied.

defs.name: RpLine
defs.source: type RpLine = RpLine { idx: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int }

defs.name: rp_tab_width
defs.source: fn rp_tab_width() : Int = 4

defs.name: rp_sep
defs.source:
fn rp_sep(text : String, i : Int) : Int =
  let b = byte_at(text, i)
  if b == 13 then
    if byte_at(text, i + 1) == 10 then
      2
    else
      1
  elif b == 10 || b == 11 || b == 12 then
    1
  elif b == 194 && byte_at(text, i + 1) == 133 then
    2
  elif b == 226 && byte_at(text, i + 1) == 128 then
    rp_sep_u2028(byte_at(text, i + 2))
  else
    0

defs.name: rp_sep_u2028
defs.source:
fn rp_sep_u2028(c : Int) : Int =
  if c == 168 || c == 169 then
    3
  else
    0

defs.name: rp_line_end
defs.source:
fn rp_line_end(text : String, lo : Int) : Int =
  let n = byte_len(text)
  var i := lo
  var e := -1
  while i < n && e < 0 do
    if rp_sep(text, i) > 0 then
      e := i + rp_sep(text, i)
    else
      i += 1
  if e < 0 then
    n
  else
    e

defs.name: rp_line_at
rp_chars
defs.source:
fn rp_chars(text : String, lo : Int, hi : Int) : Int =
  var i := lo
  var k := 0
  while i < hi do
    if byte_at(text, i) < 128 || byte_at(text, i) >= 192 then
      k += 1
    i += 1
  k

defs.name: rp_bytes
defs.source:
fn rp_bytes(text : String, lo : Int, hi : Int) : String =
  if lo >= hi then
    ""
  else
    string_of_buf(slice_bytes(text, lo, hi, buf_empty()))

defs.name: rp_trim_end
rp_width
defs.source:
fn rp_width(line : String, i : Int) : Int =
  if i >= str_len(line) then
    1
  elif char_at(line, i) == 9 then
    (i / rp_tab_width() + 1) * rp_tab_width() - i
  else
    1

defs.name: rp_body
defs.source:
fn rp_body(line : String) : String =
  let n = str_len(line)
  var out := ""
  var i := 0
  while i < n do
    if rp_ws(char_at(line, i)) then
      out := concat(out, str_repeat(" ", rp_width(line, i)))
    else
      out := concat(out, substring(line, i, 1))
    i += 1
  out

defs.name: rp_under
defs.source:
fn rp_under(line : String, arrow : Int, m : Int, lo : Int, hi : Int) : String =
  var out := ""
  var col := 0
  while col < arrow do
    out := concat(
        out,
        rp_cell(
            rp_under_head(col, m, lo, hi),
            rp_under_tail(col, m, lo, hi),
            rp_width(line, col),
          ),
      )
    col += 1
  out

defs.name: rp_under_head
defs.source:
fn rp_under_head(col : Int, m : Int, lo : Int, hi : Int) : String =
  if col == m && lo <= col && col < hi then
    "┬"
  elif col == m then
    "│"
  elif lo <= col && col < hi then
    "─"
  else
    " "

defs.name: rp_under_tail
defs.source:
fn rp_under_tail(col : Int, m : Int, lo : Int, hi : Int) : String =
  if col == m && lo <= col && col < hi then
    "─"
  elif col == m then
    " "
  elif lo <= col && col < hi then
    "─"
  else
    " "

defs.name: rp_arrow
defs.source:
fn rp_arrow(line : String, arrow : Int, m : Int) : String =
  var out := ""
  var col := 0
  while col < arrow do
    out := concat(
        out,
        rp_cell(
            rp_arrow_head(col, m),
            rp_arrow_tail(col, m),
            rp_width(line, col),
          ),
      )
    col += 1
  out

defs.name: rp_arrow_head
defs.source:
fn rp_arrow_head(col : Int, m : Int) : String =
  if col == m then
    "╰"
  elif col > m then
    "─"
  else
    " "

defs.name: rp_arrow_tail
defs.source:
fn rp_arrow_tail(col : Int, m : Int) : String =
  if col >= m then
    "─"
  else
    " "

defs.name: rp_cell
defs.source:
fn rp_cell(head : String, tail : String, w : Int) : String =
  concat(head, str_repeat(tail, w - 1))

defs.name: rp_label
defs.source:
fn rp_label(d : Diagnostic) : String =
  if d.code == "E7101" then
    "expected more input here"
  else
    "here"
defs.doc: The text on the caret's label. The end-of-input parse fault asks for more input; every other diagnostic points `here`.

defs.name: rp_message
defs.doc: The message on the header line. A parse fault's message already carries its own position; a lexical fault's is followed by the line and column of its caret.

defs.name: rp_exact
defs.source:
fn rp_exact(text : String, d : Diagnostic) : Bool =
  span_valid(d.span)
    && d.span.hi <= byte_len(text)
    && rp_one_line(text, d.span)
    && rp_ascii(text, rp_line_at(text, d.span.lo).hi)
defs.doc: Whether the compiler draws this diagnostic as one caret under one source line, the shape this module reproduces byte for byte. False for a span that crosses a line boundary, a span running past the end of the text, and a source carrying a non-ASCII byte at or before the end of the caret's line.

defs.name: rp_one_line
defs.source:
fn rp_one_line(text : String, s : Span) : Bool =
  rp_line_at(text, s.lo).idx == rp_line_at(text, max(s.hi - 1, s.lo)).idx

defs.name: rp_ascii
defs.source:
fn rp_ascii(text : String, upto : Int) : Bool =
  var i := 0
  var ok := true
  while i < upto && ok do
    if byte_at(text, i) >= 128 then
      ok := false
    i += 1
  ok

defs.name: rp_report
defs.source:
fn rp_report(name : String, text : String, d : Diagnostic) : Option(String) =
  if rp_exact(text, d) then
    Some(rp_draw(name, text, d))
  else
    None
defs.doc:
The compiler's plain-text report for one diagnostic, or `None` when the diagnostic falls outside the shape this module draws (see `rp_exact`). `name` is the source name in the location line; the compiler passes `<source>` when reporting on a single file. The result ends with a newline.

```prism
# import Data.Maybe (unwrap_or)
# import Syntax.Diagnostic (..)
# import Syntax.Source (..)
let d = Diagnostic {
  code = "E7100",
  phase = DPParse,
  span = Span { lo = 12, hi = 13 },
  message = "unexpected ')'",
  expected = Nil,
  related = Nil
}
print(unwrap_or("", rp_report("<source>", "fn main() = )\n", d)))
```

```output
[E7100] Parse Error: unexpected ')'
   ╭─[ <source>:1:13 ]
   │
 1 │ fn main() = )
   │             ┬
   │             ╰── here
───╯
```

defs.name: rp_report_doc
defs.source:
fn rp_report_doc(name : String, doc : DiagnosticsDoc) : Option(String) =
  rp_report_all(name, doc.source.text, doc.diagnostics, "")
defs.doc: Every diagnostic in a document rendered in order and concatenated, or `None` when any one of them falls outside the shape this module draws. The compiler stops at its first refusal, so a document carrying more than one diagnostic has no single compiler report to compare against.

defs.name: rp_report_all
defs.source:
fn rp_report_all(
  name : String,
  text : String,
  ds : List(Diagnostic),
  acc : String
) : Option(String) =
  match ds of
    Nil => Some(acc)
    Cons(d, rest) =>
      match rp_report(name, text, d) of
        None => None
        Some(s) => rp_report_all(name, text, rest, concat(acc, s))

defs.name: TokenKind
defs.source:
type TokenKind
  = TFixed(String)
  | TIdent
  | TUid
  | TQual
  | TInt
  | TFloat
  | TChar
  | TStr
  | TIStart
  | TIMid
  | TIEnd
  | TVOpen
  | TVClose
  | TVSemi
  deriving (Eq)
defs.doc: A token kind: a fixed token by exact spelling, or one of the special value-carrying and virtual kinds.

defs.name: kind_name
defs.source:
fn kind_name(k : TokenKind) : String =
  match k of
    TFixed(s) => s
    TIdent => "ident"
    TUid => "uid"
    TQual => "qual"
    TInt => "int"
    TFloat => "float"
    TChar => "char"
    TStr => "str"
    TIStart => "istart"
    TIMid => "imid"
    TIEnd => "iend"
    TVOpen => "v\{"
    TVClose => "v\}"
    TVSemi => "v;"
defs.doc:
The canonical wire name of a token kind, matching the compiler's artifact vocabulary (fixed tokens spell themselves; specials use the grammar's terminal aliases).

```prism

```

```output

```

defs.name: kind_of_name
defs.source:
fn kind_of_name(s : String) : TokenKind =
  if s == "ident" then
    TIdent
  elif s == "uid" then
    TUid
  elif s == "qual" then
    TQual
  elif s == "int" then
    TInt
  elif s == "float" then
    TFloat
  elif s == "char" then
    TChar
  elif s == "str" then
    TStr
  elif s == "istart" then
    TIStart
  elif s == "imid" then
    TIMid
  elif s == "iend" then
    TIEnd
  elif s == "v\{" then
    TVOpen
  elif s == "v\}" then
    TVClose
  elif s == "v;" then
    TVSemi
  else
    TFixed(s)
defs.doc:
The token kind a wire name denotes. Any name that is not one of the special aliases is a fixed token spelling; the fixed vocabulary itself is pinned by the compiler's own tests, not re-enumerated here.
